text: They had a great setup. We had a family gathering for two birthdays of about 10 people. Even though they weren't able to accommodate sitting us all at one table, they were able to Citizen one section. It was safer this way anyway. We went when they first opened at 11 a.m. and the restaurant only had about four other people in it. Other than the workers of course. The food was good. Even though we went early, it did take a while for the main courses to come out. Luckily, I only order the unlimited soup and salad, so my food was out first and early. Other than that, the food and drinks were quite acceptable, and our family had fun. The restrooms were very clean and neat.

text:
Very bad service,  the African American waitress was not friendly at all,  she definitely did not have any customer service skill, was rude, she got our order wrong. I ordered chicken parmigiana with chicken & gnocchi soup with breadsticks. When my order came out it was chicken scampi with chicken soup with no gnocchi and upon telling her this isn't what I ordered, she just picked it up without any apology or anything that would indicate it was a mistake. But I didn't want to waste food so I've asked her to put the food back on the table.  So she drops the food and leaves. Never heard back from her until I had to call her to bring my breadsticks which came out towards the end of my meal.
Now let's talk about the actual food, the wrong order wasn't even cooked properly,  the veggies on the plate was supposed to be sautéed but nothing was even remotely sautéed, every bite was so crunchy that it felt like the veggies just came fresh out of the refrigerator. The manager was just hanging around talking to other coworkers but never bothered to even check on the customers to see how's everything going.
I understand that mistakes happen when you are busy and short staffed but there was barely any customer at 1:20pm on a Thursday.  So having this many mess ups and to top that off the food being poorly prepared, isn't any excuse for a restaurant.  During this pandemic everywhere is already slow, restaurants are not getting as many business, even during slow season and time if they can't get it right then definitely they will lose more business. I can't even imagine what will happen during busy time. Very disappointing. Even an elderly couple behind us started complaining because they been seated for 10 mins but no one came to even take their drink order yet. So I'm not the only one had a bad ex the same day and time. I would suggest the management to pay close attention to their customers and re-train their waiters to have a better customer service.

text:
Wow has Olive Garden changed over the years! I thought it would be exactly the same judging by the exterior, but the inside is completely renovated! The inner decor is updated and much more modern - especially the bar area. Might be a nice place to grab a drink if they could garner the crowds.

They also have at each table a small iPad which has the menu on it (although it seemed to only include appetizers). Perhaps to facilitate the beginning of the ordering process? We did not use this feature so not sure how quickly it works. There's also a button to call the server - when pressed it lights up a red flashing light on the iPad case. I don't know that it also notifies the waiters because it didn't seem to correlate to when they showed up to the table. You can also pay with this contraption - it takes credit cards in a slot at the base for chip and you can slide at the main section on the right for non-chip cards.

Service was incredibly slow with only 3 tables in that section. But friendly.

Olive Garden is cheap. Not excellent Italian food by any means but it holds a special place in my heart from childhood. Their crowning jewel of deals is the famous buy one take one home for $12.99. Included in this is your choice of soup or salad and of course free bread-sticks. Add in the extra bread-sticks you get to take home, the butter and chocolate mints, the leftover salad and you get several meals leftover for just $12.99. I actually made 8 meals out of this one outing.

To reheat pasta at home, I recommend 30 seconds in the microwave (for half a plate) then put a pat of butter on a pot and saute until pasta is separated and sizzling. I'd add a little salt and definitely some pepper - olive garden is astonishingly under-seasoned many times for a chain.

name: Chas Funderburg
text:
Aside from the greeter being a little curt about whether or not a server that my wife and daughter had the day before was working today, the service was very good, we were seated promptly at a booth (this is a major plus for us, as we like booths).

Our server – she called herself a “waitress,” a term I haven’t heard in quite a while – was Jamie. Jamie was very pleasant, personable, and made  us feel quite at home with her attentiveness and pleasant conversation. She also served us well, explained the tablet-like device on the table, and the menu items, so that we knew what we were ordering.

The manager of this establishment – Lou Speaks; and when Lou speaks, people listen...  – must be doing something right, because all of the wait staff at this particular establishment performed their jobs well.

Even though this is a chain, the food tasted very good: even better than I remember from previous experiences: hot, fresh, and well-seasoned. Overall, we had a very good meal, and a very enjoyable, relaxed time.

If this particular Olive Garden keeps up this standard, we will certainly make this one of our ‘go-to’ spots for a family meal.

text: Worst experience at a restaurant. We were literally kicked out of this location!! My friend who came to visit me from overseas and I wanted to catch up so on August 24th we met at this location. The hostess was welcoming and we were promptly seated. Unfortunately our waitress (a black lady) wasn’t having a good day or perhaps she wasn’t excited to serve us because after requesting water she just took forever to take our orders. Never checked on us and was rude throughout the evening. When my husband joined our table she was disappointed he didn’t order anything as he was just arriving after a worker dinner with his colleagues even when he was the one you payed the check for our table when she unexpectedly brought it to us. Although we werent done she came to our table and started picking up the dishes and told us she needed to clean the table even though there were other tables available and no other people waiting to be seated. The people next to us were so shocked that this lady was cleaning as we havent even left the table. After leaving because we didn’t want to make an scene and embarrass the lady more than she had already done. I noticed the extra meal I had taking home was cold while my friends was warm. The waitress wasnt just rude but also disrespectful. Im so upset my sweet husband tipped her when the treatment we received from her was beyond rude. I complained to the hostess as I was leaving and I explained what had just happened she apologized but I feel it wasn’t enough. The manager never came to talk to us and we never received an explanation from it. Please dont come to this location, go somewhere else. The food isn’t worth this kind of treatment no matter what. I had always enjoyed Olive Garden but after this I refuse to go back and give them any of my money.

name: E.L. C.
text: Prices are outrageous and the KIDS directing parking had us park the furthest possible spot away from the venue, which didn't make a bit of sense. There were plenty of other spots closer. We will never come again. Quit hiring punk teenagers that give customers nasty looks and are obviously ego maniacs to work the parking lots. What an nice anniversary present, right?

name: Shelley Tyler
text: I went for a Mary Kay career conference. The last place was in downtown Houston. This time it was so much better on so many levels! This conference was easier to find and get to the location. The parking is amazing, I was less than half a mile away, and it was free!! The locale is so easy to locate your given meeting or setting. The rooms are so beautiful and spacious. I hope Mary Kay continues to use this venue.

name: Danny Thompson
text: Nice place our church have some service's there over 1 weekend every yr. 👌

name: Kevin Travers
text: Great outdoor theater. Its very nice when the weather is perfect..right by the waterway and lots of places to eat and drink before or after a show.

name: Kurt Snell
text: Great time. Good Food and Big Beers. Cheap Trick, Bad Company and ZZ Top were outstanding. Stood in line for a minute to get in but the lounge made up for it. All and all it was a Straight 10...

name: J S
text:
Me and my husband just moved to the Woodlands recently and it was so nice to find out how close the Pavilion was.
We recently went to our first show of hopefully many here.
We got VIP tickets to go see the Weird Al show that was recently here.
The lounge had some great snacks and service.
As for the seating and show itself. Both great we weren't crowded and we had good seat side service.
Already in love with this place.

name: Kenneth L Gabriel
text: Great venue! It's basically Miller Outdoor Theater on steroids. The acoustics and screens were excellent. I didn't go to the concession stands because I attended the Future/Meek/Megan concert and had VIP passes for a meal. Nonetheless, the place is laid out beautifully. It took 10 minutes ti get through the line, metal detectors, and get to a seat. Not bad for thousands of people at the concert. Also, Megan represented and she was everything! 🙃😊

name: johnny brown
text: Fantastic Pavilion for concerts! Conveniently located a mile off 45, dead smack in the middle of the Woodlands. Employees are always extremely friendly and helpful and concession stands carry everything from snack food to larger meals. If you're an alcohol Drinker it can definitely get pricey!

name: Mauricio Alvarez
text: This is one of the best concert venues I ever been to. Located in the amazing Woodlands, TX this place is offers great entertainment, amazing bands, signers and events for all the family are presented during the year. The food is not bad and the staff is always helpful in here. Great job The Woodlands Township!

name: Alexandra Albeck
text: Great concert venue. always a great time

name: Daniel Hynds
text: Good venue. Been to several shows throughout the years and always had a great time. Takes awhile to park, but never had to walk too far if we park by the mall. VIP parking is right there. $30 last time we did. Security is great so you can feel safe bringing your children. Food and drinks are EXPENSIVE, which is to be expected. The acoustics are great and even from the top of the Lawn the laser and light shows look awesome. Police, security and staff are usually very helpful with directions or questions if you need.

name: Anne Kriegerin
text: Great setup. Folks that work there are friendly and competent. Lots of great shows go through here. Awesome that it's nonprofit and helps our community. These photos are ones I took from the 5FDP/Breaking Benjamin/Bad Wolves concert on 08/03/18.

name: Alvin Jones
text: I loved the accommodation from the staff. The food was higher than a NFL game. The drinks were  as high.  If you're on the lawn, you can rent chairs for $7. And you leave them when the event is over.  Restrooms have plenty room.

name: Success_Is_Key
text: Seen Korn and Alice In Chains! Had a blast the drinks were way over priced and the lines for T-Shirts were Longggggggg. Drug dogs were waiting at the front. Js

name: Jennifer Garza
text: 30 seconds to Mars! Pitt passes! I was half a foot away from the stage! The opening artists were awesome too.

name: Jarrod Holmes
text: This is my favorite venue to see bands in the Houston area. The music sounds great here and it’s not so crowded that you can’t get to your seat. The bathrooms are clean, the food is decent. It’s expensive but you expect to pay 7.00 for a bottle of water at a concert. They have a Torchy’s Taco as well which is great. For the best experience stay at the attached hotel. All in all I have seen multiple shows here and have always been impressed.

name: Norma Lilia
text: Very nice experience at this pavilion. I remember I visited this venue years ago when Avril Lavigne was touring and I must admit these guys keep this place in mint condition after all these years. The covered seating is not the most comfortable, but very good views for the price so it’s a little bit of a give and take in my opinion. The GOT concert was amazing. Love it all and do recommend this venue.

name: Carlos Alberto Dominguez
text: The best venue for outdoor music entertainment, well managed and maintained.  No bad seats, get a lawn seat .. bring a blanket and enjoy the show.

name: Jordan Tripp
text: This is a great venue for a concert. I've sat both in the seats and on the lawn and both were great experiences. The pavilion and area around the pavilion are beautiful. It's also great that there is plenty free parking around the venue. A+ Experience!

name: Daniel Rouege
text: Went for Christmas, which was a bad idea, wonderful place to meet friends

name: Lady Rachel
text: My sister and I went to see Peter Frampton on September 21st. We had never been to this venue before but we were impressed by what we saw. There is ample parking and even if you don't get parking in the garage at the venue there is parking a few blocks away. There is a beautiful walking trail along the back side of it that meanders along a waterway. It is covered seating. Very cozy. Will visit again.

name: Joshua Huddleston
text: Nice spot. Great concerts. Close to home. Very clean facility and not overly crowded gow they have it laid out. I will say that the pricing on the food and drinks is out ragous. Coming from Los Angeles wear the alcohol/food is usually 8 to 10 bucks.. I was blown away paying 17$ for a tall can of beer.

name: Steven Rivera
text: Great to go for venues  and even free shows like the live jazz every Friday (before the epidemic). Great place.

name: Irais Avila
text: I'm not a big fan of big venues like this one, especially if it's outside, but the staff is friendly and mainly you go to have a good time. This place is huge and I've sat in many different places in this venue and I always have a good time. It's always very clean and the staff is very helpful.

name: Ryan Kruse
text: Cool people. Innovative board games. Had a nice weekend here. Suggestions for improvements, should offer free water at venue.

name: Sandra Lawler
text: What a great concert venue! Don’t bother paying for a chair just bring a blanket and enjoy the grass.

name: Kevin Taddeo
text: What a great place to watch a concert. Friendly staff. Good views. Great seats. Good beer. A bit pricey on the drinks though.

name: Ruben Kan
text: This is a good clean venue with nice landscaped surroundings and water features and nice greenery. There is also ample free parking in the green lot. I can't say enough good things about the physical environment. That is until you have to deal with the security. The Pavilion website will say empty water bottles are allowed. For some reason they think believe they can behave like airport security. But when I went there the guards will the "artist" has said they don't allow bottles (even empty ones). I find that hard to believe. What harm can an empty bottle do, serious question. At best you can throw it on stage, at worst you are just annoying the guests and forcing them to buy $5 waters just to use the environment destroying plastic bottles. I think it's the latter. Honestly what good does that do? Literally just leaves a bad taste in my mouth. Literally, of the water fountains near the restroom, half of them dispense warm water. I know God forbid one has to drink warm water. The other beverages on sale, for instance beer is $13-$14. Then it becomes clear why they are the BYOB (bring your own bottle) haters. It's completely hypocritical to allow solid food but disallow liquids. Shame on their "rules."

name: Turtle Beach
text: Great concert venue; however, the security was inconsistent. Ladies were turned away for the slightest bag overage but the weed smell was everywhere. The instructions were unclear on what you could bring in. One line rules are overly enforced.  When you enter, you see others with blankets, food from outside and things the previous line just turned people away for. Other than these, we had a wonderful time.

name: Andrew B.
text: Great pavilion, outside event. Enjoy my time there everytime for a concert.

name: Carol Sue Gore
text: Love this venue for concerts! It's beautiful here, with amazing sound and views. Always a wonderful experience. Saw Heart and Joan Jett here last year and had such an awesome time with friends, old and new. ❤️

name: Maria Droddy
text: Great experience! Lawn tickets were very worth it. Don’t worry about bringing chairs, they have rentals and if you bring a blanket that’s fine too!

name: Eduardo Martinez
text: Super fun venue! We go here usually for buzzfest, rock concerts etc and always have a blast. Has a similar feel to Miller Outdoor Theatre in Houston just an upgraded, bigger version. Great views even when seating in lawn area however the lawn area isn't covered so be ready for the outdoor elements⛈🌤

name: Sean Yuan
text: The Woodlands Pavilion is a fantastic concert venue to experience any genera of music. There really isn’t a bad seat in the house. I opted to sit on the hill and rent a chair. The vendors were all very friendly and once the music started, the pavilion really showed off it’s magical environment. Plenty of parking in multiple lots. Highly recommend catching your favorite artist here if you ever get the chance.

name: Tandy Lofland
text: Tonight we came to see an American nontet performing original compositions, and it was magical. There were three supporting acts: a Polish quartet, a French quartet, and a Danish quintet, all performing original contemporary compositions.  They let you bring in a gallon bag filled with snacks, so don't forget to snack up!!  The people were very friendly and the facility was clean. Would definitely visit again!

name: Tab Taylor
text: Watched the Image Dragons!  We sat on the lawn and still had a good view. The venue is very nice and kid friendly. For an alternative rock band, there were lots of young kids.

name: David James
text: Your basic pavilion style venue with grass and regular seating. Pay way too much for food and drinks. Parking can be a pain. Very nice grounds, clean bathrooms.

name: Joseph McMullen
text: The lawn is the best. You can walk around and mingle during the concert. I like the layout. Its a good design.

name: Judy Lees
text: Venue was really beautiful, employees were friendly & smiling, and the concert was fantastic!

name: Efrain Montiel
text: Great venue for outdoor concerts .

name: Brandon Bogott
text: First time ever going. Can’t wait to come back. Wish the stuff was cheaper but that’s what you pay for at a place like this

name: G M
text: Great atmosphere! Exiting out was a nightmare but the events held here are always nice.

name: michael polk
text:
Saw HOOTIE and the BLOWFISH last night and it was a great show!! Easy in , easy out! The accommodations were excellent, you can Uber right up in front! Navigating your way through the facility was surprisingly free flowing, easy to get refreshments and souvenirs. We had lawn section which we rented chairs for $7 each. I will get this section when I go again, I was very comfortable being able to stretch my legs as I could hear and see the stage very easily. They have two jumbo screens for close up views which was a great addition. Tickets for lawn section $29.50, rented chairs $7.00, souvenir shirt $30, look on my wife's face as she watched and listened to one of her favorites...
$PRICELESS. ❤💯

name: Jimelanie69 Pollard
text:
Outstanding outdoor venue in The Woodlands.

Lawn seating is very inexpensive and a good way to lay out a blanket, bring the family and watch superstar performers in the grass.

Covered seating is excellent. Big screens on each side of the big stage so you can easily see the performers if you are far away.

Easy to access parking in this world class venue.

name: Lashaunda Hillsman
text: I went to see my favorite artist, Mary J Blige. She put on a phenomenal show. I enjoyed the show and the venue was great as well

name: Ely Aly
text: It was for a graduation. Easy parking garage. Tight seating. Sticked staffed but for our own safety.

name: Evie
text:
Love the lawn area and great venue for family fun.
However.....one issue I have is the cup of water issue??? The water spilled out before I could even drink it? Who came up with this idea? What a rip off to pay $7 for water in a plastic cup with no lid???? I want my money back!
PS The Woodlands should be in an uproar because this doubles the economic footprint!  pouring water from a plastic bottle I to a plastic cup with no lid???
Shame on you!

name: Branden Ward
text: I have been to many concerts here. Love it every time!

name: Khang Tran
text:
Great Pavilion to see shows. The "green" seating area outside of the main seating area is pretty nice. They don't allow outside chairs (anymore) and it's a total bummer if you have to get out of line to get it checked in. The other thing is that they have a bag size limit, so you want to keep that in mind.

My girlfriend and I have gotten to sit in the main area and the green area and I would say the main seating area is more comfortable, but the green area is a little more fun.

name: Karin Day
text: Great venue, but pricey and help are extremely snooty, almost ruined my concert experience. It's also HOT in the summer... like no ventilation at all.

name: John Haak
text: Jimmy Buffett, if you are comming with normal tix (not suite or season pass) plan at least 1 hr to get through the gate. Also check the "Waterway gate" behind the stage for shorter lines.

name: Sverre Amundsen
text: Favorite outdoor venue in Houston. The sound is always great here. However, beer prices are almost criminally high. It's also hard to find a seat where the view isn't at least partially blocked by the huge pylons (see pics).

name: Jeremy Jon
text: Sound quality is always a hit or miss at Cynthia Woods Mitchell Pavilion. When they  have the bass so loud that it distorts any other instrument playing or performer signing, it makes me question the high prices I'm paying for my seats. However, when the speaker system is adjusted correctly, the experience is usually a lot more fulfilling.

name: Roger Dodger
text: Absolutely love this venue! Saw Godsmack & Bush here last October, and had a fantastic time!!

name: Jonathan Clingman
text: I've always had a good time here. Probably because I only go when I really wanna see who's playing! Large lawn, good box seats. Great place to catch a concert.

name: Chelsey Perez
text: Great venue. Love the family atmosphere. They bring in some amazing bands. Would love to make it back to see a ballet performance.

name: Joshua Ludy
text:
Always such a great array of music and performers. Of course the prices on refreshments and snacks are pricey, but not more than expected at any out door entertainment venue.

Some of the big name bands and individual artist perform here and as long as the weather is nice it is awesome! I recommend parking down near the waterway. It’s only $10 and better when time to leave.

There are a lot of great restaurants and bars nearby to get a beverage beforehand and a couple of nice hotels within walking distance.

name: Andy Mer
text: So beautiful and it’s always clean.

name: Sage Viridi
text: A great venue to see musicians play at! I love the feel of the outdoor atmosphere and the overall cleanliness of the venue. The staff are very attentive and extremely helpful. They do their jobs and do it well. Some of them even join in on the fun and dance and sing around to the groups that are playing. The food, drinks and alcohol are way overpriced though, but I guess you gotta earn money somehow for a "non-profit" venue. Overall, very good place to visit. Would recommend it.

name: Christopher Jayroe
text: Very nice and clean facilities. The atmosphere is very laid back and chill. The food can be a bit expensive, but that’s to be expected. Great concerts to attend and a very fun place.

name: Michael Whitley
text: Great place to experience the music you love. Seating is great anywhere in the venue including on the lawn. Venue has multiple food choices and several beer vendors on site. A must do place on the concert goers list.

name: Laura Crouse
text: And the rain came down. But they let the lawn people shelter under the canopy  even after the lightning stopped. Smart people.

name: Jen Romero-Stentella
text: Chris Tomlin, Holy Roar concert was amazing! In general concerts at the Pavilion are really good. Every year the lineup gets better and better.

name: Nichole Moretz
text:
Awesome venue! I've been going to Cynthia Woods for concerts for over 12 years and always have a great time. The lineup of bands that come through town is eclectic and amazing! Typically concert ticket pricing is not too expensive. I do suggest getting a few drinks before entering the venue though, food and drink prices are stadium style. Through the roof!
Really close to the Woodlands Waterway so easy to walk to several bar/pubs.

name: Robby Cantu
text: It's always a special treat to visit The Pavilion. My first Duran Duran concert was there the summer of '93. Great memories! In 8 days, I was able to see Stone Temple Pilots, The Cult, Bush, Hailee Steinfeld and  Charlie Puth...how diverse and cool is that? 😊

name: sloshedmrbones
text: I'm giving 3 stars due to priceing on drinks, snacks, tickets and fees. The venue is nice and plenty of free parking or a paid parking garage.l as well.  There is always a variety of shows to attend from big name concerts, to 4th of july celebrations or family Halloween or Christmas shows. Definitely worth checking out if your in the Woodlands, there is a lot to do around the venue before your show, whether it be visiting a local bar on the water way, trying a new restaurant or just taking a walk seeing the world around you.

name: Logan Moore
text: I like this venue, but I would like to expand on some details. I appreciate that it has several entrances. It is very similar to a lot of seats up from, lawn in back venues. However, there are some areas that are sub par in comparison. EG the men's room is just 6' long troughs stacked next to each other, which I personally detest. Also, there is not one fan or exhaust vent in the restroom, so expect it to be 20+ degrees hotter in there. I am a 40 year old guy, and instead of giving out wrist bands, or using common sense, I was ID'ed every time I tried to purchase a beer, which increases wait times for everyone.  They stop selling beer at 10, although they do sell beer at the top of the lawn. A lot of people these days don't use cash, which is fine, but their credit card system seemed to bog down a lot.

name: Karen Farrell
text: I wouldn't go back to this venue if John Bonham came back from the dead to play with Led Zeppelin there. Bob Seger was great after he started three hours late with no concessions and everyone crowded under "roof" that was leaking.

name: Daniel
text: Such a cool venue. The lawn is perfect on summer nights and the acoustics are the best I've heard for an outdoor stage. Food and drink are pricey but it's expected. It's great for summer concerts.

name: Shana Trahan
text:
The only downer was the extreme heat conditions. Faith. Evans glowed and her magical personality came through in her words and music. Jill Scott impressed with her music and her dramatic presentations. Jill has mad skills. Boys 2 Men, well, what can I say? “How do I say goodbye?” They were very well received by the audience, gave near studio quality sound from stage and sounded like the original recordings. Loved them!!! They also explored some rock and roll successfully I might add. I never realized how broad their musical range was. They should come out with something new. I’m down to buy it in any format. In closing let me say, “Don’t go away from me, I’ll reach out my hand to you.”

Great pairing!

name: Steve Edwards
text: Jill Scott, BoysIIMen and Faith Evans gave a great concert sponsored by Magic 102 Summer Block Party.

name: Dina Reyes
text: The concert started around 10 p.m. Give me time to cool off and maybe I will give you another star.

name: Krystal Joseph
text: It was hotttt this place is so hot even tho it’s an outside event it’s just not enough cool air circulating under the shed

name: Samuel Snelling
text: This place is awesome! I've been to so many concerts here, and this place has been the best place for concerts in Houston!

name: Ana Garcia
text: Always a blast here, rain or shine. I've attended concerts and the children's festival and no matter the event, staff is great. Sometimes the merchandise booth is only set up on one side of the venue, so if you don't see anything posted up near the area you entered then check out the other side!

name: Joel David Herlache
text: Love this place. Staff is amazing, easy in and out, great facilities, amazing sound.

name: TL ULRICH
text: Amazing shows here... dont drink the water, there's blood in the water.

name: Tanner Boyd
text: ZZ Top was awesome! Even though it rained the party never stopped!

name: Tam Tam
text: I have been supporting this venue since year 1. I particularly enjoy the free famiky summer concert series each year as well as the July 4th symphonic performances! I have a great time with the Weenie roasts as well as regular dual band concerts. Wish more concerts would book for Autumn & Winter here since seasonal temps don't change much year round. Very special outdoors concert memories made under the stars - and the laser lights can make a performance climb over the top bc it does tend to get a little boring without lights. Speakers sound great as long as you arent directly a few feet in front of them The huge ceiling fans are genious as well and the covered area is fantastic for those hot summer days! I appreciate that I dont have to be cooped up or smell cigarettes. Also i appreciate thw strict security measures protecting us prior to entry, so thanks for the safety as well. Thanks for performing here everyone! From Don Henley to Blue October to The Cure to Houston Symphony, I will always come back here for a fun musical night.

name: GABRIELA MEDINA
text:
Enjoyed a great  concert experience...
Wouldn't have thought that you can have such a great time for Country Music, he can definitely put on a show.    Parking is hard be prepared to pay cash and at the lowest $20

name: Ann Gallagher
text: I would give five stars but the food was way expensive. The fries were rubbery. Paying $21 for two meals I expected the fries to be warm and fresh. We were under the cover with seats with backs and every once in a while a nice breeze would come through. Two large screens let you see what was happening on the stage and plenty of speakers so you could hear the great music.

name: A. J. Franklin
text: Its always fun goin out to the woodlands. Its always a nice change of scenery for me especially since i work up there as a cook

name: Allycia Mallory
text: Beautiful venue. I went to help volunteer for the Children’s Festival in 2017. It was so much fun and I can only imagine the concerts there at night if it was that great during the day.

name: Monica Ellison
text:
Great experience every time we attend a concert.
Beautiful venue and great service. Only wish they had more trash receptacles.

name: Andrew B
text:
Attended a concert here for the first time in late July and returned in September for another one. Venue is in a nice area. Easy to get to. Easy to get in. I had heard from other people that the sound at the venue sucked, but both experiences I had were great and I could hear everything. I have very few complaints and will gladly return to see another concert.

The only downside is nothing inside is cheap, but that's expected in my opinion. And perhaps another downside is if you're on the lawn it can suck to stand on the slope for several hours. If you sit down you may not be able to see the stage very well. No biggie though!

name: Amanda Bradlo
text: Saw Charlie Puth here, great outdoor pavilion. Pretty much every seat is a good seat. Would definitely see a show here again.

name: K Eric Bagwell
text: Excellent facility. Spacious yet accommodating.

name: Chelsea Jordan
text: Grew up going to concerts here, from symphonies to pop music! They offer lots of free events for families throughout the year! Parking is far, but they do have a VIP and a handicapped lot closer up. Love going here and like getting lawn tickets and you can sit where you chose. Many times can bring towels/blankets in to sit on, but check the individual event to make sure you can.

name: Michael Crismon
text: I actually went ice skating. Not at the pavilion.

name: Jody Davis
text: I love watching converts on the lawn.  The only issue is that they're are no dedicated walkways so you always have lost people cutting through your group. You can rent lawn chairs, but most people stand during the concerts.

name: Victoria Pratt
text: Even from the lawns, you can see the stage good. HD cameras make the experience great for the price. Went when it had poured. When lightening occurred they gave the lawn patrons access to covered areas, even empty seats until the lightening stopped. We brought umbrellas because it wasn't on their banned list online. Band performing decided the umbrellas weren't allowed so Cynthia Woods Pavillion  checked in items and gave a tag for you to collect after your visit. However, I wish they would have sent an email or newsletter of the bands no-go list of items.

name: Mz Lady G
text: Loved the concert with Frankie Beverly & Maze. The pavilion is a cool place and we sat in the lawn. We all wished the restrooms were on the hill. I suggest you spring for the lawn chairs if you will be there for awhile or have back issues.

name: Frank Ramirez
text: Saw Slipknot for Knotfest here...man it was AMAZING! GREAT venue, up close and personal , no matter where you sit.

name: Joey Dee
text: Been going to the pavillion for years well designed and have great acts that perform.

name: A Seel
text: This place is great! The staff is always friendly, and the acts are amazing. You will enjoy the covered seats and big fans to keep you cool, or the lawn where you can rent chairs. I have done both, and always have a good view. Check out one of your favorite bands or singers there, because the energy is electric. If you want to save $ on ticket fees/charges, you can also purchase tickets at the box office.

name: Lauren Ehler
text: Great area. Outdoor pavilion! Have gone here numerous times and have loved it every bit, pricing is pretty steep on alcohol but other than that it’s a blast!! Parking is a bit expensive so we usually will walk over instead of paying.

name: Graham Prosch
text: Great venue for the whole family. Wonderful lawn seating the bring the kids along and covered seating if you want to sit a little closer. The pavilion is small enough to feel pretty intimate and there is not a bad view in the whole place.

name: David Moore
text: What a great concert venue! Very intimate, compared to Toyota Center. No bad seats anywhere.

name: Danielle Jackson
text: Absolutely beautiful to go for a walk and hit any restaurants or shops along the way👍🏿

name: Sam Padgett
text: They’ve gotta figured out the sound issues with this place. It’s the big downfall to this pavilion

name: Valeria Mcdonald
text:
Great venue for all types of music. Hearing and seeing the Houston Symphony perform "heroic music" from superhero movies gives a much better appreciate of how big a role music plays in movies.

The facility is very nice with fans and some air conditioning. Concessions are expensive. $14.50 for a beer; $10.50 for 4 chicken tenders and fries; $9 for a refillable soda.

name: rawwritsrachel
text: Great venue. Always a great time. Prices of food and drink are outrageous, but the Woodlands Pavilion has always been a great venue. I don't care for the beef up in security. We watched Dave Matthews Band and they were great. The Pavilion is surrounded by a beautiful park with paddle boats and stuff... just beautiful scenery.

name: Henry Lafleur
text: Great shows, free parking, easy to get in and out. Lots of options to walk to the venue from surrounding hotels. The lawn is nice when it is cool and has breezes in the summer (as long as it doesn't rain). The covered area has large fans and is good for rainy days.

name: Adela Trudel
text:
DO NOT worry about getting Lawn seats, unless you're too lazy to get there early. The lawn can fill up quickly bit is still a great experience! No bugs to worry about, you can bring in a blanket to sit on, and the breeze feels great (compared to seats that don't get so much wind).

Use the internet to choose a view if you want seats! The pavilion website does a great job when selling tickets to let you know if your view will be blocked or partially blocked.

Always family friendly and lots of cool people and fun concert goers.   (FYI I have seen Dave Matthews and Jack johnson... so maybe it was the performers bringing in cool people).

Be prepared to walk because you will! I've self parked, vip parked, ubered, and stayed at the closest hotel.... all still required 5-15 minutes walks to get in and to my seats.

Summary.
Great, fun, venue for concerts!

Tips for ladies
The restroom on the right side of the stage.... just walk in the exit if there's not a line. You'll end up right at the potties. Do NOT use this tip to cut in line when there is one, or the potty patrol on there will bust you!

name: Shelby Best
text: I always have a good time when I attend concerts here. Can enjoy the lawn or there are seats available. I would recommend the seats if possible. Do serve food and alcohol.

name: TxTrueLibra Rose
text: Excellent Concert from Doobie Brothers and of course Santana. CWMP Staff were great.

name: Curtis Edwards
text: Great concerts, as busy as they get during the summer the place stays clean. Security has been fairly well. But be prepared the place fills up for seating and when busy.

name: Heather Haworth
text: The lawn seats were amazing when we saw Pentatonix...

name: Linda Garcia
text: Awesome venue... Need put huge fans on hot evening..

name: Katherine Kessler
text: I always live to catch concerts here! Hosting the best National Acts, try purchasing the Woodforest VIP tickets and get access to the Woodforest Lounge-they have great drinks and really good food!

name: Nancy Lozano
text: Every time I come here for events I have a great time.  Lawn seats are great fun. Tons of parking. Drink prices are reasonable.

name: Jessy Epperson
text: Went to a concert and enjoyed myself. Had co versions shutdown due to lightning strikes in the area, but the staff was apologetic and professional. Bathrooms were clean for having 15k people there, and parking and traffic were well maintained.

name: M T
text: Love the venue. Great acoustics for concerts. There is not a bad seat that I have found. Always enjoy going to events here.

name: Brooke Arey
text: Joan Jett and Heart was fantastic! Venue was awesome too.

name: Jose Anaya
text: It was a great experience,  zztop and bad co , they rocked it , after 50 yrs and they still jamming hard as can be , great time and memories,  only if the beer could be a little cheaper lol , I know it's the cost of business, loved it

name: Lucas Ashby
text: We have enjoyed coming here for many performances. They offer shows throughout the year, and some are even free. We got to enjoy their Halloween music performance from the Houston Symphony. They tend to have a diverse array of singers and comedians for everyone. Seating can be under the roof or on the grassy area. Remember to check the weather before coming here.

name: Ak Kk
text: Thank God for this place. Hard to find calm walks and oen greenery in Houston!

name: arifur rahman shuvo
text: Great arena.I have witnessed ironmaiden for the first time there.it was such a blast

name: chad Pepper
text: Great place for a concert actually moved up to the grass with friends and was more comfortable. Never did figure out why you can't have a draw string bag though.

name: HellkittenJ Jmb
text: I like this venue because no place is a bad seat. Acoustics are good wherever.

name: Gloria Fields-Escobedo
text: The walk was filled with beautiful scenery.  We absolutely, positively thoroughly enjoyed all Summer Block performances!! DJ spun great jams and crowd as bursting with energy.  Summer heat was in full effect though. We stayed hydrated with water $(5) and ice cups ($2).  It didn't cool down until late evening. Staff members were cordial and very helpful!!

name: Erica Bess
text: Any where you sit has a great view

name: Erika B
text: My family and I saw Lynyrd Skynyrd, Bad Company and the Outlaws at the pavilion on May 12th. It was an amazing show! The pavilion is my favorite concert venue! Looking forward to seeing many more great performers here!

name: sharon rolan
text: Great experience.  Sound was awesome.

name: Amber Garnett
text: My fav concert venue. We came 6 hours just to see maclemore and kesha at this particular venue because it's so great! And it was near 102 and I was comfy under the awning.

name: Sarah Hebert
text: Great venue for concerts and safe for kids! The staff has always been excellent and the concessions are run by local schools to help with programs like band. Great for the community!

name: Angela Baucom
text: Very nice! Extremely expensive beer!

name: diaryofareader
text: So much fun!! Flo Rida, TLC, and Nelly. Loved it

name: Douglas Fresh
text: Da Woodlands getting our grown folks on! Summer Block Party .

name: Zoltan Wilson
text: I love this place. It's right down the street from me so I try to go all the time.

name: Clismer Mayorquin
text: A nice little field for concerts isn't the big auditorium but it's ok it's woodlands area you know who cares ?

name: Jeremy Sosa
text: Always love coming here for concerts. Grass seats aren’t too bad, and you can rent lawn chairs or bring a blanky. Great place

name: meyber santos
text:
Beautiful venue, all seating is good, fans give great breeze 😉
Ladies make sure you bring small purse. They don’t allow anything too big.

Staff is helpful and kind .

name: E McClung
text: Great acoustics in an outdoor setting. Has a nice feel, even when it is a fully packed concert. Room to breath!

name: Gregory Walker
text: The service was great, the people was better and they will see me again in any kind of weather.

name: Char Austin McDevitt
text: Been to so many concerts there that I can't even count. Always have a blast at all- even in the scorching heat.

name: Alonzo62 Cantu
text: A great place for outdoor concerts with Peter Frampton

name: Jeremy Cooper
text: Cool place for a concert.

name: Chris Wedemeyer
text: Great place to kickback outdoors and enjoy a concert... Like most venues, food and drinks are way too expensive...

name: Adrienne Sanchez
text: Outdoor venue. We like to pay a little extra for the seated area. Food and drinks are overpriced as is expected at a large concert venue. The lawn area doesn't allow blankets so be advised when sitting there. They do have chairs you can rent.

name: Jon Litt
text: An amazing venue for live music events.  Very easy to get in and out of. Very clean. Wonderful acoustics.

name: Ging More
text: Just love the location because it's a pretty scenic walk outside and it's very close to everything. We've been going for the last 14 years to attend concerts and other events, It has always been clean and the volunteers/attendants have always been very helpful.

name: Ashley Hubbard
text: Attended Boston Pops Orchastra.  The whole evening was amazing.

name: Alexander Munse
text: A fun place with lots of great shows every year! The food and drinks are a bit pricey, but that’s expected when seeing live music! The sound is great, no matter where you are in the venue and they have great spots on the lawn that are inexpensive and you can still see and hear everything

name: BELINDA MOONEY
text: I love the opportunity to listen to different venues. I especially love to go to the Houston Symphony orchestra concerts.   It is also nice for the budget that you can choose between paid seating & free seating at many of the concerts.

name: Holly Colotta
text: Great concert-Train & The Goo Goo Dolls! Great Fellowship, It was cool, it wasn't hot. we had great seats. the concert was great! I hadn't been in probably over 25 years! had a blast

name: Heather Helms
text: It made my daughter's graduation day amazing even in with this pandemic

name: Stacy Baldwin
text: Took our daughter for her 1st concert experience and everything flowed wonderfully. It would be nice if they could find a better system for merchandise purchasing/shirts but that is to be expected with the amount of people. Overall great experience!

name: Myra Rock
text: I attend the Maze show last night and I was disappointed that I couldn't enjoy the show. I will never purchase tickets on the last row of any section again. People were standing along the rail, were loud, and drunk. One lady spilled her red drink on my mom's white cap and white jeans. I couldn't believe that security allowed all those people to stand there. A few people were sitting on the rail with their feet on our seats. So disrespectful. If they had seats they should have been in them. I bought tickets to enjoy myself and I could not. The venue needs to do better.

name: Janice Lavalais
text: Gotta love this place. I've been to many concerts here. The food is a bit high and the covered seating isn't too cooling. You may get a cool breeze every now and then! Just note for Summer concerts, the staff seating you sweats too. 😆

name: Fawn Nicole
text:
It’s a nice venue, needs more fans in the back

Acoustics sound amazing, I’ve been coming here since I was a kid. I can’t give more than 3 stars because I don’t like people charging $7.50 for a small water and taking advantage of people 💁🏻‍♀️

name: Dennis McCorvy
text:
Concert was awesome.
But tell me how can you sell chicken finger baskets without BBQ SAUCE OR HONEY MUSTARD.
We are in Texas, give sauces besides Ketchup and Mustard..

name: Josh Goldberg
text: This place is a huge venue, but I'm not a big fan. It's a hike to get to and the security staff at the entrance can be quite rude at times. I've seen a handful of shows here and personally, I prefer smaller, more intimate venues. Go experience yourself to see that it's just an okay venue.

name: Alex Kirby
text: Incredible outdoor venue. There's a reason this place is famous, for sure. The acoustics are fantastic and there's usually seating on the lawn in the back that's fun to sit on during more laid back shows.

name: Crystal Brown-Quintero
text: Great place for concerts. Just saw Lynyrd Skynyrd/Bad Company!!!

name: Kimberly Stafford
text: My favorite venue! The staff are always professional, friendly, and helpful.

name: Russell Martin
text:
Good outdoor fun. Parking is disorganized at start. No direction. You are just on your own. After you find a place to park you are concerned if it is truly legit.
The venue was good. Plenty of food and beer. No liquor.  When leaving it was not too bad to get back to the interstate. It is a must do when in Houston.

name: Trivia Eva
text: My son and I Love the cynthia woods Mitchell pavilion.  We love to come out here, relax , and enjoy the concerts they have. It's always a great time. We had seats before but we prefer the lawn sits. There the best.

name: Jabre Williams-Southerland
text: Friendly helpful staff. Great vendor variety with reasonable pricing. And #1 clean restrooms with no wait even with massive amount of people. VIP room needed more seating but we secured a table with no problem since we were early.Ample parking but it was not needed since we stayed at the Marriott next door.

name: Melissa White
text: Not a fan of the seating. Can barely see over anyone. Not a great landscape angle for seating like the domes and arenas. Kind of small screens on side of stage. Nice workers. Fast getting in. Save your $ for ATT Center or Hard Rock. Better view & experience.

name: Kelly Pierce
text:
Went for Wild West show by the Symphony and it was awesome.  BONUS...
Pre show had a free book event for kids....hooray for reading ❤

name: Evan Gooch
text: Shout out to all the great concessions workers.  It has to be a crazy hard job standing there and taking the abuse as customers realize they are paying $17 for a beer.  Holy moly.  The lady I  talked to was very nice and professional, and could only laugh about their pieces.  The venue is nice and the open air environment really is great, but come on,  that's flat out robbery on your beer prices.

name: Robert Devor
text: Covered outdoor theater, large overhead fans, good viewing of stage, performances,  plus large screens to view movies or performances.  Easily accessible seating. Not air conditioned; weather dependent.   Parking nearby.

name: Jessica Lee
text: Saw Third Eye Blind and Jimmy Eat World. Their concerts were great. The venue, as always, was wonderful. Particularly, the bathrooms were very well maintained. Love coming here.

name: Philip Lan Conn
text: Live music,  friendly appreciative crowd.... this is a great venue to enjoy a concert, especially with unique hillside views.  Pro tip, if on a budget or tickets are sold out sit outside by water or park and picnic and listen for free.

name: Elizabeth Crabtree
text: If I could give less than one star I would. When I was younger this place was a lot of fun. Now there are so many constant rule changes you couldn't pay me to go. I went today to a concert there and it was the last straw. My bag, which I have been bringing to shows here for TEN YEARS and as recently as last month, was too big, BY LESS THAN ONE INCH. Like I legit keep a tape measure in there. The lady checking us was so rude, and when I was upset offered to get "a supervisor" which literally looked like just a random employee next to her. Who was even ruder. My options were to throw my purse away or miss the show. OVER LESS THAN ONE INCH. So I throw it away and get back in line two lines over. They're letting in bags bigger than mine that are not diaper bags or medical bags. . .

name: Something Ur Remember
text: Nice Venue To See A Concert

name: TheOverton86
text: We went here for the Thomas the Train event. It was a fun day. The workers seemed organized and kind. The only thing that needs to be discussed is the stroller area. That was an absolute disaster.

name: Pepe Lepu
text: I went to see Iron Maiden and the place is wonderful!!! Lawn area is clean and cheap, great look!!! I recommend this place to spend time with family and friends!! Thank you!!

name: Ana Maria Alvarez
text: Free when you sit on the grass. I have had a great time everytime I go. Pet friendly.

name: Mr. Mark Francis
text: Always great shows. Bob Seger's show had a light show from the heaven's. And lot's of rain

name: Chimney Smoker
text: Always love going to shows here. Only issues I have is their absolute outrageous prices for food and drink. As if spending 70-200 dollars for the show isn't enough. Let's spend that same amount on a small thing of food and a couple beers....

name: Patrick K
text: Great place to see a concert. Would be nice to get a few more fans or something to move a bit more air under the covering but... That may not help too much. The staff here is always really good too.

name: Dave Chapa
text: Always a great venue for concerts. We recently saw  Santana, Third Eye Blind and Jimmy Eat World and the sound was outstanding.  Very clean and staffed well with friendly people.

name: Deborah Hymer
text: Good concert venue if you can get seats and not have to sit on the hill.  Some seats have obstructed views due to posts.  Restrooms are small but there are a lot of them.  Good location for pickup and drop off of guests.

name: Rekina R
text: Awesome venue.  Parking needs to be better and I'D be great if the ushers could assist more when patrons continue to try to sit in seats that are not theirs!

name: Roberto A Bermudez
text: Awesome show by Carlos Santana. The venue was packed! Poor Ventilation system under the pavilion tent.

name: Joseph Passe
text: A bit uncomfortable and cramped in the seats. Beer was $17. Has to close fairly early which seems to cut bands encores very short compared to other venues I've been to. But other than that. The acoustics are very good. So was the view

name: Eddie Simmons
text: Sat in the lawn it was totally different than I'd imagined,not a bad seat anywhere. Cheap Trick,Bad Company,and "The Little Band From Texas" one great show.

name: Joey
text:
Actually I used to attend concerts along time ago.   I am always attending events at the town green center such as the recent lighting of the doves and fireworks  or the 1 mile cancer walk.
Google asked me for this review because it is attached next to pavilion.    I did give one star because last time I attended a fountain drink was over $5 bucks   Glad I don't drink alcohol.  Whoooo over 12$ a beer!! And make dang sure you eat before you watch a concert!

name: Vivienne Saunders
text:
Great venue. I don't think there is a bad seat
One of the elevators was out in the parking garage though at the July 7th event and my bad knee was not happy. Did not know about other elevator.

name: Monica Campana Calderon
text: Christmas decorations are magical at this time of the year, really fantastic!

name: Sherri Lee
text: Went to the Jimmy Buffett show on 6/1/19. Waited in line for almost an hour to get through the gates. For what reason? I have absolutely no idea. I'll avoid that venue in the future.  Suggestions if you go: leave plenty of time to get through the gate, leave your bags at home or make sure you know what size bag is approved (yes, they measure), know what you can take,in, take a bottle of water so you don't get overheated during the lengthy wait to get in.  They had the fans on but at a very low speed, so dress comfortably.

name: Debra Benton
text: Inside and out of the pavillion are nice. Parking is atrocious so be prepared. The teathet is like an amputee theater so everyone can hear the performances inside and out. Pretty cool.

name: Krystal Garza
text: Saw Marilyn Manson and Rob Zombie! Absolutely an amazing experience....

name: Cynthia Goedeke
text: Nice place but I wish the waters were not $7.50 a pop or more. Food and drinks are very expensive here. Be prepared to spend just as much as your tickets or more here just for food and drinks.

name: Lisa Swaim
text: Love  concerts here! Staying at one of the local hotels within walking distance is the way to go! Don't forget to look at their purse policy so you know what you can take in..

name: Lexie Griffiths
text: SO many fun events hosted here! Beautiful and shaded unless you're out on the grass

name: Michele Behannon
text:
Great venue. Lighting and sound, amazing!
Outdoor seating, covered seating available at extra cost. Many things to do around the pavilion as well. The drive from Houston is long but worth it for the performances.

name: Ryan McKee
text: Beautiful location. Our second venue since moving to Houston. The surrounding Woodlands area super upscale and a great place to explore. Free shuttles and beautiful waterway will be returning to try some of the local restaurants

name: Lori Moore
text: My husband and I had a wonderful time, enjoyed it tremendously. One thing that I would suggest is that some form of transportation from the parking lot to the Pavilion. Frankie Beverly and Maze, Keith Sweat and KEM were all fabulous!😊

name: simona arispe
text: Cynthia Woods Pavilion was awesome and beautiful it was perfect for the Ozzy concert. Had a FABULOUS time.

name: Britany Bianca
text: $20 parking, 16.00 margaritas, 5.00 water, and 9.00 sodas. It was 100 degrees. You can't bring water. Read the permitted/allowed list before leaving your house. They measure purses. You were allowed to purchase lawn tickets but couldn't bring your lawn chair, they rented them for 7.00 and they only accepted cash. My 35.00 ticket after "convenience fees" ended up being 67.00. I won't attend another concert here, just my preference 🤷🏽‍♀️

name: Phoenix Riiz'n
text: The CWM Pavilion is a great place. We saw Cage The Elephant and Beck. Cage was great. What an amazing performance. Beck was terrible. I've been listening to Beck for over 20 years and this was the first chance I got to see him live. What an absolute disappointment!

name: Tanya Horak
text: Great Concert!  Got to see Iron Maiden!

name: Edgar Castlow
text: One of my favorite places to see a concert

name: Dawn Shipley
text: The Venue was great but parking was an issue.  We tried the handicap parking, they were full and we were sent to Silver lot.  No attendant was there and so we were not sure where to park or get the shuttle so we had to walk which was difficult for my husband.  Maybe we were early but attendants should be there if they send you to a lot.

name: rita soria
text: Weather was beautiful, staff patience & courteous.

name: S.B. R.
text: A good time everytime I go. Just saw Weezer and Pixies, going back for Pentatonix. The smell of weed is always a nice part of the experience.

name: Alton Degeorge
text: Jimmy Buffett concert. Think I caught a contact high...I can't remember. The pavilion is, has, and hopefully always will be a great venue to see a show. All visitors should know The Woodlands strictly enforces a noise ordinance. Shows always end by 11.

name: Johnnie Honey
text: Just recently visited Cynthia Woods Mitchell Pavilion during a concert, the staff there was great. When we got there our seats were upgraded. Everyone was very pleasant! We had a great time!! the only thing that I might have to say that maybe a negative would be the price of a Coke, a very small cup of coke is $5. 25. Very pricey!! disappointed that they keep the water coolers on the outside warm. I will always return for the great concerts and the experience. I just won't buy another drink. Enjoy!!

name: Chantel Williams
text: Parking was the bomb.  We got the gold parking pass did not have to walk far at all.  Everyone was very nice and helpful!! Mary J and Nas put on a great show

name: Chelsea Moore
text: We had a super fun time at Ozzy! Drinks are pricey, but we were expecting that.

name: Robert Adsit
text: Very easy to get it and out of the amphitheater. Music sounds great but the only thing that makes it difficult the fans aren't on a higher speed to cool it down... in the summertime gets really really hot

name: Tyra Kennedy
text: Went to my first concert not too long ago and had a blast. Just super outrageous on prices, and other people were rude and kept running into me. But the place itself was clean and awesome.

name: Paul Cain
text:
Great concert with pop evil , cheap trick  and poison.
$25.00 for 2 x1 liter water and a bucket of popcorn was a bit ridiculous but since the venue is non-profit I guess I can always deduct it as a charitable donation.

name: David Huss
text: Sound quality and audio engineers were terrible. They need new equipment and better skilled technicians. Almost ruined a good concert. Would recommend traveling to other venues if possible.

name: Paul Barnwell
text: A lot of public venues like this can be confusing, not very clean, and the staff could be non interested. Not here!! It was super clean and easy to navigate. Everyone from the ticket checker to the gal we ordered drinks to we super friendly and welcoming. The people stationed all over the seating were happy to help us find our seats and the nearest clean restroom. And of course the acoustics were pretty good. Had a great experience

name: Elizabeth Marion
text: Always have a wonderful time when we go just wished it was more suitable for disabled people

name: Kerri Almendarez
text: Had a great time seeing Tesla, Joan Jett and Styx

name: Brack Botts
text:
Love this Venue! I’ve seen a lot great concerts!
I love being outside for concerts!
It’s Clean n safe and alway a lot fun!!! All #music #maryjane #love

name: Keeper Brunson
text: Nice grass, pleasant venue. Non-alcoholic beverages were hard to find and the staff was pretty aggressive about asking people to leave the minute the concert was over. Otherwise, would highly recommend (as long as it's not raining. Most of the venu is uncovered.)

name: Matthew Torres
text: It's a great venue, some seating doesn't have that good of a view even though it's a small to mid size venue. Drinks are really extremely expensive. Nice clean bathrooms and good hangout space

name: Rosie Pineda
text: I loved the place BUT I would have enjoyed the concert better if weather was warmer. We had to leave early due to it being to cold for kids. Loved Chris Tomlin Concert 4/2019

name: Jason Sorrels
text: This is a nice place to see a concert unless it rains. When it's raining they shut everything down and just leave people standing in the open getting soaked with no way to make them feel like they are getting something for their money. If you want to see a concert here definitely keep an eye on the weather and if there is a chance of rain don't do it. If it rains it will be a waste of time and money. Huntsman the management company really need to rethink their policies before they completely ruin this venue.

name: Barbara Scheel
text: Had a great time at the Heart/ Joan Jett concert!!!!

name: Daijia Taylor
text: First time there went to see Chris Tomlin AMAZING EXPERIENCE EVER !!!! Totally worth it changed my life

name: Aundria Eli
text: I wish it was not so humid in our city. That's it. Life Water  $7.5 a cup of ice $2 Sufficient restrooms constantly bring cleaned. Toilet paper, soap, hand dryer all available and acceptable.

name: Louis B
text: An outdoor venue in Houston Texas is a heat stroke waiting to happen. The venue is laid out in a "fish bowl" like area where virtually no breeze will reach you. Two beers costs $28.75 I have seen more than twenty events here and always notice the band members dealing with the heat. I remember seeing many concerts at the Astrodome, the Summit. Guess what they had in common? Air conditioning.

name: Nicholas Tew
text: Great place. Lots of awesome things take place here.

name: Janet P
text: They have a policy that will not allow you to carry a purse larger than 8.5"x11", my bag 1/2" too wide & we were turned away. I offered them to search it to see it only contained a wallet, phone & lipstick & they refused.By the time we caught a lift back to our hotel to secure my purse & back to the venue, the show was half done. I understand the reason for the policy, but 1/2" really?! Make sure to measure your purse!!

name: Dave Peterson
text: This is an awesome concert venue. Very comfortable. Very well designed and laid out. Good parking nearby. We love this place.

name: Gordon Hare
text: Always a blast at this venue. There’s not a bad seat anywhere in the house. The Lounge by the North Gate is always a fun place to hang out between sets.

name: Tina Goff
text: So my great memories here! Great venue and super convenient to night life after concerts. Concessions are very speedy.

name: Jeremy H
text: Beer prices high as usual but now they offer a small Craft Beer selection! Love this!

name: chanu varma
text: Awesome place in woodlands

name: Westugirl
text: Wonderful!!!  Love going to concerts here, took my 11 yr old granddaughter to see Edgar Winter, Alice Cooper, & Deep Purple her,  she is a big fan now!!

name: Sabrina Scott
text: I missed something "outside" but it was ok once I adjusted myself.   Tickets took forever but that's not your issue.

name: Idalia Hernandez
text: From the parking to the pavilion is a plopping walk but worthy to take because every way we go there was a sign directing us the path. It is a well organized place for any event. Kudos to the staff for a well done job.

name: Rob Meyer
text: Great venue. Had lawn tickets, so sat pretty far away.  Sound was awesome! Parking was a distance away, so be prepared to walk.

name: Kimberly Landers
text: The shows are amazing. Enjoy the bands. Music was very on point. Nice stage layout. Outside around the building was so beautiful. The seats are small & to close to each other though. Spend most the time smash next to a stranger and couldn't move. Seats not for those have any medical problems with hips or legs. Be careful. Other then that the staff was very nice and bathrooms was very well kept

name: Stroka D
text: Packed,  awesome crowd and tons of beautiful women. First time coming but will be back for more shows in the future.  This place can hold thousands of people plus every seat gives you a clear view of the stage.

name: ryanjiii
text: Free concert by the Houston Symphony on a breezy evening with my beautiful daughter.  Just one of those moments in life that make it worth living.

name: danny schwertner
text: It's a great venue for a concert. Adequate number of bathrooms and concessions.  Keep in mind though, it is the Houston area, and it is an outdoor venue. June-september evenings are hot and humid. Dress accordingly. The only reason I don't give it 5 stars is there are some lines of sight to the stage that are obstructed.

name: hybrid8theory
text: Excellent Venue. Lots to see and BUY!!! Lol. Some seats have MAJOR stage obstructions, but still overall not bad.

name: Krisi Turner
text: We went to a concert last night. It was amazing until we got a drink. Two beers cost us 34.00. I will never purchase a drink from there again. This was ridiculous.

name: Kevin M. Cook
text:
Some of my rating might be nostalgia - I saw a lot of shows here growing up. That said, it’s a pretty well-managed, efficiently-operated venue, and I’ve heard that a number of artists/performers/bands particularly like playing Cynthia Woods (I imagine some also find it remote, and a bit suburban).
If you’ve never been, definitely check it out. It’s a great experience in both the grass and seats, usually.

name: Kia Justice
text: Great venue. They have plenty of free parking that doesn't take long to walk from. The food and stuff is overpriced but I think that's kind of standard for places like this. I always enjoy going to concerts here.

name: Wendi Nesbitt
text: We went to see Shinedown and it was awhile between my last visit. We walked from our room at the Marriott so we did not experience the parking. We sat on the hill and it was nice. Security was worse than the airport so not sure why so heavy? Overall grass was comfy to sit on. I just wish people would sit their butts down. I can not stand an entire concert.

name: Cynthia Nieves
text: Its so nice

name: DJ Williams
text: Nice concert. Very hot in July summer evening. You can bring your own snacks if they are in a gallon size clear ziplock bag.

name: Nisha G
text: I had an awesome experience while watching artists on the Heartbreak on a Full Moon Tour. Hopefully, you're able to experience it on a great day as well. The weather was rather nice, concession prices were HIGH as expected, margaritas  $15.50 were not good or strong, their beverages are wine based and drenched in cherry syrup😝. The staff were very polite, provided prompt service at each stand from gates to restrooms (which were kept SUPER CLEAN) to concessions...great job. The parking staff were great and helpful too!! Make sure u sign up and receive pavilion updates to stay current with show times for each act, where to park, what to bring and not to bring. OVERALL GOOD

name: Daniel Masters
text: Unorganized lines and half decent sound. It's an OK venue to see a big act but not an amazing experience. As it is an outside venue, it is extremely hot. I have never been more uncomfortable at a venue than this one. There is nowhere to escape the crowd and heat.

name: carla bankhead
text: The Woodlands Pavilion Redid the place! Amazing evening!!!

name: Tom Lambrecht
text: Great place to see concerts! Largest outdoor music venue in the U.S. seating is comfortable, but check the rules for what you are allowed to bring in. They are very strict.

name: Racheal Coleman
text: Mary J Blige always perform well!

name: Triple G Roofing Huffman, TX
text: I have an extra ticket for Chris Young tomorrow night. Sec 107 Row C Seat 15. Paid 119 make me an offer

name: Jennifer Blakeney
text: Great place for concerts. Beer is high priced but that's with any concert. Love the lounges.

name: Cindy Gauthier
text: Best venue ever for watching live music and events! Quaint at 16,500 capacity, great helpful staff. Food and liquids very expensive. Bring your own in 1 gallon zip lock bag. Check website for bag guidelines. Most concerts limited bags to 8.5" x 11", and they are firm on it at security. No knifes,  weapons. They have metal detectors and search bags and blankets so don't try to sneak in something. Go in South Gates for quicker entrance and less crowds. I love this venue and I invite you to come and watch a show. You won't regret it!!

name: Rosaleen Doll
text: Excellent venue. Excellent staff, very friendly always. I love attending to concerts at this place.

name: Enrique Adame
text: Great place to bring the family.

name: Chimira Harris
text:
Sitting on the hill is

the best seat in the house

name: Abhishek kaurav
text: You can borrow lawn chairs for $7/ea.(cash only) Lawn seats are bang for buck, good audio systems, nice setting.

name: Greg Bledsoe
text: The place is fabulous. Nice big TVs. No bad seats. (they could be a little more comfortable tho). Really enjoyed the event.

name: Desiree Mckinney
text: Beautiful surroundings, just too hot to sit outside in August! Please add a ducks to blow on the seats. I'll never go back in the summer.

name: Karl Bernard
text: Great outdoor venue to see a concert. Lawn seats are the best affordable option and the covered seats provide a more comfortable option that's closer to the action.

name: onlybigfern onlybigfern
text: Good for most shows can get crazy when it rains

name: Tina Grimes
text: We are so fortunate to have a venue like the Pavilion located in The Woodlands. Not a bad seat in the house, first class entertainment, courteous staff, venders, and fun atmosphere add up to a great evening.

name: Amanda Nicolas
text: Lawn seats are the best!!! Go a little early and find a place on the hill. Everyone always wants to get closer in the seats, but it's super hot and there's no air circulation. Up on the hill, you have more space and usually a breeze. The only time to go for the seats is if it's rainy or cold. The ability to ve able to take food in a gallon ziplock is great! You can take your own snacks and save your money for the severely overpriced drinks. We did share a "share your stack". It had waffle fries, cut up chicken strips, bacon, nacho cheese, and cilantro sauce. It was really flavorful and it was so much that the two of us couldn't finish it.

name: Siddharth Chauhan
text: Awesome place

name: Monica Johnson
text: Not a bad seat in the place! Despite being an outdoor venue, the design allows for good airflow and large overhead fans provide nice breeze. All staff appeared pleasant and helpful. Found the adult beverages to be wildly overpriced - $12.50 for 8 oz. glass of cheap wine. Wine is also sold by the bottle which we hadn't seen before.

name: Miranda Ingram
text:
I have been going to this venue for years to some awesome shows! Unfortunately they haven’t been taking care of the venue the same. Bring plenty of OFF Bug Spray to protect from the infestation of fleas on the lawn. My group had to leave our last show because they were biting us so badly. I wrote the venue and asked what they were doing to address the issue but still haven’t received a response back. Disappointing to miss a concert that was already paid for because of the bug issue...

Edit: Got an email back that operations is looking into the issue and they are sorry for the inconvenience. Hopefully the issue will be resolved.

name: Miss Williams
text: Went into the rooms,not the concert portion, no large bags. I had a medium sized purse but had to take it back to the car 20 min away. It was for the superheroes kid event. Alot of moms had to turn around. Traveling with alot of kids, that's hard to do. So we got out of line walked 20 min to car and came back to and even longer line. Not sure if I'll return. Was definitely a hassle.

name: Mary Ballard
text: This is a lovely venue. My only complaint is it is a very long walk from the parking area to the pavillion. Also, you better mark your parking space with their app or have a good memory.

name: Matthew Shaver
text:
Location is not ideal for Houston as a whole, though easily accessible from I-45. In my experience it's a bit too large for an amphitheatre which combines with the typically semi-interested locals to suppress the atmosphere. Though recently I've noticed this actually works well for the ever more common, multi-headliner nostalgia tours where they just play the hits.

On the plus side the staff has always been great, it's easy to get in/out, there's tons of parking, lots of food/drinks within walking distance for before/after and it draws a good lineup year in a year out.

name: CeeCee
text: Great food and drinks! Just overpriced! 😲 Staff was super friendly and helpful! Love it here!

name: Everardo DeLuna
text: I love this amphitheatre, it my favorite one in Texas. The food, beer options and layout are all great. I can't wait to come back.

name: Tiki Campbell
text: Always have and always will love this place. Great music and performances in the open air cannot be beat.

name: G Roberts
text: Awesome venue. ...in Spring and Fall when you are not melting outside....even better when the pit is general admission. I've seen a ton of awesome shows there

name: Monica Carrillo
text: Went to the Ella Fitzgerald and Frank Sinatra tribute with the Houston Symphony. I loved that they let you use their lawn chairs. It was a nice time.

name: Travis Workman
text: Saw Rob Zombie and Marilyn Manson here!!! Good show good sound and very well organized. Had no hassles getting in and out first concert I've been to in awhile and felt comfortable enough at the place to actually enjoy the show instead of being on guard the while time watching for people that like to crowd ones personal space. Lol. Staff maintained good crowd and drunk control.

name: Siddharth Chauhan
text: It's real a prototype...

name: Leroy Lopez
text: Great outdoor venue with good security. Seen many acts there, and it never disappoints, but be ready for $12 beer night!

name: David Wallace
text: Went to the Holly Jolly Jingle tonight to see the local high schools' play Christmas music. Nice way to get in the spirit of the season...#xmasmusicoutdoors

name: Amin Sabanero
text: This is the first time a ever visited the pavilion and it was for the Depeche Mode concert. The park that surrounds this place is a very relaxing place. I am planning on going back soon.

name: Lady Morte
text: Awesome shows, love the layout, always have a good time! The only negative is the prices are crazy for food/drinks, of course I know it's the woodlands but definetly have gone up on price in the recent years. Oh well, I'll can always drink before I get there! :)

name: Kristi McAfee
text: Fun to go. Beer is $16 for a tall and very difficult to see if you are short. Pay the extra money to be off the lawn

name: India Chatman
text: If I could give them less I would. You send my tickets to the wrong address, your representatives took forever to fix the issue and I have not gotten the refund for my parking yet! I had to walk forever to get to the concert hall and now I’m sweaty before I could even get to the concert which I wanted to avoid hence the reason I paid for garage parking! I’m so mad I would rather just get my money back and go home!

name: Melanie Halbert
text: Easy to get to and get in and out. Nice staff. Love that concerts aren't ever too loud due to the location. Very clean facilities.

name: eddie webb
text: Great environment. Love this facility

name: Megan Barineau
text: Depending on what show you go to see, this place is great. The worst part is that the seats are pretty crammed together, but it's generally clean and well maintained.

name: Jennifer Lebron
text: One of my favorite venues. If a band I listen to goes here, I'm there.

name: Acid Cannibal
text: Went to Cynthia woods Mitchell pavilion for my first concert, twenty-one pilots July 5, 2016. I had never been here for anything before and I had my concerns because of our seats being on the lawn.  It was not too far away from the stage.  I was worried I wouldn't see them at all or hear them that well but I did, very well! Of course I prefer closer seats which I'll strive for next time but it was an amazing experience!! TOP was absolutely wonderful and the pavilion was a great location for this concert and I will never forget this experience.  Oh I won't forget they had lawn chairs for rent 6$, I didn't think we should since it's a concert we'll be standing majority of the time. Big water bottles 2 cost us 7.50$ not too terrible considering how hot and thirsty we were.  Grass didn't make me itchy, I have eczema and I did sweat but I hardly became itchy so I don't know if the grass is fake or treated but it was okay to sit on for several hours. The lines could use more organization that's for sure..looked like one giant blob of people rather than actual lines for entry.  Restrooms not terribly far so that's good.  Parking far but not unreasonably considering the venue, nice scenery too.

name: Sami Ozan
text: Always amazing! Besides the fact that my friend lost his phone. But that's on him lol

name: Shadowlexx McRocklin
text: Best concert experience besides tons of people..  Parking is a challenge..  Alway a great event place..

name: Danielle Carden
text: The lawn seats are my favorite and there's a new lounge that it awesome with giant projector screens.

name: William Beck
text: This time we came to see Bob Seger and it was thundering and lightning like crazy! They postponed the concert a bit. But everything worked out, and they were great! Always an AWESOME  experience!

name: Old Goat H.
text: Need more fans above for summer people packed in close sound was great need one of these by sugarland!

name: Jonathan Hill
text: One of the best outdoor concert venues. Very impressive and clean. Location is also very pretty. Parking is a close walk as well. I don't really have anything bad to say about it.

name: Blake Northrup
text: Always a great place to see a show. Heart, and Joan Jett were the latest we saw, and they didn't disappoint.

name: Steve Ferguson
text: I think it used to be a pretty good place for a concert. I really dislike how they have ruined the concert experience. They used to let the musicians play as late as they wanted to. Nowadays they shut it off at 11 pm no matter what. Being an outdoor venue the Texas heat does not make it nice to start the concert early evening.

name: Aurora Barron
text: Loved this venue!!!! Easy parking...took a nice walk around this venue, so much to see... Enjoyed it

name: Renae
