With that being said, the bed was cozy.

resp.text: Hello Hein! All the updates have been complete for several months- what images did you see that didn't match? What do you mean you wanted more "with my rooms and utilities offered" I want to truly understand your perspective! The entire property was upgraded- nothing in the rooms carried over except the tubs on some floors- everything else is all new. Please contact me at jw.engblom@sheratondallasnorth.com thank you!

name: Michael Price
text: Really a nice revamping of the entire building. Have a great breakfast menu. In the room service is second to none. There is a great View of the North Dallas Skyline. You're very close to the local high end shopping. An extra incentive is the close proximity to both of Dallas' Premier airports.

name: ashley t
text: Front desk people are rude. Omg but the people in the restaurant area are AMAZING! Made my bday awesome. Went for drinks at the bar after our day and Le was awesome! Served me my first drink being 21! Thank you so much Le.

name: Shaina Attoh
text: The rooms are very nice and the customer service was top notch!!! I would definitely stay again.

name: sean stevens
text: Very good location, close to shopping and food. The pool is a nice touch. Up to date decor with a very modern feel.

name: Arica Thomas
text: No working pool

resp.text: Thanks for your review Arica. Our pool was damaged in the recent ice storm and is in the process of being completely renovated! The pool is noted to be closed on our website, but will reopen later this month! Of note, our pool bathrooms will be totally renovated, and our pool will now be heated! We look forward to welcoming you once it reopens!

name: Erik Lopez
text: The place is overall really nice and clean. The bed was super comfortable and the bathroom was very neat. The bathroom is small like others say, but I did not find it a problem. Even though there was construction during our stay it didn't bother us at all even when we slept in. The noise does travel easily from the hall due to gaps under the doors, but we were right across from the elevators and it still didn't affect us much. We also enjoyed the environmentally friendly option that let your earn extra points or $5 towards foods or drinks in the hotel. Overall the stay was very nice and pleasant.

name: Miss Bland
text: Staff was friendly and helpful. Hospitality was great! Rooms stay clean and if needed staff responds quickly.

name: Amanda Delapass
text: Decent place, super comfy beds, clean which is always important. Parking is a little strange, but either way I would stay again.

name: Arron Baldwin
text: I stayed at the Sheraton for a work gathering that lasted three days. During that time the staff was wonderful, warm, and very helpful. My room was always clean for me when I arrived back midday and at the end of the day. Enjoyed my stay.

name: William Sparks
text: Had a small problem with our room but Johnathon at the front desk helped us out and was awesome.  A/C worked great.  TV was nice.  Everything was as expected for the price.

name: Faisal Khan
text: The hotel was very clean and the staff was friendly.  The pool is smaller than it seems in pics,  wish there was an indoor.

name: Joshua Flores
text: Great service. Good rooms, comfortable beds.... Modern look. Will stay again.

name: Patrick Hamilton
text: Recently revamped, everything is new in the room except the shower. It blows my mind that anyone would have the stupid idea of putting a sliding door that doesn’t lock on a bathroom door. Also the fact that theres a massive gap in each side that you can clearly see through. Seriously, who approves these things? Parking is tight and horrible. Location is good.

name: Christopher Sells
text: near lots of things to do. very clean. unfortunately here at the same time as a large group of kids who are doing things like playing soccer in the hallway and pressing all the buttons on the elevators. not the fault of the hotel, but undesirable nonetheless.

name: William Schaefer
text: Absolutely amazing staff, great management who really know how to treat guests. Thank you to Rob for giving extra special attention to our dog Hayden. We will definitely stay here again when visiting Dallas.

name: Ms. Mecca's Take
text: The renovations were magical in making this look like a brand new hotel! The staff is Awesome

name: Dionicio Casas
text: Best sleep I have ever had.

name: Laura Little
text: The toilet ran all night. The parking was limited unless you paid, which was confusing because the kiosks did not work. Hard to get into the hotel due to the only entrance was on a feeder of a feeder. Employees were nice. Iron, iron board, coffee machine all were clean. Super soft pillows. A/C cold. Room was clean.

name: betty kelly
text: Art show very nice.  Hotel rennovated very nicely.  Like the lounge food lobby space.  Flat bread pizza great.

name: Kristina Riggs
text: We were able to book two nights online and the check-in was flawless. They are pet friendly and my Jack Russell Terrier feels right at home. The room is very comfortable and the bed is very comfortable. I am a student so I do a lot of work online so the desk and study area is very convenient and set up very nicely. The Wi-Fi is not free however there is a charge for the Wi-Fi. So I opted not to have Wi-Fi and use my own hotspot. There is an ice machine that is automated so you don't have to put your hands in the ice machine and contaminate all the other ice. Housekeeping that was on the floor was very nice to my husband. He was helpful and helped us find our room. The TV is updated and there are a lot of channels to be able to watch. And the bed is very comfortable with for big fluffy pillows on it. The air conditioner is working wonderfully and there are no signs of bed bugs and no signs of roaches. Even the amenities that they leave are more than I have seen in other hotels. They leave little bags of Q-tips and cotton balls and little Essentials that you may forget. Like a loofah. The bathrobe says one-size-fits-most and unfortunately it doesn't fit me LOL. We are on the 14th floor and it is considered the quiet floor and the view is spectacular. I actually needed an extra chair in the room and I called downstairs and they brought another chair to add to the room within 30 minutes. I feel safe the entire time I'm in the room and even when I take my dog outside I still feel safe because there is Security on the property outside. I would highly recommend this hotel to a couple staying in Dallas.

name: Victor Marquez
text: Very impressed with Sheraton hotels, the lobby looked newly renovated, as well as my room. 42" flat screens. Front desk hosts were awesome! My fridge wasn't working when I arrived to my room, called the front desk, they had a replacement at my door in less than 10 min. Great service!

name: Lucia Arzola
text: Beautiful hotel and great view from the 15th floor

name: Denny Syn
text: Great staff & beautiful rooms.

name: Luke Synnestvedt
text:
Look, I’m a Bonvoy loyalist when it comes to traveling, but this hotel really missed the ball on several factors.

Issues:
Air conditioner sounds like a factory exhaust fan (even though management has assured reviewers as recently as 4 weeks ago that “all facets of every room have been replaced now and should be higher quality, including the utilities”).

The shower has two settings: scalding or freezing, you pick (but not really because it switches randomly while you’re in it).
The shower is very low pressure.

The parking entrance/exit doesn’t work, so you have to buzz the front desk and wait for someone to let you in or out. Tonight, that took 20 minutes for me.

The rooms are poorly sound proofed at the front door, so if you are near an elevator or have noisy floor-mates, expect some racket.

The good:
Beds were comfy and rooms were average. That’s pretty much it.

resp.text: Sorry to hear we didn't live up to your expectations Luke. I am not aware of any issues with our parking system, water pressure, or temperature, so these must be isolated issues. I will research your reservation so that we can look into your room specifically. Thank you.

name: tanya rae
text: Great burgers! Nice staff as well

name: Paul Wright
text: Gave a friend a ride here.

name: Adrian Johnson
text: Always love stayingat the Sheraton. Everytime I travel. How I had aroom faces the expressway. The motorcycles zooming by and the trucks can be a bit load. Thats the only reason I gave it a four star. Everyrhing else about the place is so comfy and pleasant

name: Lemuel Moore
text: This is a cool hotel. The rooms are clean. This place has been renovated and use to be a Holiday inn back in the day. Its looks really good at night with the lights.

resp.text: Glad you like our hotel! I am not aware we were ever a Holiday Inn but we have flown a Hilton and a Wyndham flag in the past. We look forward to your next visit!

name: Judie Collins
text: Remodeled and fast elevators.  Wish the ATM fee was not $4.00. Need more gluten free choices.

name: Travis Kirkpatrick
text: Stayed because my wife's company uses them. Room was very nice and clean. Lobby and bar area seemed great though we didn't have drinks or food. Parking is a bit frustrating.

resp.text: Thank you for the kind words.  We look forward to having you back again.

name: Kirk Lawrence
text: Older hotel that shows it's age in the hallways.  Room was newly renovated. Clean quiet and comfortable.  Lobby looks nice and customer service was good as expected.  Nice place for the price.

name: jake buckingham
text: Nice hotel. The woman checking me in had a poor attitude but maybe she was just having a bad day. That being said my keys didn't work when I got to my room so I had to come back down and wait in line again.. she wasn't there when I came back. The woman in front of me had non-working keys as well. After waiting in line twice and 3 elevator rides I got to my room 30+ mins later. They only had one working elevator which was slow with so many people using it (5-10min wait) and it was jam packed every time I needed to get on. The rest of the staff was great. The rooms are clean. Gold members get to use the lounge

name: Ben Gilbert
text: Got a good deal here through the Hotel Tonight app. It was fine, met my needs. The lobby had a musty smell to it, but the room did not. Many channels on the TV were fuzzy or distorted. Bed was comfortable

name: Will Crowley
text:
Parking is a challenge. They do a poor job of getting you where you need to go without having to drive around the block if you make a mistake. The front entrance lot and drive-up should connect to the back lot. This wouldn't be hard to achieve with minor pavement improvements and a new boom gate.
I didn't stay overnight, so I'm not familiar with facilities, but it seems nice.

name: Zaid Hopkins
text: Great hotel,  lovely rooms

name: David Sender
text:
Room looks like a needs renovation
Other than that the customer service is awesome

resp.text: Hi David! Thanks for your review. I am glad you enjoyed our customer service! I am surprised to hear you felt the room needed a renovation, as we just completed a total renovation of all our rooms 7 months ago. The renovation was a total gut - not just an update on paint/carpet/artwork. If I can ever assist please feel free to contact me directly at jw.engblom@sheratondallasnorth.com thanks again!

name: Jose Gracia
text: Was in town for a work conference, place was clean , staff was professional and good and fast room service

name: M Staton
text:
Nice, close to Galleria and many restaurants. Staffs are very nice.
Some of guests were very noisy in late night and early morning at hallway.

resp.text: We are glad you enjoyed your stay.  Sorry about the noise from guests going to their rooms.  We look forward to having you back.

name: Lesa Salih
text: Large updated rooms and bathrooms. You will love the lighted mirrors and glass showers. Fantastic linens and comfy beds. Nice large screen tvs. The rooms are always quiet. The housekeeping staff is great! But the desk staff can be absolutely unhelpful and beyond rude. If you can avoid interaction with the desk staff during your stay, then you will enjoy staying here. Also parking is strange here. It is gated from the front but the back gate is always up. There are no restuarants within walking distance. And the Galleria is about 3-4 blocks away. The shuttle has to have prior arrangements made with exact times and days. It only goes 2 miles. But Uber is great in this area.

name: Luis Lebron
text: The place was nicely decorated and spacious. Most of the hotel staff was wonderful except the door man. He was very rude and did not know how to talk to people. I may want to spend a night or more with my wife, but may not do so because I do not want to speak to this person. I hope the hotel will train its staff how to talk to people no matter how they dress or look.

name: ashton barratt
text: The hotel is a little old, but the price was unbeatable for the quality. The breakfast buffet was superb, you must try their house made salsa on the eggs! The parking lot has a pointless gate with a permanently open exit. The elevators were under renovation during my stay so they were a pain but it was understandable. I would most definitely stay here again.

resp.text:
Hi Ashton!

Thanks for taking the time to leave a review. I am glad to hear you enjoyed your stay with us. Isn't the Salsa AMAZING?! Our eggs with Salsa is my favorite breakfast buffet item:) 1 of our elevators are down for modernization, the start of a million dollar modernization program that should conclude before the end of the year! Our room refresh will begin next month. We have been experiencing some difficulty with our parking gates, the exit gate you are referencing was impacted by a vehicle, and parts are on order. We do normally leave our exit gate open at peak departure times to expedite guests exit, as parking charges are applied directly to your room, not via the exit gate. I welcome you to return once our first set of rooms are complete in late October. Please feel free to email me directly to arrange a special rate.

Cheers,

J.W. Engblom
Director of Sales & Marketing
jw.engblom@sheratondallasnorth.com

name: Matthew Myers
text: Nice and Efficient very diverse and the hospitality was thru the roof.Very impressed and I highly recommend this wonderful place.

name: A J
text: Never stayed in this hotel but came for a church conference and I was suprised to hear the front desk say they dont serve 24hours coffee. They charge customers after noon time. My family and I had stayed in many hotels but never seen any hotels like Sheraton. They dont provide water or coffee. But have to pay for all drinks.

resp.text: Hello Ann- we in fact do offer complimentary coffee in-room along with bottled water. We feature a full-service restaurant and do charge as such for all drinks. I hope you enjoyed your conference.

name: juan borjas
text: Great rooms great service

name: Jefferson
text: Nice place

resp.text: Thank you for sharing this valued feedback.  Happy you enjoyed your stay and hope to see you again soon.

name: Kita Johnson
text: Loved the hotel. Clean and nice staff

name: J Johnston
text: Clean and updated...liked this hotel for the price....just a short walk to gallaria..

name: Stq MediaGroup1
text: Very nice rooms and the service was great

name: Barbara Silvas
text: The room was very nice. The pool area was very nice also. The restaurant was good and not high priced. The front desk staff was really friendly and helpful.

name: Randall Joy
text: Fine visit. Wasn't a guest of the hotel so i can't give it a full review.

name: Canji Williams Rhodes
text: Nice stay. Great amenities.

name: Mark Nimo
text: Very standard type of hotel. I was here for a corporate meeting. I was not greeted by anyone from the staff. I had to find hall my company was meeting in in my own. was not very hard to navigate. But would have been preferred to be asked. The hotel was very clean.

name: Dry Rub Smoker
text: Nicely remodeled. Clean. Comfortable.

name: B W
text: Warning : Anytime the front desk tells you that they are putting you on a quiet floor away from the elevator, they are lying. The beds felt like Stone. The only positive : location

name: Jim Bugbee
text: Great stay. Cool hotel.

name: Karthick S S
text: High class hotel. Good for business meetings.

name: Rob Higareda
text: Nice rooms and good bar.

name: lawrence king
text: It was great

name: cowswithguns
text: Beds are comfortable. Staff is friendly.

name: David Studinski
text: Lobby will mislead you as to the status of renovations here. Rooms are decently sized, although our bathroom was tiny. Club lounge leaves much to be desired, but is good for a quick happy hour stop.

name: legion cold
text: Very nice management..very elagant environment

name: Emori Elise Grace Faith
text: With Jackie had s blast super nice place

name: Adam Dickerson
text: Great place to stay very clean and friendly staff

resp.text: Thanks Adam! Glad to hear you enjoyed your stay and we look forward to welcoming you back soon:)

name: Tika Bell
text: Very nice hotel. Service was professional. Bed and pillows were phenomenal!

name: todd malone
text: Very nice friendly staff. Bed was comfortable and my back did not hurt the next morning

name: Jose Maldonado
text: Enjoyed my stay. Room was nice. The location was good and they have shuttle service for 3 mile radius that can take you to galleria mall. Only one down side was that there wasn't any covered parking.

name: Tracy Houston
text: Very nice room. Terrible restaurant. Food was not very good but high priced.

name: Jonathan Lorber
text: It's okay, but there is constant noise from the highway, which makes it's very fatiguing to stay at this hotel.

name: joshua estes
text: No microwave, rude staff, refrigerator was a 1.5 x 1.5 box that barely kept anything cold. Staff was rude and seemed upset that we were there. Especially the old heavy-set man that was sitting at the entrance. If it werent for the cleanliness and decor, I would've rated the hotel 1 star. I have had 50 dollar MOTELS that have had bigger refridgerators AND had in-room microwaves. Staff sucked, customer attention sucked.

name: Charles Gragg
text: Comfy beds, clean room, big TV!

name: Courtney Bailey
text: Beautiful hotel beautiful room and beautiful staff . Gave me absolutely no trouble and misty is Fantastic. I will be staying again

name: Carlos Jimenez
text: This is a good place to stay. Once they complete their renovations it's going to be way better.

name: Julian Carrera
text: Very friendly people at the desk to help out. I love the room. Very spacious and comdortable bed. I definitely recommend this place.

name: Mario Ortiz
text: Very nice rooms from top to bottom. Kids enjoyed it

name: Richard Morris
text:
Restaurant was pretty good, ordered ribeye steak, was cooked perfectly.
Downside, they kept charging my credit card for "expected incidental expenses".. I ended up paying double due to unknown charges, fees, and whatever else.. Don't know that I'd choose Sheraton, again.

name: Fidel Maldonado
text: Nice hotel, very clean, good prices at the bar/restaurant.  In my opinion,  the rooms were a little small,  we got a 2 queen bed for my 2 daughters, one which is in a wheelchair, my wife and myself. Beds are real comfy

name: Rachel Turner
text: Just recently renovated. Beautiful property, and great staff!

name: M Spicyeyes Navarro
text: The faucet bathroom water smell like sewer. The entire Hotel did not look well kept at all. All the room smell like cigarettes, as I had to ask them to relocate us to another room  because the initial room smell like cigarettes  big time.  Along with that...the hotel concierge Alice was not very friendly at all. However one gentleman from Ohio I cannot recall his name was a very friendly man. He was the only perk to our trip there. We ended our stay at the hotel a day early because my daughter and I got sick from the faucet water. If you have a choice in choosing a hotel I recommend you find another hotel.

name: Bjoern B
text: Very nice hotel. Looks incredible inside. Staff is friendly. They do charge for parking but there's a road that goes along side the hotel, just outside the parking lot that a lot of people will park for free.

name: Christopher Hartke
text: Hotel is nice in in a good location. Unfortunately it is under construction currently and a little Dusty. Also, the pool was too cold to use in the evening.

name: Shannon Hall
text: Wonderful service. Would stay again.

name: Emma Butler
text: Great hotel and very comfortable

name: Bobby Joe
text: This place was overpriced for snotty service. The parking situation is terrible. The rooms were okay not the best but not the worst and some of the food in the restaurants we're not that great.

name: Trey Cox
text: Really nice rooms and comfy beds.  Not sure why it is rated 3.5 stars on all of the hotel sites, it should probably be 4 stars.  Compared to other comparable hotels, $10 for parking seems pretty good.  Complimentary breakfast was very good as well, some of the best free food I've had outside of grandparents' house for Christmas.

name: Rewa Franklin
text: Had our family reunion here, it was nice. I loved it!

name: Jim Long
text: Completely remodeled and clean. I really like the new upgrades they made, even the wireless internet is faster. The new SPG lounge is also nice.

name: Shawn G
text: Really friendly staff. Hotel is decent. Slightly older but that isn't there fault. Biggest complaint was there was never anything in the Club Lounge. No hors d'oeuvre in the evening, breakfast in the morning, or snacks during the day. They had a handful of can beverages and milk.

name: Shaq Dino
text: Honestly only knocking a star due to its distance to downtown dallas and the lack of late-night eateries in the area. I had to walk to Wendy's about a mile away due to the fact that the shuttle stops running at 10 pm. Other than that the hotel is clean , the staff are welcoming and caring and the bar is nice.

name: Adams Miller
text:
Really, the best hotel I've been in for the price! Great breakfast, quiet, clean room and nice, cool room. We enjoyed the small pool and it's a very short walk to the Galleria.

I bought my ticket on Kayak. I couldn't decide weather to give this hotel a 3 or 4 star review. The hotel it's self is nice it's new and clean.  but the down side is that they are located in not the best area  to go out and walk around.  There is a free shuttle that will take you anywhere within 3 miles of the hotel.  But I waited 35 minutes for that Damm shuttle to take me 5 minutes down the street to the mall.  And the worst part is that the shuttle was there at the hotel the whole time! The girl at the front desk was rude and made me feel like it was a terrible inconvenience to drop us off.  Bad customer service

name: Darrien Grays
text: Came to deliver a package....restricted with the renovations they were doing but I can see the potential of where they are going. nice hotel!

name: richard d
text: The hotel has been renovated. The elevators were running slow probably because one of the three elevators was broken. Gym was nice with new machines and rooms were clean. The location was central for our needs. There was plenty of parking.

name: Michelle Ierardi
text: Lovely hotel. Friendly, welcoming staff, beds couldn't be more comfortable, Netflix is built in to their tv so I was able to login to my account at no extra charge. Immaculate. Bar is cheerful with good food and service.

name: Michele Purkett
text: This was a Groupon deal so they must have given us a Groupon room the air conditioner banged loudly like a freight train coming through! It was clean though and the staff were excellent!

resp.text: Sorry for your loud ac! We do not have “Groupon” rooms and are in the process of replacing the rest of our older PTACs in the next few months. Please let us know if your plans have you returning to our area so we can pre-block you in a room with a new AC unit! Thank you for your feedback and we look forward to seeing you soon.

name: Breion Barnes
text: Rooms are decent sadly there is no microwave in the room hardly any channels to watch on tv. Not to many places deliver to this hotel. Comfortable bed but will not stay again

name: Blake Pfohl
text: Although this hotel has a nice property it lacks in staff manners. the front desk man at night time is an overweight rude man he was very rude to my lady who being a SPG Platinum member I feel deserves upmost respect. rooms are clean you can get the rest that you need just avoid the front desk man at night time.

name: Matthew Gantz
text: Of the hotels in this area, I would not recommend staying here unless you have to. The rooms are fine - they are clean. But everything here is outdated...feels like you're in a hotel from the '90s. The saving grace here is their very good breakfast buffet.

name: Monica Ghosh
text: Staff is nice, rooms are neat and clean... Only one suggestion, is to fix the elevator situation. They shake while moving up and down, and make loud noise. Other than that, all is good!

name: Darron Powell
text: Never happy here with my stay or with conferences. Very pricey for what you get, and worn...

resp.text: Sorry to hear- we recently underwent a multi-million dollar renovation and have by far the most current product in the Galleria area. Not sure what conferences you are referring to, as we haven’t had any repeated conferences in some time. Happy to assist if you wish to discuss further offline- please email me at jw.engblom@sheratondallasnorth.com. Thank you and Happy Thanksgiving!

name: Chris Bartels
text:
The hotel and rooms are decent enough.. The bathrooms need to be renovated and the showers need to be adjusted for people over 5ft.

Also adding sockets close to the night stand to charge cellphones is a must.

name: unicorn fam unicorn
text: Great service overall ..very clean rooms

name: Max De La Garza
text: Comfortable room, nicely appointed.  Room was close to the elevators but I didn't have any trouble sleeping.  Construction vehicles made parking a challenge but that's a minor annoyance.

name: David Sinagub
text: Clean hotel and friendly staff. Overall a good visit. Restaurant and bar took forever for food but it was tasty.

name: Rafael Rubio
text: Hotel is being renovated, rooms are modern, nice and clean. The temporary club lounge is poorly maintained. Breakfast buffet is OK. Conveniently located by the galleria, offers complimentary shuttle service.

name: Corey Walsh
text: Very courteous staff.  Plenty of space in the room.  I would definitely stay here again.

name: elp tejas
text: I enjoyed my stay at the Sheraton and would recommend it to anyone who's visiting Dallas.

name: Toni Smith
text: The bar was ok Food was really good though. Just wished they had at least a couple regular tables to eat at. They were all bar tables.. High.  The suite was very large and very nice.

name: Roseanna Long
text: Artist was great he can paint with both hands

name: Keith Richardson
text: Only a loud A.C. unit in the room kept this from being five stars. It was an overall superb stay! We will be back!

name: Nolan Hamilton
text: Lounge was great, rooms are spacious, and gym has plenty of equipment.

name: Koln Wright
text: I enjoyed my experience at the Sheraton hotel, the room was very nice and staff was friendly. Great location at a reasonable cost.

name: Rick Van Leuven
text: Very comfortable bed, extremely clean and convenient location.

name: Joseph Duran
text:
Sheraton Dallas hotel by the Galleria is a nice hotel... I got a deal through priceline for my one night stay. Have a decent fitness center too
The beds are comfortable... So comfortable I told them I'm taking a pillow haha
Would stay there again if I had to... But I prefer a place with free breakfast like La Quinta.

name: Michael Dinaw
text: Very clean rooms, comfortable beds. The only con, if at all, the bathroom is a bit small and it's sliding door doesn't lock.

name: nunya stockson
text:
Its clean as one would expect of any hotel. But despite the free wifi claim it is 13 a day. That and there is no microwave or refrigerator. This is a joke. I expect significantly more from a establishment in this price range. Days inn for me next time.
After writing this i went to the pool to look. And it was pathetic. 20 feet long. Most of it was 1 foot deep. And the deep end was 4 feet. That was as deep as the pool went. And it was ice cold. I expect more from an upscale place.

name: Lonnie Meaders
text: Friendly staff, nice bar.  The floor I stayed on needed to be updated.  No A/C in the hallway.   In SDH's defense I did request a budget room.

name: Rick Singh
text: Nice hotel, good gym for a hotel, a nice entrance and very comfortable rooms. Limited menu at the restaurant

resp.text: Hi Rick- we really appreciate you staying with us and look forward to having you back!

name: Michal Welc
text: Undergoing significant remodeling right now (Dec 2017). Whole floors are out of commission. The rooms that are already done look nice and modern.

name: Beatrice Aviles
text: Rooms are nice clean. I enjoy my stay here. Will be back when am back in Dallas for business.

name: Sam Miguel
text: If you are looking for a good and affordable location for conference, meeting or seminars then Sheraton Dallas would be good choice

name: Brandon Sealy
text: Beautiful design in and out. Wasn't there long. Very nice staff though.

name: Ron Dagdag
text: Clean rooms, pillows are soft but not for me.

name: Patrick Gilmore
text: Clean rooms. Nice hotel. Customer service could be a bit better.

name: alesa simon
text: This hotel is currently under much needed construction. It is dusty and an allergy nightmare. The elevators are broke and there are strong fumes through out the building causing headaches. The electricity goes on and off causing the internet to crash. My shower on the 14th floor had a clogged drain and water would over flow all over the room into the hallway. I requested to to be fixed 2x in 1 week time span. No one fixed it. The lock on the door was broken and they frequently turned off the water for 4 to 5 hour time spans. I was on a 2 week stay with a business group. They didn't even provide podiums in the rooms for a business training session for public speakers. This hotel experience will definitely discourage my company and me personally from staying at Sheraton Hotels/Resorts in my frequent travels.

name: Renay Land
text: One of the best places i ever stayed at. Will be back

name: Royal M A y A
text: Good deal hotel!

name: Nick Moore
text: One of the best places in Dallas to stay. Exceptional service at check-in, in room service, and at their restaurant, which is amazing by the way. Amazing rates on rooms and it's in a great location.

name: Luis Enrique Barrios Castillo
text:
Clean restrooms. Confortable beds with individual A/C in every room including the SmartTv that gives you channels from Cable and offers you Netflix (This service must be used with your own Netflix account).

Nice pool, breakfast and crew for a generous price and area NEAR FROM GALLERIAS MALL.

resp.text: Hi Luis!  Thank you so much for the review.  I hope you make it back our way soon!

name: Charles Noble IV
text: Decent event space

name: Aaron Garcia
text: Good rooms. Staff was very friendly and helpful. Would stay again.

name: Thomas Buccelli
text: Enjoyed the stay. Beds were comfortable and rooms were clean. Only minor issue is that water pressure for shower was a little light.

name: Mark Jarman
text: Our stay was very nice. The staff was very friendly and helpful even though they were currently doing renovations.

name: JC zelaya
text: Nasty

resp.text: Hi JC! I’m sorry to hear you are in some way dissatisfied with our property!

name: John Xu
text:
The Sheraton Dallas Hotel by the Galleria is located in in North Dallas, close to a moderate amount of shopping and businesses. The hotel itself is fairly hard to get to, and there are gates to get into the parking lot which is always a pain and causes confusion for most rideshare drivers.

Once inside the hotel, the lobby is well decorated and appointed with a fully stocked bar. I didn't get a drink during this trip, but seemed that there were a decent amount of people milling around. The front desk staff was average, not able to really do much besides hand me a room key. Once I started walking towards the guest rooms did everything go downhill.

The hallways look dark and decrepit, with no A/C which causes them to be stifling hot. The elevators are slow and old, so even going up and down 10 floors is a pain. I got a standard king room, which definitely shows its age, there is no energy or real life in them. The bathroom was of adequate size, nothing special. Wi-fi did work, so that is a plus there. The club lounge was one of the emptiest and saddest ones I've ever seen, so don't come with high expectations.

With no name. I say to her " there is no name on this front or back she snatches it from me and writes her name on it. 3 hours later and no pool to swim in cause it was not a heated pool Rachel offers me free breakfast well club level reservation comes with that already . offered me a flat bread Pizza I denied that aswell  . She was very rude and very unprofessional.  Offering me what already came with my room was just not acceptable!  At this time every employee was surrounding her now due to the high voices between Rachel and i. She could have resolved this issue in a better manner then just telling me " She felt not needed to heat the pool today!"   I was offered free parking when if you park in front of this hotel it's free!  I didn't park in the gated parking.  All this cause of FALSE information on the website to get you to stay with this location.  Bathrooms were disgusting , went to look at pool felt how cold the water was and was not useable was dirty and looked like no one had cleaned it all year, room was hot and over all hated the customer service!
We will never give a red cent to Sheraton or any sister properties!

text:
Came in on a late Sunday night and they were opened until 11pm, such a plus. My boyfriend lives near this restaurant and never heard of it. Thank goodness for Yelp.

We walked in and were greeted. We didn’t know what we want. We were stuck between a gyro boss and a buffalo chicken. We ended up splitting it down the middle.
It was cool to read the signs that were around while waiting. Different facts about pizza!

When the pizza came, I was excited. I tried the gyro side first. It was really good. I wish that I had taziki sauce with it for dipping then it would have been peeeerfect. I then tried the buffalo chicken side. Man, I loved it. My boyfriend and I were describing that the american cheese maaaade that pizza. It was so good.

Will def be back for some late night munchies if needed.

name: Usman Hasib
text:
Welcome to Sugar Land, Pizza 101. We've been in desperate need for halal pizza in probably one of the most dense areas of halal eaters in Houston.
I stopped by there today during their soft opening. I ordered half buffalo chicken/half meat overload. The entire menu looks great.
The restaurant looks very professional. Their branding and setup is on par with any major pizza franchise. They have online ordering and delivery. I was really impressed. The owner was very friendly and made my pizza promptly while I waited. They ran it through the oven twice to make it well done, the way I like it
The pizza was delicious! Very different than other halal pizza places in Houston. This has a thicker pan crust, similar to Pizza Hut. All the ingredients tasted very fresh. Thin crust is also an option.
I wish Pizza 101 the best of luck in Sugar Land! I will be visiting again soon. There sign isn't up yet but it's next to Marble Slab on Williams Trace and 59.

text:
Couple of my friends highly recommend this place so I came for a test and I was totally satisfied!

Place is clean and simple, better than most of the pizza place.

We ordered their garlic chicken wings, man this is one of the most unique wings I have had. First of all, the wings are huge! Very meat and super marinated. Might be bit salty without anything else, but after my pizza I come back to the wings it's perfect, this is have to have for this place.

We ordered medium size pizza thick crust with half gyro boss and half chicken tiko. The gyro remind of going to eat in a Greek Restaraunt. Love the bread, texture is perfect. My friend said it must be really good coz I ignored how hot it was. Lol.

They have a glass bottle Fanta in a long skinny bottle, loved it.

When we were there there's only couple table dining in, love that it's not noisy at all. Gave me a chance to have a nice quiet lunch to chat with my friend.

Very enjoyable meal I had there, highly recommend it!

name: Nbetzy Guzman
text: I have been a customer since 2018 and this place just get better and better. Happy Lamb is my one place to go for a cold and rainy day. My kids enjoy the fried chicken and egg noodles. They provide an Ice cream machine. And you can serve your own drinks. If you are a spice person but your family it’s not I highly recommend you try the Mix which comes with one side spicy and the other one regular. I love the fresh seafood and meat. Restaurant is always clean and so the restrooms .

name: Abby IW
text: Great variety of food! Everything is fresh and very delicious! We come here every two weeks. Service is great and the environment is enjoyable. Modern looking inside out. Restrooms are always clean.

name: Alisa Mac
text: We loved this place. The service was outstanding, our server was very knowledgeable, helpful and timely, probably the best we’ve had in a while. The food was extremely delicious. We absolutely did that happy food dance and smiled with each bite/sip. I recommend getting the cabbage and spicy bone broth combo instead of the suggested original combo. That cabbage broth is insanely good! Ask for the extra base to maximize the flavor of the cabbage soup. We left the place super-duper happy and will be back again soon!

name: wayne sprinkles
text: Great experience overall... the staff was very friendly and explained the whole process from choosing broth to cooking times and meat selections.. definitely a good splurge dinner as it is fairly pricey,  but I would go again.

name: Relii Cabrales
text: Ever since my sister introduced me to this place I have not stopped going and introducing everyone to this place! It is AMAZING. The servers are absolutely attentive and helpful, the have your table clean at all times, the make sure your soup is hot and full of broth. The food selection is amazing for your hot pot. The taste is amazing! I cannot express how full of flavors the hot pot is! The meats are delicious and just everything is so fresh. The place is clean and sanitary and it is very nice. I will forever come here!

name: Strong Song
text:
This place was a ton of fun and had entirely vegan options; good ones too. For broth the vegan options doesn't show up on the menu but as it turns out, they can make most of their broths vegan. In the broth, there's a whole buffet of veggie options, several types of tofu, and ask kinda of noodles.

Bathrooms were super clean and comfortable to be in. You can tell that the staff cares about this place.

The only complaint I had came with the bill. First of all, going with a vegan options should probably not cost the same as going with the meat based option but instead should be it's own standalone price as it frees the staff from having to keep continuously bringing raw meat to the table. So, already, the 24.95 seemed pricey, but certainly worth it; everything was delicious. The problem was that gratuity was automatically factored in and brought the bill to 31 per person; still no problem with that. The problem is that after already factoring in the tip they asked for another tip on the bottom of the menu and there's never any mention of the fact that they already added gratuity. This was annoying because it felt slightly underhanded. Like they were hoping I wouldn't noticed they already tipped.

Overall would go again. Great food.

name: richard sierra
text: Amazing place to try asian cuisine. Highly recommended for a good experience in cooking your own food at table. It was very clean and follow all covid precautions. Amazing employees who are willing to answer  your questions

name: Gary Westmoreland
text: Love it!!! Nice atmosphere, happy and very friendly staff.  Worth every bit of what you spend

name: tonya sprinkles
text: This place was an amazing experience.  The food was delicious.

name: Ann La
text:
Come starving and get their all-you-can-eat option because it's worth it over picking individual items. The price is good for $21.99 on weekends and dinner. You can pick non-spicy, spicy broth, or do half-half. Go for the spicy broth for a lot more flavors. Just avoid eating the peppers in the broth. The broth is chicken-based. You can also request for vegetarian broth.

The AYCE has 3 rounds. You will be given a menu sheet. Select your meat, veggies, seafood, noodles, cold dishes, and sauces. Pick your quantity for each option. Go for at least 2 because each portion is a bit small with the exception of meat and seafood.

name: Mark Nabb
text: So much food. We can't ever finish it all. Very good. The seafood bar is always fresh and fresh veggies too.

name: Tommy Pham
text: This I place is arguable one of the best Hot Pot places I have been to ever since it’s remodeling. Can’t stop from coming back here. The place was under another name 2 years back and since it’s re-opening I have came back more times than I can count. The seasoning of the soups are great and I love the way that we get our own food side dishes buffet style. It makes it way more fun and enjoyable than waiting for someone and ordering from a menu. Good selection, nothing more I can ask for

name: Jayson Kendall
text: I really liked this place. They had all the add ons for whatever hot pot person you are. Very clean and the staff were amazing. I'm coming back soon!

name: Susan L
text: Formerly known as Little Sheep but restaurant got a new makeover. We went on Sat lunch. Very clean and friendly attentive service. This is an all you can eat buffet and drinks (no alcohol) similar to fondue but Chinese style. We got half and half, one side is the 7 star spicy beef tallow (very spicy, not recommended for the faint of heart) and the other half is the mild beef marrow soup. We chose the premium meat options  because the quality of meat is better. You can choose other types of meat but would not recommend. We love the flavor of the soup but a tad salty at the end of the meal time when we took a sip of the soup. We ordered mainly meat which you can tell your waiter so they bring out thin slices of meat upon request when you want more. Reason why? To get your money's worth. Also try to eat some veggies to balance the meal. Get ready to spend about 2 hours to cook your meal and leave satisfy.

name: Jason Mouton
text: Awesome hot pot experience!   Everything was fresh and tasty.  Its all you can eat for  $24-30 person and worth it.  Great for a family brunch.  Recommended and I will return.

name: Joshua Johnson
text: Our first time was phenomenal.  Very welcoming staff and the guide you through the everthing. The food speaks for itself... clean, fresh, and beyond delish!  Treat yourself to some of the best Saki ever

text:
t has been a while but when we were here we really had a wonderful experience, all the food was great, and since this was our first time here the employees helped us along the way making some of the decisions of the type soups that are used for the cooking of our food
I know my family and I had a great time and for those that have never tried this you really need to, I know we will be back
Thanks

text: First time trying hot pot, Happy Lamb did not disappoint. Loved being able to customize all parts of my meal and service was amazing! Would definitely eat here again.

text: The service was great and prompt, 5/5! The waiters would come fast to take the order when seeing we were done with one meat plate just as fast when changing dirty or empty plates. The food was OK, 4/5. There were some buffet choices on the side such as different types of noodles, veggies, and seafood. The meat choices were ok, plus different types of lamb, though you don’t really see the much difference when tasting between meats, which is weird. Not the best, but still a very decent place!

text: Great dine in experience! Clean and good food! Customer service is ok

name: N A
text:
Awesome Restaurant! Everything is very clean. You have to wear a mask. Especially at the buffet area. They provide disposable gloves to use at the buffet and you must change them each time you go to get anything.....
You pay about $25 per person, a little more if you want premium meats (like wagu beef). The server brings you the meats of your choice to cook in a broth. They also have a buffet with raw seafood. Fish fillets, shrimp, mussels. And other foods like dumplings, steamed rice and lots of veggies. Everything is unlimited. Drinks are included in the price. Great experience. Will definitely visit again.

text: First time having hot pot, and WOW. It was great! Besides the meat they bring to you to cook, there's a whole bar of raw items to cook, and several hot items on a separate bar as well.

text: First time coming here was really impressed by the selection of fresh seafood and vegetables they had. They give you a big quantity of meats. The broth is really tasty all the items on the self serve looked so fresh. The service was really good. Will be coming back here for sure. Highly recommend.

text: This place is great. Everything is served fresh and turns out delicious. My husband however, thinks it’s crazy to pay to cook your own food. I thought it was fun!  Just plan to be there more than an hour and don’t come starving as you’ll have to cook your food at your table.

text: The soup/broth was very good! We got the half spicy and half regular with fish, Angus beef and chicken breast. Our waiter was nice and attentive. I would definitely recommend this place for hotpot!

text: OHMAGOSH! I loved this place... I went there for my birthday on the 1/27 with my fiancé for the first time and they were so very kind and welcoming to us even though we knew nothing about how to do the hot pot the lady at the register stood there and explained it all to us very patiently then took us to the table an helped us again with ordering our meats🥰 this was the best experience we have ever had  and the prices for the all you can eat are just great! I highly recommend them I am a food/restaurant blogger so this was just spectacular 👌 an im not shy about giving reviews 😅 so go and see them and fill up you stomachs 🤤🍽🦑🦪🍜🍥🥮🦀🤤

text: It’s an amazing place to have Hotpot. Really good staff and service. I keep coming back to this whenever i can. We used to go to their California Mountain View restaurant. And this one is equally good and may be more cosy and friendly :)

text: Hot pot was good. Very good service as well

name: Van N
text:
Updated Review: We went back after the renovations and rebranding, and the flavors were still good.  However now that they are mainly self serve, many of the options that they had before for AYCE such as the homemade dumplings and meatballs are no longer available.  The variety of vegetables and seafood definitely is limited as compared to what it was before.  Also I'm really not a fan of paying that much for an AYCE and still having to get most of the things for yourself. The service though was still nice and friendly.
******

One of the better hot pot places in Houston.  The food and service are great.  I love the spices and flavors of their hot pot, and if the hot & spicy broth isn't spicy enough, you can ask them to make it spicier.

name: John Smith
text: Everything here is fresh and packed with tons of flavor! The service here is also very good. I'll be going to this one often.

name: Mobro
text: Wow!! First time Hotpot!. It's a buffet at a very reasonable price. The staff was so nice and accommodating.  Leslie whipped up a delicious dipping sauce and made great suggestions knowing it was our first time. She made the experience very pleasant and the food was just so good and exciting.  Will be back for sure and I recommend y'all try it!

name: Daniel Ngo
text: Every time I come here, I like the food a bit more! For starters, I personally don't like getting just the spicy broth because the Szechuan peppercorn kind of overpowers all of the flavors of the different meats so that everything starts to taste the same. On my last visit, I got the split pot of half spicy and half plain broth and I think that was the best because it allowed for a variety of flavors throughout my meal. The menu has a large selection of meats, seafood, vegetables, noodles, and more making it easy for everyone to find something that they like. One issue I had was that the service was not good the last time I came. They sat five of us at a table for ten in the back, and when we asked for two pots of broth (since the table was way too big for us to only use one) our hostess said that that was impossible. When we asked our waiter he was more than happy to give us two, stating it was no problem at all, which redeemed this interaction a little bit. The real issue came during the meal, where our table and the other large table next to us were largely ignored by the waiters because we were so far in the back and they just didn't really come by. It made it very difficult to order. It was not a problem on previous visits though, so it may just have been a bad day or bad seating.

name: Jordan C.
text: Terrible service. Went there with a large group (10 people) and they took our order and never saw them after the food was delivered. Since we had a large group tip was automatically included on bill. Would not recommend taking large groups.

name: Alex Bruce
text: Love this place. The service is always great and you definitely get what you pay for.

name: Jason Ackerman
text: Service was excellent. Food was fresh and plentiful. Took covid seriously and spaced people out well. Hand sanitizer was readily available.

text: Quality. Good service. Great broth

name: Carolina Batalla
text:
I would give this place 3.5 stars. I feel like there’s not much variety compared to other all you can eat hot pot restaurants I’ve been to be honest. The sauces were a bit bland and the spicy hot pot was bland but the original one was pretty tasty! Ambience was nice if it weren’t for all the dirty dishes in all tables that leave but it was okay. Would I come here again? Probably not, but worth checking out.

EDIT:

They have really upped their game. I honestly now prefer their soup over other restaurants. The ladies in the evening always take good care of us. There is a guy in the morning who really has a nasty attitude so if you’re trying to go for lunch try avoiding that guy.

name: Rebecca Wei
text:
We considered getting their unlimited meal but decided that it would probably be cheaper to get their combo plates and then add on meat if we wanted. The unlimited meal is probably better for those who really just want lots of meat. We were a little afraid of not having enough because you just never know from menu pictures how it'll turn out in reality, but we had a good variety, and definitely had enough. For 9 people we ended up with 6 combo plates, several additional plates of fish balls (the roe fish balls omg drool) and a few but not a ton of other random things (extra meat, mushrooms).

Would recommend: the beef combos, don't remember which one it was but all yummy. The roe fish balls, the fuzhou fish balls, pumpkin!

name: Gammie Le
text: By far, one of my favorite place for hot pot. Especially if you do the ALL YOU CAN EAT. For $21.99. Totally worth it considering if you order a la cart, it would be well over that amount anyway. Food always comes out fast and super fresh. I love the veggie variety. I usually order the half & half broth. One side would be spicy and the other just the basic bone broth but it’s packed with so much flavor. It’s perfect for a cold winter day!

text: Everything is dandy but I wish there were better sweets lol

I have to admit it was worth it!
Great and prompt service.
This hit the spot. It was a great choice.

text: Outstanding quality and a wonderful place to take family or friends. Very kind employees.

name: Ella Anderson
text: A great place to eat hotpot. I’ve gone here plenty of times with my friends and they have all enjoyed it as well. The service and food was delicious.

name: Natasha Kayotkina
text:
I came here with two other people and we got the half and half hot pot.

The flavor of both broths was pretty good. The new self service was quite nice since you can always go grab whatever you need without having to wait for a waiter.

The new remodeled look is edgy and quite refreshing. This place is perfect for a chilly night in Houston. Staff is friendly but it does that a long time to get broth refills. Ice cream machine and small desserts are a nice touch for the meal.

It was way too cold inside even when eating hot pot. Bathrooms were clean. Very good for groups.

text: Food was amazing I got half &half broth, but I definitely like the spicy broth much better, nice clean place, big portion of food for the price , great experience overall

Unfortunately it did take a while for our food to come out and there were waaaaay too many chillies in the pot, it was an overkill. Customer service is just okay, not too polite. A bit overpriced but I'm great ful for the experience.

text: The hot pot with Chinese characteristics is very characteristic and worth recommending.People who like to eat spicy food can go to taste it.

name: Eric Cosby

text: HotPot was very good and service was good. Definitely come hungry for the all you can eat because it is worth it!

name: Catsur na
text: Never had hot pot before, went here to try it. We had a menu that explained the cooking times for various foods, but it was taken away as soon as we had ordered. Also, we didn't get any suggestions or other explanations from our waiter, despite being obviously confused about how to order. So we ordered the half n half (spicy and original) along with some seasoned/marinated meats and veggies; the spicy wasn't spicy, the original was bland, and the marinated meats had no flavor. We really didn't find this fun, or a good social time, or even tasty. I really can't recommend this unless you already love hot pot, and even then I suspect it will be bland.

name: Grant Gossett
text: So good, all you can eat for 25 bucks. Wide variety of ingredients to put in yourself. Great date spot.

name: Ken Novoa
text: Excellent service, very friendly staff, friendly atmosphere, nice seating, food is HOT and delicious, I am a happy lamb and if you come here you will be too.

text: Good quality and price. We love this place. The manager/ owner is very kind to us.

name: Shaleen Cornett-Bailey
text: Omgs this place was absolutely amazing and food not disappoint. Everything was perfect from the restaurant itself, service and the food!!! The price was the best for all you get. And the selection was huge. You have to go here and try it I swear it will not disappoint

name: Cindy Nguyen
text:
The manager is the only reason I may return.

This is my 3rd time here. The first two times I came with friends we had a great experience and I was very excited to bring the family.

This time the service was terrible. The restaurant was not busy. We got seated in the most unenthusiastic expression. The workers were perpetually unattentive. We had to flag down a server for each transaction and I'm starting to wonder if they can hear, but it can't be everyone in here with a problem... once the manager arrived and started servicing us we were able to get some items rolling. We never saw the servers again.

$20/all you can eat. Value is good and food is fresh, but the service is very frustrating and Disappointing because I'm not sure I'll be able to convince my family to come back.

text: We did the half and half and liked the non-spicy broth a lot better. We didn't care for the meat too much, mainly stick with the vegetables and seafood. Good service, ok food, but pretty good deal for $20/person.
