text: Such a variety of vendors that had great selections of produce. It was a little pricey, but worth it for the farm-to-table freshness!

name: Zachary Gibson
text: Sooooo much fun. Parking is tough after 10 am but there are a few office buildings closed for the weekend you may use. Come early .... don't worry... They will cook for you there and YES! There is hot chocolate and coffee. Tons of giant fresh veggies and a few meat vendors as well. But head the signs: "children left unattended while be given expresso and candy". Cute,  local and a great excuse to get outside on a Saturday morning.

text: First time to this Flea Mrkt. It has a good selection of organic produce ,four booth right  from entrance. Organic Meats , pimento cheese to your right , plus Lavander products, from Lavande farms , natural lotions and bath products, smell so good.  Back they have great food to eat. Almost to the exit  Artisan Bread is delicious, french style , go early to shop. Also Texas Hill Country Olive Oil and Balsamic Vinegar, Extra Virgin and my favorite Fig Balsamic vinegar. The market is open from 8 am to 12 pm . Enjoy the trip!!!

text:
I will keep coming to this place for the falafel breakfast with one farm fresh egg from now til kingdom come. So good. Seriously. MMM. homemade batter and all.. can't beat it.

Anyways, the rest of the market is great. Some new vendors here and there, but most of the same. The only bad thing I have to say is that one of the vendors, one time, wouldn't sell my a couple tomatoes ?! They wan't me to buy the basket of ten. I still don't get why you'd turn someone away because they didn't want to waste your product?

Anyways, just went on to the next farmer and he had no issues, as you'd expect. Everything i've gotten from the market are fresh and the vendors are always willing to talk with you and take custom orders.

If you want something specific, like eggs, go early before they sell out. Otherwise, I'm super happy to have this as my neighborhood market. Thanks!

text:
The King of affordable dim sum with great quality!
Been a fan of their consistency and food quality. I always order enough for a tribe! The shrimp dumpling (M03) are delicious. The turnip cakes (S10) are so good. I appreciate their customer service and ordering via phone is easy. So delicious!

name: D. Osorto
text: Food was delicious. Quick service.. There was no wait. They do temp checks. They have take out.

name: L A
text: Their food and service was just alright and nothing too exciting. Interior looks very depressing, dated, and dark. What made me rate it 1 star, is that a ROACH (about 1" long) jumped on our table while we were eating.  This is totally unacceptable and would definitely NOT recommend this restaurant.

name: Mark Moreno
text: This place really hit the spot for my craving of dim sum. I really wanted a good steamed pork bun. The pork gyoza and shrimp balls were amazing. The egg rolls were crispy and fresh. I saw some other negative reviews on here and on yelp so I was apprehensive about trying this place but I’m glad we decided to give this place a shot. When I have a craving for good dim sum, I’ll be sure to be back.

name: lost.sleepy
text: Came when there wasn't anyone else in restaurant. Great food, love the taro options!

name: Daniel M
text: Tasty food and interesting things to try. Hole in the wall place. But still good food.

text: A great place for dim sum in Chinatown. Quick and friendly service.

name: Minh Huynh
text: Much better than most dim sum restaurants on Bellaire. Especially the crispy shrimp ball.

name: WAR DAWG RANCH A MISSOURI HOMESTEAD
text: Great food.....flavors are amazing....nice quiet place hidden away..... prices are good.... highly recommended.

name: Brittnee Gradney
text: Everything is amazing and doesn't taste pre-frozen. The only thing we didn't enjoy was the steamed pork dumpling but thats because we thought it was shumai. They take your temperature before your seated which is a plus for me since many restaurants don't. Very cozy and not super crowded on the weekend since its a little hidden. Gem.

name: Van N
text: Pretty good dim sum with nice and friendly service. The only con was that some of the dim sum items were skimpy on the meat stuffing.

name: Christina Grayson
text:
Pros: turnip cake, prices
Cons: very slow. 腸粉 had 5.5 pieces of shrimp total. For the whole dish. One per noodle. Also, this was the “xiao long bao” but where is the soup? Skin was thicker than a dumpling skin. This was not a xiao long bao.

name: Julie Lopez-Velarde
text: Love the foods here but the lady server seems always so mad and rude.

name: Catsur na
text: My first time eating dim sum and it was super tasty! Placing an order online was easy. They quickly called me and let me know they were out of something I had ordered, and let me make a substitution. Very friendly and professional! My only issue is that they didn't give me one of the dishes I had ordered--they didn't tell me they were out of that one, it wasn't in my take-out bag, and I was still charged for it. Didn't realize that until I got home. Despite that, it was tasty enough that I would come back for more.

name: Alexander Garza
text: An excellent spot for authentic Dim Sum delights. Our party of four was quickly seated and the server was able to recommend his top picks. Clean and fresh; each selection we chose satisfied our cravings. Price was reasonable and I can't wait to return. All the dumplings one could desire and "Dim Sum"!

name: Jessica Colmenares
text: I just ordered some food from this place and it was awful! The taste was nasty. I’m worry the shrimp is not good and now I have food poison. I think I have to wait a few hours to see. And by the way I put the food in the trash

name: Paola Howard
text: The food was yummy, the service was a bit slow for 2 apps. It seems like people always order togo? I am rating it a 3 because i think it could have been cleaner..also you can't use your card if your bill is under 15$..

name: Patrick Lee
text: It's our first time to eat here. We have looked at different dim sum restaurants in the area and decided to give this a try. There was no wait on Sunday and we were provided a table immediately. You order the dim sum by checking on the dim sum order sheet . The dim sum came fairly quickly. I guess they have the propular items ready all the times. We ordered the normal items. The taste of them are okay but the skins on the shrimp dumplings and the rice noodle rolls were very thick. The filling for the Cha Siu Bo is too little, too dry, without any oyster sauce. The service is okay just like any other Chinese restaurant.

name: Jenn Pren
text:
EDIT   10/12/19 went again and still love this place! The fried pork puff is my favorite! the spring rolls have a sweet seasoning taste but good. the lo mein is fantastic and crispy! will keep coming back to this place!!!

This really hit the spot! I visited from Austin and already want to go back and have the food again! Everything was so good, only thing I noticed, we ordered pork steam buns, only got steam buns. They were still good, but really would have loved the pork in them. Everything we had was fantastic, and would recommend to anyone who wants some good dim sum! Can't wait to go back! Loved the egg rolls, pork dumplings, there was another pork bun might have been the fried one.. But man it was good! May have over done it by ordering alot, but was able to take home and still tasted good!

name: Henry Chin
text: Due to the covid19, it’s only take out. The place is a little hard to find. The dim sum is very good.

name: leslie stessel
text: My first time here, excellent food.

name: deadlyhandsomeman
text: Dim sum is sum for dim. Eating meal time making better you feel for goodness sake.

name: Christina Dominguez
text: We went on a Sunday afternoon and we were promptly seated and served within 10 minutes of ordering. The plates were brought out by several people as the dishes were ready instead of all at once, so that was a plus considering the table was small for all the dishes we ordered. We were able to finish some small plates and made room as dishes arrived. This is our first try with dim sum so the pictures helped us decide what to get. When you arrive you'll get a paper menu on which you'll write the quantity of plates you want. We will definitely go back and try different 5 dishes.

name: Bruce Davis
text: I love this place! Order comes out hot fresh and fast direct from the kitchen. Waitress is very nice and I'm accumulating points for money off next time! I'll be going back very soon and often. It compares to dim sum I've had in top end restaurants around the world.

name: Rudi Sandoval
text: The service leaves much to be desired, but the food is fantastic. The prices are also very reasonable. Overall, great hole in the wall.

name: joan m
text: If you are craving for dim sum, this is a good place to go. Be sure to come in early since the area is small. Fast service. One can have sumptuous meal for under $50. Steam buns were a bit dry and chili oil was quite old. However, be sure to order dumplings and chicken feet. Toilet is also clean.

name: Jed Myers
text: Great selection, wait staff speak english. Pictures on menu. Love Dim Sum and this establishment didn't disappoint. 2 small children and 2 adults everyone left happy and full.  Highly recommend

name: Carla Bradley
text: Everything is delicious and reasonably priced!

name: Retired At 55 On The Flipside
text: Good hole in the wall dim sum resto.....

name: S.D. S.
text:
Obsessed with this place. Amazing dumplings with a large variety of options. The service is quick and friendly. They have a great rewards program so make sure you sign up.

A bit tricky to find at first, but once you see the glass  shop, just walk past and the door is on your right.

name: Lan Truong
text: Simple dim sum location with quick service. We ordered a la carte from a menu and then they promptly brought out our selection. Very good taro puffs. Quality for what you pay for.

name: Jimmy Pop
text: Very good dim sum. Had a lot of options to choose from and the prices were reasonable. Took the family for the first time and they liked being able to pick lots if different items to share.

name: Jessica Tran
text:
Fresh made to order dim sum and the greatest service I've experienced from a dim sum place in China town! Wow!!! Calvin, our waiter was very attentive and took care of us so well! It was extremely busy as usual for a Sunday afternoon, however Calvin was super fast getting our order and food delivered to our table, and refilled our drinks several times throughout our time there.

The selections here are very limited, though they are all very good. Super fresh and crunchy for the items that are to be crunchy, and steam rice cakes don't fall apart like most places! Can not wait to come back for their delicious dim sum!

name: Tony Nguyen
text: One of the other Dim Sum place I go for some Dim Sum. Price is fair and they good decent customer service.  I do recommend you stop by if your in the area. Its worth the checking out.

name: Chelsea Beard
text: After only eating dumplings in a couple places around Bellaire, this place was by far my favorite. I went with 5 others who wanted to kinda try it all, which by the end we had picked about 30 items.... I told them this was a lot and thankfully the staff was very nice and helped us cut down the order and also told us they could split the items so we could all try them. Also I am allergic to pork and they did a great job of telling us what items were as they came out and helped keep them separate from the non pork items. Overall a great experience and cant wait to go back!

name: La Grange Products
text: Great food

name: Gabe Bravo
text: It's hard to find a good dim sum place. I guess you dim sum, you lose some. This place, however, had dim sum and then some! I want to die

name: Ha Vu
text: In my opinion, this dim sum restaurant is the best in Houston. They got various choices and tasty. Like to come on Sunday since everything come out fast and hot; one minus point is some of my order had to wait since they are super busy on Sunday, but it's ok. Their price is reasonable compare to other places, food is fresher. Highly recommend this Dim Sum place.

name: Nick Wen
text: After all these years, still a great place to satisfy my dim sum cravings 🤤👍

name: Joel Harvie
text: The food was pretty good,  service was only okay. The staff was friendly though. I love dim sum so overall I was satisfied. This place has a pretty good variety of dim sum. They are located in a big strip mall in Chinatown. I don't know if they have carts and bring items around, but when I was there you had to order off of the menu.

name: Austin Taylor
text: Great food.

name: Bobby Guy
text: Our favorite dim sum in Houston. Super simple experience, dim sum served all day!

name: Amethyst Montoya
text: Great food. Pictures on menu! Prices very good, under $50 for 4 people! Definitely recommend

name: Ray Losoya
text: We try to visit here every 3 months. Pretty awesome food and service.

name: Giao Dang
text: Great service and good food. Also the restaurant looks much cleaner than others.

name: Krista Nix-Buckner
text: The dim sum and tea was very tasty! To be blunt, it lacked ambience. I wouldn't bring anyone I was trying to impress but it's great for friends who enjoy good food and don't mind no-frills. The menu had good photos and accurate descriptions. I'm definitely planning a trip back soon!

name: Alice
text: Delicous and affordable. I really like their fried egg noodle with beef. New go to place for Dim Sum

name: Samuel Sloane
text: Whew.  I am still reveling in an amazing lunch stop today.  If you want  some well-prepared and fresh dim sum, look no further.  Reasonable, but not cheap (who wants to east cheap food and cheap ingredients?)  I enjoyed a double order of steamed pork buns, grilled taro, steamed shrimp shumai, fried shrimp and crab balls and lotus leaf wrapped rice.  Well done.  Nice flavor and easy presentation.  The menu has pictures for the uninitiated and they have a lot of options for those who are ready to perhaps try something new.  Service was terrific and on the spot!  Will be back soonest.

name: Shawn Bates
text: The dim sum is fresh, hot, and yummy! It was my group's 2nd time here and we are already planning our third. 'Nuf said.

name: Patrick Jimenez
text: Favorite place for dim sum. Fair prices and quick service. I'd eat there everyday if I could

name: jonespalmer
text: Ive always wanted to try steam buns and fried buns. They look so delicious on anime and watching people eat them on youtube. I decided to order a few different kinds from here and they had no filling. The bbq pork buns literally had three little cubes of meat. Great disappointment

name: Anissa Diame DelaCruz
text: I'm always suprised here. It's amazing, authentic, savory Chinese food. You'll never forget it. I willingly trek across the city to enjoy every bite. 😁♥️

name: Stephanie Nguyen
text: You can't go wrong with made to order dim sum. Staff is friendlier than most Asian restaurants, the food is tasty, and it's quick! Must try!! Get the shumai, pork puffs, shrimp deep fried with noodles, and Chinese broccoli.

name: random troll
text:
I went here with my work colleagues. Great tasting food and the dim sums were really good and have wide variety of choices. So it'll fit anyone veg, non-veg and vegans.  Anyone craving  Kentonese cuisine must definitely go here.

I'll surely be visiting them again.

name: Annie Rupani
text: Our go-to place for dim sum, everything is made fresh and comes out fast. We have never been disappointed, some of our favorites include stuffed shrimp eggplant, steamed beef rice noodle, and the steam mushroom chicken bun.

name: Marco Gonzalez
text: Great food

name: Meestar Youu
text: Solid choice for anytime dim sum. Has tables for large parties and they have increased in size since I last went.. Excellent selection and food. Service is Chinatown-like.

name: Mary Beall
text:
Food was good for the first time but not great. Girls bathroom needs cleaning .
Will go again for 2nd go around

name: Michael Purnell
text: One of the best places to find Shrimp balls

name: Yifan Kong
text:
I'm reading the other reviews and am concluding that nobody who reviewed this place highly has eaten good dim sum. The food here is bland, unappetizing. So many things wrong... The beef in the porridage was old and tough, the dumplings had dry, unappetizing skins, the shrimp rice flour wrap tasted like nothing and had a tiny amount of shrimp in it. There wasn't even Chinese vinigar as a condiment on the table.

The only dish that was decent were the chicken feet.

The reviews on this place are blowing my mind.

name: J Huss
text: Came here to satisfy my chicken feet craving. The food is pretty good. I was expecting carts moving around the restaurant, but the restaurant itself is pretty small, so you order your dim sum from the menu instead. Friendly staff.

name: Jackie R
text: I guess the whole point of my review boils down to “not what I expected.” Very few chicken dishes, approximately 2, and there was a bit too much fried/doughy food on the menu. I would definitely try another place instead. You have SO many options!!

name: Asad Khan
text: Poor experience... I read such great things about this establishment... Sadly, it was a poor experience...

name: Jase Yiu
text: I’m suspecting the other reviews were written genuinely about this place. They just don’t know how to make dim sum at all! All the ingredients are not fresh and they substitute the necessary ingredients that is the same with every single dim sum place on earth with some cheaper stuff that doesn’t taste good. Everything is made with alternative way that makes the food garbage. You can tell the person who makes the dim sum hasn’t at least watch some YouTube video on how to make them. I’ve only ate about 10% of what I ordered, and I was starving when I went in. The waitress keep asking if we want to sign up for 10% rebate. I honesty wouldn’t eat here again if it’s free.

name: Toni Chan
text: If you’re looking for a good dim-sum place here in Houston you must come here! My family and I loved this place, will definitely come back. Good food and good service.👍🏼👍🏼

name: David Nguyen
text: Nice we quiet place with very delicious dim sum

name: Nora Chen
text:
I used to come here every time I crave dim sum, but they were closed for awhile for reconstruction. Now, I am back today and it's been so long! This place is renovated and has a much bigger space than before! I really like it. There are more tables and they also have a newly designed menu. They've also have a receipt with what you order now.

The food still tastes the same as when it was back at it's old place.

name: Pete Romfh
text: Dim Sum,  Yum Yum. Always a treat to eat here. The servers always laugh when I try to say the names of the dishes in Chinese.

name: dachmom20
text: Great dim sum for great price! Went there with a few coworkers and we were treated by friendly staff. The only thing was that they only gave us two menus for 7 people. We were able to order (this is a family style restaurant). The food came out a little slow and they came pretty much one by one which made it awkward to eat. Once most food items came out, it was good. We had a great time and the bill was very low for 7 people!

name: Daniel Ngo
text: I must give bonus points for being one of the very very few restaurants that offer all day dim sum! If I ever have a craving in the afternoon, I now know where to go. That being said, the food definitely wasn't the best I've had, but it was still pretty enjoyable. Everything pretty much tasted like what I expected it to. I think the most noticeable thing was that the noodles or rice dough or any sort of exterior of the different items was often very thick, whereas if I went to a nicer place the proportions may be a bit better. Also, the service when I went was interminable but it can be forgiven because they were being routinely inspected at the time. Basically, going here is much better than not getting to have dim sum save for specific days and times, but there are definitely better places to check out if you do fall in the proper time window.

name: MAYLING Hutchinson
text: A small hole in t he wall with a great selection of dim sum food!!! Reasonable priced and quality and quantity is good!!

name: Albert G
text: It was decent dim sum. The service was slightly slow in the beginning but it picked up after we got our first dish. Our server was friendly and made the experience have a good closing.

name: Yesica Hernandez
text: I really like the food here and the service is really good as well.

name: Bessie Kahn
text: The food is wonderful and comes out really quickly. But may I just say, the staff is absolutely wonderful! They did everything to make sure that we enjoyed our time here. I don't just come here just for the amazing food but also for the friendly staff.

name: Edward Belsley
text: Good Dim Sum, various pastries are quite delicious, particularly the pork and chicken dumplings. Shrimp dumplings and fried shrimp balls are also worth trying, along with the spring rolls and fried rice! Perfect hole-in-the-wall restaurant that serves small portions family style, so it's easy to share with others if you wish.

name: Jessica Pomperson
text: Came with a large group of friends to celebrate a birthday. The food was delicious, the service was great. It’s literally a hidden gem.

name: Patrick Ng
text: Their dim sum is pretty terrible. I recommend go somewhere else.

name: Ashwin Verma
text: Best dim-sum in Houston! They've recently renovated the space and made it much bigger, so you aren't knocking into your neighbor's chairs any more. Service has also improved: all the staff seem to speak English now. Food is as good as ever (though prices have increased a bit).

name: Fauna Chieko
text: Favorite dim sum! Really fresh and not too much msg.. good staff too!!

name: Christina Ogidan Itata
text: Delicious, authentic Dim Sum if you pick correctly. Pork ribs with black beam sauce, steamed rice noodle wrapped around fried dough, pork meat balls, fried turnip cakes and rice porridge are my favorite. Some things aren't as delicious, but I can't remember what those were!

name: Justin Janecka
text: This place was great! A little off the path from the typical western palette, but there is nothing discouraging about perfectly steamed shrimp dumplings, dumplings with pine nuts, and pork dumplings. The wild broccoli was cooked perfectly and complemented the smooth and silky texture of the chicken feet. The wait staff is attentive and the food is great!

name: Emily Colmenares
text: Love how the dim sum is made to order! And they have a loyalty program

name: idklolwtfbrb Harrison
text: Idk what is happening, but it seems all of the dim sum restaurants are closing in Houston. It's freaking me out, man. Fortunately, Dim Sum King is still open and one of my favorite places to get some dim sum. Dim sum any day of the week, made to order, a variety of selections, and not expensive. Hào chī!

name: Travis Massingale
text: We go here at least once a month, Dimsum is the best and you cant beat the price!

name: Kadeem Duparl
text: Food was really good! Recommend the shrimp fried rice and the pot stickers! Other than that the service wasn't bad, not the best but also not bad.

name: David Johnson
text: Just went there. We've been to dim sum places all over Houston and this one is quite good! Cleanliness is about average for an authentic Asian restaurant. Will definitely go back.

name: Ray Mack
text: The food was decent in the service was okay. Nothing negative to mention here but nothing stellar to talk about either. I went here twice but it was just okay.

name: Dean Sharp
text: Nice place, very quiet,  Great Shimp balls ,wonderful staff. Dining here was a pleasure .

name: Stephen Hu
text: If you are new to dim sum then go try a place that serves dim sum on a push cart. If you are a dim sum veteran then you go to Dim Sum King. Here you can skip the formalities that is the the push cart. No more waiting for that one cart to come around with your favorite dish. At Dim Sum King, you are offered a picture menu of all of the dishes they serve. You then go and mark the quantity you want of each and turn it in the to waiter/waitress. Few minutes later the food comes to you;exactly what you ordered. When I want quick great tasting dim sum, I come here.

name: Catherine Luo
text: Good stop for a buffet! Prices are reasonable and the food is great.

name: Simon Lau
text: My favorite dim sum place in Houston. They have a picture menu which lets me order with my eyes, which usually means ordering too much. The dim sum comes out hot, and the service is usually pretty quick.

name: Jocelyn Ponce
text: So good. Can't wait to go again. Staff gave awesome suggestions.

name: Chris Tucker
text: A smaller place with a good selection of dim sum. The flavors were good and the service was fast.

name: Michael Kuhlmeier
text: Good prices, tasty food, well-illustrated and representative menu (for those uneducated like me), prompt staff.

name: Paolo Ilagan
text: There were some dim sum that was cold! Food is still good.

name: CC Gates
text: Quick service and tasty food! Very low key.

name: Bellin Tantania
text: Our favorite restaurant for dim sum. Now All the servers speak English. Good quality food and price.

name: Jennifer Cruz
text: You pick the food from a menu instead of carts going around. The food is still good and the service is not bad either.

name: Duy Duong
text: This is one of my favorite spots for Dim Sum at anytime of the day.  Food comes out hot compared to the restaurants that push the dim sum carts.  The prices are cheap.  I rated 4 stars instead of 5, because a few of their items do lack a little bit in flavor.

name: A. Cortes
text: Good prices, good shrimp dumplings

name: Alexander Nguyen
text: It's a decent place to eat. There were just some things I ordered that I didn't like. It made me feel like they didn't really put much effort in making good food. For an example I find there bao's meat to bun ratio 1:3. It's not a lot of stuffing in the bao's, and of you're new to dim sum then there's some items that are on the menu that would have some things that are not included in the description. An ex. for that is if you order the fried eggplants, the you would be getting the eggplants stuffed with shrimp.

name: Michael Chan
text: May not be the best looking restaurant but if you want best tasting dimsum off Bellaire, this is it

name: Alex Wong
text: The best dim sum place... If you only care about food.

name: Don Quach
text: Staff was nice, but food was blah. It seemed like frozen microwaved food or just reheated food from the night before. Definitely better dim sum elsewhere.

name: Thinh Nguyen
text: Decent food, the place is kinda loud.  If you are going on a date I would advise against this place due to the noise but the food is great.

name: Rose West
text: Lots of delicious dim sum. Wide variety

name: Phat Tran
text: This is not a big restaurant but it's clean, serving a good foods and inexpensive price compare with other places.

name: Sandra Pham
text: When you are looking to escape the overly pretentious and overpriced Dim Sum restaurants flooding Chinatown, this is the place you want to go. It is reasonably priced and has a good grasp on the staples. It's an authentic, no frilly nilly type of place. Meaning do not expect impeccable service or even a smile but that's OK. Once you over look the straight to the point attitude you are in for a great meal. It's delicious and fast with no BS.

name: Hannah Kiger
text: Very good homemade Dim Sum, cheap prices, and large selection with easy to read picture menu.

name: Husrin Sankosik
text: This place use to serve good dim sum but they disappointed us this last time. Food qualify is not as good as before. Some items are over steamed such that the skin become wet and soggy and break off the stuffing when luck up. Too bad.

name: Don Tran
text: Not the best Dim sum but it's a good place that's quiet and you can enjoy dim sum casually. Great service.

name: CinnaStar
text: Great food and friendly staff!

name: Bobbi Himyari
text: The sprout dumpling was delicious! Very fair price for high quality food.

name: John G
text: Always packed but great food. Not much elbow room though.

text: Love this place will always go back fast and friendly staff!!!

name: Harry KQ
text: Great dim sum location!

name: Alfredo Melendez
text: Best ramen I've ever had. Great staff.

name: Raul Rodriguez
text: Great food... The place is lind of hidden .. But it is worth the look..

name: Rain
text:
TL;DR: Had good first experience, second experience was awful,  the very same waiter forgot to send in our food order, never checked up on us after we waited 30 minutes, and owner/manager was angry at us for deciding to take our business elsewhere after they wasted our time.

Went here after lunch hours and had a good time. Some food came out really quick. Our waiter gave sub-par customer service. As expected for any Asian restaurant, especially in the Bellaire area.

Prices were good, food was great from what I've eaten (xiu mai, chicken feet, turnip cake, fried crab ball, fried shrimp ball, banh bao).

We came here 3 days later. It was quite empty, maybe 2-3 tables were filled with others.
We ordered our food and waited. And waited. And waited. Turned out, the same waiter from last time left our food order on an empty table.

We waited 30 minutes for nothing because he was hiding in the kitchen and we found out after thinking something was wrong. We decided to take our business elsewhere after wasting our time because of the terrible waiter.

Owner got upset with us because we decided to go elsewhere. Sorry, but your terrible waiter(s) drove potential customers away.

name: Alan Chai
text: If you are looking for good and cheap dim sum, this is the place

name: Ashley Lai
text: Tucked away in a little corner in a chinatown shopping strip, Dim Sum King is great for a low key dimsum with a small group of people. The location is very small so parties larger than 4 will have a hard time finding space here. They have all the dim sum classics like har gow and siu mai. Great pictures for dimsum newbies and also a large menu to choose from!

name: Jim Ba
text: Its ok. Worth trying again

name: Denver Greene
text: This place is where you need to go if you really want Dim Sum and all of the other Dim Sum places are closed. It's really good food and for the price as well. They just don't always have the cart service that you might want with a typical Dim Sum experience.

name: Jonathan Nassar
text: This is one of my favorite dim sum places. Great sticky rice, har gao, xiu mai, they have lots of good options here.

text: This is the “SPOT” if you want to get you a SHOT of Moderna!! Came here for my final dose to handle this freaking covid!! Glad this is over ... just wonder whats next!!

text: Got my Covid19 vaccine here.  Thanks for providing the venue

text: Vaccine admin efficient, well run out employees friendly and competent

text: Got my first vaccine here! I'll be back on the 20th!

name: G Traylor
text: This facility is a rip-off. Bait & switch. I had web reservations for 3 days @ $9.95/day. When I leave, I am charged $10.95/day. The gate agents aren’t empowered to their customers. Management not available. An appeal to the 1-800 number went unanswered. And I am a Spot Club Member - or should I say former member, I will never park there again.

resp.text: Our apologies for the frustration! We will certainly correct any error that were made, do you mind forwarding your reservation and receipt to us at feedback@theparkingspot.com? We'd also be interested in what number you dialed, as we do not have an 800 number for The Parking Spot 1. Thank you!

name: Sarah Edgington
text: Love the parking spot. So convenient and easy. Buses are frequent and drivers are friendly and welcoming. You even get water as you leave - perfect after a long flight. The app is excellent too.

name: DrLynn T
text: Speedy service. Plenty of covered parking. Recent flight arrived at 1am, got on the shuttle exhausted, driver was amazing. Took my travel companion and me to our car and made sure we were safely inside and our car was okay. The app is terrific and makes check in and check out easy peasy. I use Parking Spot at every airport from which I fly. They're the best!

name: Carmen Santiago
text: Fast service ,,friendly Representatives

name: Raul Valle
text: Always great to use the app for parking reservations, gate entrance check-in and for locating next pick-up shuttle when returning home at same or different terminal at Bush Intercontinental Airport. Great app and great people...!!

name: Bruce Lyngaas
text: Pay ahead on phone app is a real timesaver. The staff are all friendly and very helpful. I like the schedules, location, reminder cards, rates, covered parking and phone app.

name: vanessa sierra
text: Good, but I recommend making a reservation online, it is much cheaper.  I give it 3 stars because I don't agree with this, they should give everyone the same price.  14 days I paid   $207.

name: Nathaly Torrico
text: My first time doing this and It was so quick from booking, parking and everything else. Surely will do this again.

name: Bill Mangus
text:
We were very pleased with the covered parking , very little waiting time for friendly and helpful transportation to and from airport, even at 11:00 PM at night. Prices were reasonable for the 14 day vacation.
We recommend

name: Jim Morris
text: The man who greeted me was nice. Then i waited 20 minutes after being told someone was on their way to get me (i walked and asked if someone was coming after 10 minutes on initial waiting). The driver? The person who told me to wait in the sun in front of my truck...

name: Cherie Stallings
text: Parking is convenient.  Shuttle operators are friendly and helpful with luggage.  Service is dependable.  Cold bottled water when leaving Parking Spot for ride home from airport is much appreciated.  Thank you.

name: Christopher Powell
text: I think everyone (and I mean everyone) at the Will Clayton #1 Parking Spot are really customer focused. I feel bad because I don't carry cash very often. It's because we travel internationally so much. It doesn't make sense to take US dollars to Asia and then get a bad exchange rate when you try and convert to local currency. The point is, no cash in my pocket. The reason I feel bad is because the drivers at Parking Spot (without exception) are so helpful and I do see other folks tipping them. I want to do that too, but again no cash. I wish Parking Spot would let me put a "driver tip" either on my Parking Spot card or at check out, where I could add a tip for all the drivers. Maybe they split it? That way I could tip my drivers with my credit card. Would make it much easier for the traveler to treat these folks right.  Anyway, the team is awesome, some of the nicest folks you'll meet. They really exhibit true Texas hospitality. Good job. - Chris Powell, customer for two years now.

name: Tom Brodie
text: I love The Parking Spot! It's easy to reserve a spot online and I can see which location has cheaper prices before I make my selection. I also like the frequent customer discounts.

name: Mark Cramer
text: Very friendly and helpful staff. Efficient pickup and drop-off. Everything went very smooth. I will continue to use them in the future.

name: Lindsey Bey
text: Always quick and easy. In and out. The bus drivers are great to get you to your car quickly and efficiently.

name: John Kane
text: Very affordable. Exceptional service. Safe place to park long term. Super friendly and helpful staff! HIGHLY recommend this company to anyone needing to park their vehicles at the IAH!

name: smily dutchgirl
text: A good way to park your car if you are traveling long term. Be sure to arrive early as it obviously takes time to load people and luggage in the transportation and then drop them off at the airline. If you dont wa t to pay 20 dollars a day at the airport this is a good solution

name: Sandra Hempel
text: Personnel (both shuttle drivers and gate attendants) were very personable and helpful!  Kudos to the staff!

name: Justice Nnaji
text: Wonderful location to drop off your car at the airport with a short ride to your terminal.

name: Janet Davenport
text: Clean , quite and friendly. Good breakfast bar. Friendly desk clerk.

name: Jeff Lowery
text: I enjoyed working there most of the staff was a lot of fun.

name: Felicia McKnight
text: Great experience. Every employee I encountered was nice!

name: Tootie's Soul Food
text: Prices are seriously competitive, service is wonderful and they offered shuttle rides to the airport. I joined 😆😀😁

name: Chris Caswell
text: The drivers are very helpful and friendly.  This level of service has noticeably improved the last few years and that extra bit of courtesy helps both before and after a flight.

name: Jeffrey Browning
text:
Used 3 times now with no issues
Quick Trip to airport, which is nice on the worn out airport buses.  Lost my wallet on the bus and they turned into security.  Had it back in 15 minutes.

name: Graham M
text: Fast, efficient and friendly service. Some of the buses could do with new suspension, though. A bit bone rattly.

name: Tom Newsom
text: Prompt pickup and arrival at the parking spot and at the airport. Courteous, friendly and help with the luggage drivers. Clean transportation vehicles and facility. Cashier was helpful in applying coupons and informing us of our points.  Complimentary water.

name: Paul Trainor
text: My wife and I always use the Parking spot when traveling. The staff are friendly and helpful.  Always a parking spot, though I recommend and use covered parking which IMO, is worth it.

name: Alann Gutierrez
text: Very pleased with everyone I encountered. I was running late for my flight out, but that was not their fault--I arrived at the terminal via shuttle very quickly after I parked. I waited maybe 2-3 minutes for a shuttle after I landed and walked outside. The drivers were courteous and cheerful, as was the cashier on my way out. The cashier also helped me find a discount with my Costco membership, and gave me a bottle of water and a rewards card, all with a pleasant attitude and a smile on her face. All in all, very pleased and will absolutely be making them my go-to "parking spot" (ha!) for future trips.

name: Marvin Castillo
text: Great service!! Will continue use it as need it, very convenient .

name: James Stewart
text: This is a very simple process to enter and exit the secured property! Plus it's close to the airport!

name: t sandoval
text: Easy reservations, easy to find, easy to park, friendly staff & drivers, and easy to check out!

name: Todd Ratajczak
text: I always park here for IAH flights. As long as you are careful to remember that the correct bus is the BLUE "Will Clayton" - labeled one, you'll be fine. There are multiple Spot locations, so correct bus identification is a priority. Free water bottles at the exit is always appreciated. Discount codes are available online.

name: Tiffany Christopher
text: Traveling with kids is never easy but the parking spot makes it easier, so helpful with luggage and the wait is never long

name: Ariany Moura
text: I have coupon but didn’t work, so we spent much more than planned. If we have any idea about that we would parked in another place. I also tried to book when I was on my way to the airport but the system didn’t allow me. Horrible! And the shuttle was taking so long to arrive.

name: Julia Ebarb
text: Parking there every week is very convenient. All the employees are so nice and pleasant and work very hard to make getting back and forth to the airport as easy as possible. The valet car washes are a great additional service too!

name: brian calidonio
text: I chose this place because it had good reviews but the customer service was terrible. When I got there the lady made me wait at the gate while she tended other people. Then a man came to my window and made it seem impossible for me to get in without a printed receipt, the lady (who was obviously in a bad mood) came back and said no she can just use my name and number. Finally I got in and they took my truck as I paid for a car wash. I figured maybe it was just a bad luck thing. But when I arrived back, the new people at the gate were even more rude! I also received the treatment of being unable to pull out without a ticket! She was rude and short luckily I was able to find it. Then to top it off, I was charged an extra day even though I had put the hours on their website exactly as I used them! I did not even bother trying to deal with this lady who was even giving me a hard time to leave. Oh and the car wash, I walk up to my car and decide to do a quick look (at night) and see a black streak on my door. Try to wipe it and nothing. I got a water and rag out of my truck and after some really hard stroke was able to start taking it off. Thankfully or else this would have pushed me over the edge. Very unhappy especially with the premium I paid to be here. I don't normally do reviews but felt compelled after this.

name: Akwugo Eziefule
text: It's inexpensive. Great service. I get to earn parking at any Parking Spot facility. This is the one time, "you get what you pay for" has a positive connotation!

name: Jason A. McCrory
text: Reasonable pickup time from the airport. Great driver, very friendly guy!

name: Carmen Demapan Fernandez
text: Very quick easy process!  Repeat customer!

name: Carli Centurion
text: Decent service except for the detail wash. The detail cleaning was a complete scam, since it looked almost the same way as when I left the car. I have done detailed clean services to this same care before, and you can see a great difference when the service is done correctly; sometimes the car looks brand new. I will not recommend the car wash service at this location, whatsoever.

resp.text: We are so sorry to hear that you were disappointed with your detail, Carli!  If you would like to connect with us directly, we'd love to chat about it with you.  Please feel free to privately send us your contact info at feedback@theParkingSpot.com.

name: Charles Flook
text: Would not recommend; with so many similar choices you would think the service level to be top notch however not in my experience. We pulled in with a receipt from online reservation and they directed us to the appropriate lane. On our exit we proceeded to the checkout with our reservation that we came in with however told we couldn't leave until we produced a ticket...which obviously we didn't have because the gal sitting outside the booth who directed us to our lane initially did not give us one. We were told "you can't leave until you provide the ticket." This could have been remedied easily but the cashier's lack of customer service pushed it over the edge. Needless to say we won't be back with so many options to choose from.

name: Ursul Valentin
text:
They took good care of us,  we even got a cold water on our way out!

That’s the 4th time I’ve used Spot 1.... no complaints whatsoever...

Thank you!!!

name: Jennie Arevalo
text: Covered parking is a must in humid Houston weather. The interior of my car was not hot when I returned after a week. I didn't have to wait at all to be picked up or dropped off. The shuttle bus driver was very courteous and helped me with my luggage. The cashier at the entrance/exit was also very friendly. Complimentary refrigerated bottled water is also a plus. I've parked with other competitors nearby where I've had to wait a long time to be picked up and/or dropped off. Sometimes I've even had to call their dispatcher to find out where the shuttle bus was because I had been waiting so long after an already exhausting day of travel. Though not a deal breaker, the other places would give me room temperature or even lukewarm bottled water. Not so at The Parking Spot. Highly recommend!

name: Chad Wixon
text: Everything went smoothly and better than expected. The spots are a little tight, even for my mid sized truck (Chevrolet Colorado) but it was manageable.

name: Stephanie Manley
text: I have generally had good luck here.  The parking spaces are large, and the folks are very nice.   I choose this location because I see their buses the most often.  I also like that you can call them when your plane lands so you don't have to wait forever.

name: Chris Emery

text: On December 16 at 1:22 AM we were picked up by a Parking Spot 1 bus and experienced the worst bus ride of our lives.  The driver was speeding down Will Clayton, hitting the bumps at 60+ mph, with complete disregard for out safety, presumably in the name of getting us to our car quickly.  The bus had NO rear shock absorption and we flew out of our seats at the bumps.  To make matters even worse, when he turned back west on Will Clayton, he accelerated hard and turned into the parking lot at an excessive speed, hitting the curb and nearly flipping the bus over.  That wasn't enough.  He then proceeded to speed down the isles to our truck.  When we got off the bus, we were in-shock at the "ride" we had just gotten.  Today, 3 days later, our backs are still sore from the bouncing and jolting.  I will be filing a formal complaint with The Parking Spot.

name: Glenn Gibbons
text: Easily 5 stars. We had an early lunch today with my wife's parents who frequent this establishment, and our three young girls. We now see why they love it so much. My wife and I had the Pollo Trapani and it was OUTSTANDING. From the thin slices of garlic, the perfectly cooked pasta, shrimp and chicken to the light dusting of herbs on top. This was excellent. I will find it difficult to try other dishes when I loved this one some much. Our server was personable, friendly and attentive without being overbearing. What I assume was the owner or manager stopped to check on us twice too and was very kind and genuinely interested in our service. I will be glad to stop here again every time we pass through.

resp.text: We're glad to know our food met and exceeded your expectations! Thank you for sharing your insightful feedback and sharing the great experience you had here. We appreciate all of your kind words towards our team and are proud we were able to leave a great lasting impression with you.

name: Josh Brock
text:
I didn't know there was such a good traditional Italian restaurant hiding down highway 6! This place screams Italian from the moment you drive up. We sat in the bar area and were quickly brought bread sticks to try, which were delightful. These aren't the bread sticks you're used to at olive garden. They like crunchy little sticks coated in what I think was parmesan. We also ordered a bottle of Birra Moretti, an imported Italian beer which was delightful.

As for the food, I had the Veal Parmesan, which was quite tasty, I fully recommend you try it. Its veal breaded like chicken parmigiana and covered in delicious cheeses and sauces. It also comes with some spaghetti.

Dessert was the bomb! We ate the Tiramisu which was incredible. I wish I had gotten a picture of it, because it looked so good, but we were way too excited to eat it.

The service was excellent as well. I highly recommend you try Corelli's!

resp.text: Josh, we are delighted to hear you enjoyed your first dining experience with us! We strive to provide our customers with authentic food and hospitable service. We appreciate that you took the time to provide us with honest and detailed feedback. Hopefully, we just earned ourselves a regular and look forward to seeing you again soon at Corelli's Italian Cafe!

name: ntexas100
text: Today was our third visit to Corelli's for lunch.  The two previous trips the service and food were excellent.  This trip was just as good.  However, we had one glitch.  Me, my wife, daughter, and our 2 year old granddaughter had lunch.  We ordered two pizzas.  One pizza came out with the wrong toppings.  Our waitress was very apologetic and offered to make us the correct pizza.  It wasn't a big deal to us to eat the wrong pizza (toppings were good for us), but she insisted and told us she would box it for us to take home.  The manager came over to apologize as well.  He saw how my granddaughter was getting a little restless, so he brought out some fruit.  My granddaughter loves fruit and this kept her satisfied.  Over all, the thin crust pizza was very good with just the right amount of sauce and cheese.  Once again, the service was exceptional.  Our poor waitress was genuinely sorry for the mix up, so I gave her a very nice tip.  This was the first time we had their pizza.  Before we had their chicken entrees and pork chops.  ALL were cooked perfectly and tasted great.  Even if we didn't get a free pizza, Corelli's has easily become our go to for Italian.

resp.text: Thank you for the wonderful review and kind words. Being able to provide a wonderful dining experience every time is what we pride ourselves on. We're glad to hear, that even with the mix up of pizza toppings, your experience ended up being a great one! We look forward to welcoming you back again soon.

text: My first time here. The service was impeccable, prompt, friendly, and accurate. I had the snapper, pan-fried in a very light flour dredge, it was cooked perfectly. This was fat, soft  pasta. The Lasagna was delicious,  with a very snappy fresh tomato sauce with zesty flavor. That is huge for me,  because lasagna is not my favorite dish. The margarita pizza was terrific, I added pepperoni and the spicy red pepper sprinkle. It was true perfection with a nice thin, chewy crust. The wine list is acceptable. I would have loved to see a bubbly ROSE' on the list, but it was not to be. There were a couple of good Italian wines available. Especially a nice Sangiovese. The decor is really authentic and quaint. The entire experience was authentic,  and did not in any way taste like a chain style flavored restaurant. I enjoyed the total experience.

It's was so disappointing and almost frustrating to see a place with so much potential lacking so much. Beautiful interior space and patio. The staff was friendly. The prices seemed fair. The experience as a whole was great for the first 15 min...up until the food arrived.

It was such a disappointment to see them fail so bad on the food that I am here leaving a review where I normally would never do so. My girlfriend had the manicotti and the sauce was gloopy, thick and somehow watery all at the same time. My chicken parm was smashed to a pulp and dry and the presentation as a whole was lacking. This would be acceptable Italian food for a non Italian restaurant but for a place like this we expected much better. We could have gone to olive garden and had better food for a lower price. Nothing was authentic or tasted great.

Again, frustrating sine the place has so much potential. This is definitely a case of poor kitchen management. No wonder it was practically empty on a Saturday night. Should have caught the hint from the beginning that something was off.

resp.text: Yatin-We are sorry to read this feedback as we work hard to serve the most authentic and delicious tasting Italian food around. name: Chrinecia Alexander
text: This place is in the perfect spot for everything!!! Hotel is gorgeous inside and out. No mess nor foul smell on the outside area like other hotels. For this family trip, we had EVERYTHING near us. Thank you staff for making this stay well worth it!

resp.text: Thank you for your wonderful five star review.  We greatly appreciate your business.

name: Roxy C
text: Clean hotel/room. Everything was great. Recommended 👍🏽 No breakfast included and no pets allowed (if these two were a yes it would be even better 😊)

resp.text: Thank you for your review.  So happy to see your 5 star review.

name: D'SILVA
text:
My first visit here and was impressed with a 3.5 star hotel. I felt it deserved a 4-5 star with their elegant ambiance 💯
Deluxe room suite with an amazing lake view, so beautiful 💘🍷 one day stay is not enough to explore😄 Coming back

Happy Hilton Honors Member👍

resp.text:
D'silva,

What a nice review.  We loved having you.  For your next visit please let myself or the front office manager Viridiana know your coming and we will personally select one of our best rooms for you.  Thank you so very much and welcome to the Honors family.

Yours in service,
Bill Dalleske
Hotel General Manager

name: Joshua Mar
text: Didn't have any shower curtains and the walls were super thin but.... If one is looking for a more reasonable price and a famous Hilton this is a great one and not to be missed. I will say the famousness made all the difference even if I had to pay incidentals which the staff was wonderful and were more than glad as a patron to have my back.

resp.text:
Joshua'
Sorry to hear about the missing shower curtain and the thin walls.  Thank you truly for your business.

name: Cathy J
text: Hotel is nice, but the beds were smaller than what we are use to in a room with two beds. There is plenty of space in the room but the bathroom was tiny, which made it hard for everyone to get ready. Our closet door was off the hinges, so it wouldn't close all the way, which blocked the entrance to the bathroom a little. The view from our room wasn't bad. We weren't on the lake side, but still had a bit of a view, including the marina.

name: edhem besirevic
text:
Great location! Really enjoy staying here when in Houston.
Bathrooms in every room I stayed, could use updating.

resp.text:
Edhem,
Thank you for your review.  I am glad you liked our location.  We are continually updating different area's of the hotel.  I am sure in the coming years re-evaluating the layout of our rooms will be something our owners will look into.

Hope to see you soon.
Bill Dalleske

name: James Tackett
text:
My daughter's wedding was in Baytown on the 20th of March.  She let all of the family and friends know where we would be staying and encouraged them to stay as well. Overall an impressive venue. The rooms were spacious and spotless!
The staff was extremely helpful, knowledgeable, and kind! Kudos all around!

The only issue we had was the lounge was closed. We do understand due to covid the lounge was permanently closed. We had asked prior to our stay if it would be open so the guests would only have to go upstairs to their rooms once the festivities were over. We were assured via email it was.
Other than that small issue I would highly recommend this amazing Hilton!

resp.text: Thank you so very much for your kind words.  I will share this review with my staff.  Have a wonderful week Mr. Tackett.

name: Alaa Mo.
text: Great service, clean room. I'm currently staying at this hotel. My 2 main concerns are that the air conditioner does not cool the room, it keeps stopping and starting, and the room is not even getting cold even though we have it on 61. Second thing is that there is a door between us and the room next to us. We can literally open it and walk into their room at anytime. And the most annoying thing is that we can hear EVERY single word of their conversation, pretty sure they can hear us too. I've been to many different hotels, and never had that happen.

resp.text:
Alaa Mo
I am sorry to hear about your dissatisfaction with your most recent stay.  I will be sure to check all of our connecting rooms to ensure they are properly secured.  I will also share your Air conditioning issues with my engineering team as well.

name: Ian the beer rabbi
text: If you want a five star for a hotel the only way to get it is with a valet and  Concierge. But the hotel is beautiful and the cost seems very fair. And man was it clean!. Great spot to stay.

resp.text: Thank you for writing a review please let me know what we could have done to have earned a 5 star review.

name: Jazzie T
text: Very nice hotel, staff was friendly and helpful and my son loved our waterview room and their snack shop. The hotel room was very clean and comfortable, we definitely enjoyed our stay.

resp.text:
Jazzie,
thank you so very much I am glad you enjoyed your stay with us.  We love the opportunity to be your hotel of choice.

Yours in service,

Bill Dalleske
General Manager

name: Michael Ham
text: Even during these stressful times, the staff is very friendly. Check in was easy enough, and I enjoyed talking with the guy. The room was very clean. Good view of the water and pier they have. It's winter, so not anything happening on the water. It's still nice to have a view. Location is across from NASA property.

name: Heather Hoagland
text: Great motel for a great price on the water! Rooms are clean and the pool is actually open.

resp.text: Thank you Heather.  Yes we are open and ready to take care of great guests like yourself.

name: Karen L
text: Great location and beautiful views. Paid for an upgraded alcove room with sofa, but they only room available was a king room with 1 chair she said due to Civid-19. Not sure why they offered upgraded suite if it really wasn't available? Front desk person said she would give me some points back for my stay. I was a little disappointed, but the views in room 1109 made up for it. Small balcony, but awesome view of the lake.

name: Alfred Daise
text: Hotel staff was excellent but they need some much needed updates at this site. They need to enhance their outside as its on the bay. With beautiful views of the water. Rooms are clean and it appears staff is working hard to keep building Covid19 free as much as possible.

name: Stephanie Barry
text: Great views of the lake. Kind of older hotel, but still nice.

resp.text:
Ms. Barry,

Thank you for your kind words.  True our hotel has been around for some time but we try to make up for the age with service you deserve.

Hope to see you again soon.

Bill Dalleske
General Manager

name: Crybaby’s Universe
text:
They cancelled our reservation because they overbooked and didn’t even tell us. And the two people working the desk didn’t know how to do their job, and they acted like they didn’t know that our reservation was gone. After going through a bunch of trouble with Hotwire, we got a new hotel, and Hotwire only gave us an extra $40 along with our refund (for our “troubles”). They didn’t even offer a free hotel stay or anything. Wow.
Well, we’ll never use Hotwire or give Hilton our money again.

resp.text:
Dear guest,

The Hampton Inn and us share the same address after looking up your information I believe you had The Hampton Inn by Hilton was incorrectly chosen I am sorry for the confusion the desk staff caused.

name: Felicia Hackbarth
text: Amazing stay. Had a room with Lake view which was breathtaking to wake up to. Definitely recommend.

name: Frankie Sharpe
text: Great view, nice room, & fantastic soft bedding

resp.text:
Thank you for your five star review.  I am glad to hear you enjoyed the view and were comfortable in our beds.  Have a wonderful week.

Yours in service,
Bill Dalleske
Hotel General Manager

name: John Westwood
text:
Hilton right across from Johnson Space Center. If I could give 3.5, I would. The staff was very friendly and helpful. The building itself looked very nice. The Lobby level looked very well kept and up to date. Workout room had great amenities and newer equipment.
However... the rooms just seemed old. Desk chair had a tear, shower faucet looked 20 years old, TV from 2002. Maybe I got an outlier. But it just seemed like the Hotel put all the money into a nice restaurant on the Lobby level and neglected the rooms. [written 2019]

resp.text:
Hi John,

Thank you for staying with us. We appreciate your honesty as we look for reviews to provide insight and constructive feedback regarding our hotel’s service and amenities to better our guest experience. We welcome any additional comments or suggestions you would like to share. If you return to our area, we hope you’ll stay with us again.

Regards,
Jessica Smith-Houston
Front Office Manager

name: Chris Bayes
text: Great views. Nice rooms. Walls are a bit thin.

resp.text:
Mr. Bayes,

Thank you for taking the time to write a review.  I am glad you enjoyed our views of Clearlake.  During your next stay with us please let us know in advance and we will see what we can do about finding you a little quieter location.

Yours in service,
Bill Dalleske
Hotel General Manager

name: Andrew H
text: Nice hotel with a great view. Very clean. Would give 5 stars but the bathrooms need a little bit of renovating. New lights and better shower heads. Other than those minor things, the room was great and extreme comfort beds.

name: Jeffrey Larson
text: Comfortable and well-appointed meeting space.

resp.text: Thank you for your four star review.  Have a great week.

name: K Fleuret
text: We arrived 20 min to 4:00 and told it wouldn't be ready until 4:00, so we left and came back. The room wasn't ready when we returned at 4:30 so we had to wait in the lobby since all the services are shut down until 5:00 pm. We have a junior suite which came with a private balcony. One or two people can stand in this little triangle, no chairs or tables for sure. Not what I think of as a balcony. Also didn't get the waters our other diamond member norms.

name: Hugh Bollin
text: Decent hotel. Very close to NASA so that is probably the best part.

resp.text:
Hi Mr. Bollin,

Thank you for taking the time to write a review.  Yes you are correct our location is very convenient to local area attractions such as NASA.  I am very hopeful that you give us another chance some day soon in the future to earn a 5 star review.

Yours in service,
Bill Dalleske
Hotel General Manager

name: Janis Balsamo
text: Such a great place to stay with amazing views of sunrises on Clear Lake or views of Johnson Space Center and sunsets.  The staff and management are friendly and try to take care of you in every way.  The hotel is spotless and have special cleaning procedures during this Covid time.

resp.text:
Thank you for taking a moment to share your experience. We look forward to welcoming you back to our hotel in the not too distant future.

Sincerely,

Jessica Smith
Front Office Manager
Hilton Nasa Clearlake
Jessica.smith2@hilton.com
281-333-9300

name: Joy TheTurd
text: Beautiful lobby, safe, exceptional customer service 😊Front desk staff made me feel valued, were friendly ,professional, and helpful.  The view from my room was beautiful, the room was clean and quiet.  We did not eat anything from the restaurant or room service so I can’t comment on that. The reason I gave this Hotel only 4 stars is because the room is a little small and the bathroom is cruise ship small.  Then there is an unpleasant odor coming from the carpet.  In spite of these drawbacks I would recommend this hotel and stay again.

name: L Riles
text: NOT impressed. Expensive for the standard look. Hasnt been uprgraded. Toilet handle came loose. Carpet all over looks slightly worned; tub, bathroom ceiling over tub, floor lamp old. Pretty standard for their price. Theyre in a good location so they may wanna spend some money to upgrade.

resp.text:
Ms. Riles,

Thank you for taking the time to write a review.  We appreciate your business and your advise as well.  We will continue to make changes to make our hotel a better place for our guests.  Have a great week.

Yours in service,
Bill Dalleske
Hotel General Manager

name: Jeff Horner
text: Nice hotel. Nice area. Nice view of clear lake. Fair price

name: Tim
text: Great location, 5 minutes from NASA. The room was large and comfortable. Fantastic views. Nice lounge on the top floor.

resp.text:
We greatly appreciate your feedback on your recent stay with us. I am pleased to hear you found the your accommodations to your liking. If there was anything that could have made your stay more enjoyable, please don't hesitate to contact me. We look forward to welcoming you back to our hotel soon

Regards,
Jessica Smith
Front Office Manager

name: Christopher Goff
text: Comfy beds, nice clean room, great air conditioning.  We had a "Lake View" room, however the view was obstructed.  We experienced great customer service. Called for towels and extra bedding and they both arrived very quickly. Highly recommended!

name: kieth perea
text: Nice place for a quick get away

resp.text:
Mr. Perea,
Thank you for your review.  I am glad you enjoyed your get away.

name: Leo Nardo
text: This was an awesome stay. I was so happy with the rooms I stayed in. I had to stay in two different ones because my stay got extended after I checked out, and I'm happy I was at this hotel. The views were great, and the customer service was perfect. The restaurant is a tad overpriced, but it's a hotel restaurant, but the food was pretty good! So I really have no complaints. :)

name: Joe Apodaca II
text: A great view from my room. The room was clean and comfortable. The staff were friendly and helpful. Came to visit the Boardwalk and NASA. Breakfast was excellent and mighty tasty.

name: Quazi Elahee
text: I am not totally impressed and not very upset at the same time. Not sure if this is usual standard here or not but I had a little more expectations regarding the services available in the room or at least on every floor. I had a new born and of course we needed a microwave to be warm things up. I was expecting one in the room but understood that it's not service apartment so it's okay but they can make a place in each floor and place some pantry items there. I had go down without any clear direction from where I can warm the milk as no one seems to know that the downstairs pantry doesn't have the microwave anymore and I was kept directing there. Finally had to go to the restaurant. No drinking water was placed in the room and we had ask for it every time. I am good with the room standard and the location and the view. We liked staying there apart from the bad things I mentioned. Customer service is not bad. Ample parking spots. Located beside water. Loved that. Decoration was good too. So overall can be better but not bad though. I would try some other place next time. But recommend this place too. Price reasonably affordable. 4 star should a good review.

name: Lisa Goff
text: Very nice hotel and staff. Beautiful scenery

resp.text:
Thanks for your feedback, we are pleased to hear you enjoyed your stay.

Regards,
Jessica Smith
Front Office Manage

name: Shea H
text: Very cool, NASA themed Hilton. Room was nice with an amazing view of the lake. Outdoor balcony was small but definitely a plus. Morning breakfast buffet was not to bad. Will go back. Staff was very accommodating.

resp.text: Thank you Shea for your kind review. We're delighted you enjoyed the view from your balcony, breakfast and staff and we look forward to seeing you again! Sincerely, Farred Kamal - General Manager

name: Phongsiri Nirachornkul
text:
Room is good.
Price is reasonable.
But no wifi( reception will always say problem with network or internet for 24/7)

No free breakfast

Please, read this comment before you book this hotel.

The breakfast is buffet ($16 per head)
Plus, mandatory tip 18% without any service
We didn’t get any service from them and they charged us for $16 for tip without any asking..

We are willing to pay tip if any server come to say “hi” and serve water. We didn’t get any glass of water on table too.
If you want good breakfast then we recommend you to search in yelp app

If you can accept no free breakfast and no wifi.. then this hotel will fit for you....

P.S. If you write one star review then it will have automatic apologize message from GM , but the problem will be there forever... Don't worry... they won't do any thing to fix these problems ..

Good luck for your journey..

resp.text:
Dear Phongsiri,
Thank you for taking the time to review your recent experience. Please know we take all guest feedback very seriously as it greatly assists us in learning where to focus our efforts. I am sorry to read that we did not meet your expectations. This is absolutely not the impression we wish for our guests to leave with. Please know I will be addressing your comments with our leadership team to ensure that all training opportunities are covered moving forwards. I hope that we might have the opportunity to welcome you back in the future so that we may earn back your trust.
Best regards,
Bill, GM

name: Trinity's Labyrinth
text: I won't write too much except that beware staying at this place they don't maintain the rooms even though they say they are putting in extra cleaning etc . Nothing is open even though I called and asked they said yes, also I called earlier to see if early check in was available and they said it was just to get there and be downgraded to a room that was dirty and filled with drug paraphernalia. No room service was provided to clean the room either and I understand being  under staffed but dont lie to people. Also beware if you are a woman because  they will treat you like you don't know anything at all .

name: Pablo Ordaz
text: The service and upkeep of the hotel was absolutely 5 Star. We were amazed with the staff and how quickly they responded to special guest requests.  Location had an incredible view to the bay and accomadating to the special occasion.

resp.text:
Hi Pablo,

Thank you very much for the wonderful review! I will be sure to recognize the staff for there exceptional efforts.

Regards,
Jessica Smith
Front Office Manager

name: Deuce Coliyon
text:
WOW!! Exactly what I imagined!!!! The view was so beautiful from our King Deluxe!!
Wish you guys could see the videos!!
The hospitality was great!! Parking for everyone.. Just didn't eat there.. Maybe next time. My top 5!! See y'all again soon!!
Thanx

name: Michelle Tradewell
text: We have been here for STAAR testing for my son now 3 times with tomorrow being the 4th time. Very nice Hotel with a beautiful surrounding neighborhood. It over looks the Bay and Yaht Club too which is nice to look at. There are tennis courts as well across the street but not sure if its for private use or public. I love takin walks/runs around the area while he is inside or just relaxing by the pool. Its all beautiful and greenery everywhere and just very peaceful with sounds of birds at times.

name: Megan Smith
text:
Clean. Absolutely gorgeous inside. Tiny store for snacks/drinks/items. Bar. The drinks smelled boozy just while standing next to someone. Score. Fruit water in the lobby. Parking lot was clean and lit. Beds were pretty nice with fresh linens. The bathroom was a tight fit.
We got a room with a view but our windows were so full of dripping condensation that we couldn't see out of them until we squeegee'd them. Then there was a mess of water all over the sills. That was odd. I've never had a full size window condensate like that in all the hotels I've stayed in over the years. The lake the nice. Location was good.

name: Sharonda Millner
text: Family came for a quick Memorial Day getaway. Have stayed here before COVID-19 and I must say, this was the worst experience! I get hotels may be operating with limited staff, but this was unacceptable. We had a leaky ac unit, told front desk, they were unresponsive and unconcerned. Wet carpet pool for 2 days! Also, no towel or room cleaning until 3rd day of stay (ours was 2 nights). Emptied our own trash into big black trash bag that was full in the hallway. No pool or restaurant (COVID, I get it). They should just close until things are back to normal and they have adequate staffing. Won't stay here again.

name: Rebecca Dove
text: We arrived without a reservation on a Saturday. They had a couple of double bed rooms left. The room was on the 9th floor and had a view of Clear Lake. The pool closes at 10p and restaurant at 11pm. The staff was very pleasant and made our stay awesome.

name: Cyn Grisham
text: It's a great hotel when the bar and restaurant are open.  Stayed during COVID.  The rooms were well appointed and the bed was divine!

name: Russell Hall
text: Stayed here a few days ago.  The hotel was clean and had a nice lake view room for us.  The room layout was a little dated and the shower did not drain as fast as it sprayed - short showers only.  Overall, not bad.  I'll probably try something else the next time I need a room as this wasn't my favorite.

name: Logan Bob
text: Location is on the water and bayside view is very nice. Front desk staff are very nice too!

name: Greg Park
text: I stayed here on a business trip, the staff was friendly. Rooms were nice with a great view of Clear Lake. The staff was friendly. The elevator waits were a bit long at times and the stairway was not located very conveniently but overall the stay was nice and I would return for another visit.

name: Adam Brown
text: Chill great spot on clear lake.

name: Jeffrey Walloch
text: The hotel is located in a convenient area on NASA road 1. The lobby has been newly renovated. Rooms were renovated at some point, but are definitely showing their age again. The breakfast is unreasonably expensive (like most Hilton hotels). Though the high floors afford a good view, I'd recommend heading down the road a bit to newer options.

resp.text:
Dear Jeffrey,
Thank you for your feedback. We are sorry to hear that you're not entirely satisfied with your experience. Please know we have addressed your concerns about room conditions and breakfast pricing with our leadership team. Hope to welcome you back again in the future should you return to the area.
Thank you.

name: Htrav6
text: 3 nights starting 10/22/19.  All electrical items worked.  Tub & sink drained well.  This is a nice-looking hotel in a good location; however, a good night's sleep is the most important thing to us, and the hotel failed on that.  The double beds sunk to the middle so badly that  comfortable sleeping was impossible; we ended up using both beds and sleeping separately.  Also, bathroom counter space was insufficient.  Given the name and price ($145/night) of this hotel, we expected a much more comfortable stay.

resp.text:
Thank you for taking the time to review your recent experience. We greatly appreciate all feedback as it assists us in learning where to focus our improvements. I am sorry to read that we did not meet your expectations on this occasion. We very much hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back in the future so that we can earn back your trust.
Best regards,
Bill, GM

name: Robin Varghese
text: Great stay..clean and comfy stay..great view of the lake. Breakfast was great though expensive but was a big portion and worth the price.

name: Robert Martin
text: Nice hotel with good proximity to the NASA Space Center.

name: J Freeza
text: Condo suite was amazing. Pool was nice n clean. Breakfast was out of this world good!!

name: Treva Askey
text: Excellent hotel for the price. Nice rooms with friendly staff and love the lake views.

name: Craig Bower
text: Great suites and Awesome service!

name: Edward Reeves
text: Stayed a night for a business trip. Clean rooms, nice staff. Food was good, but a little high on price for what you get . Easy access to NASA.

resp.text:
Dear Mr. Reeves,
Thank you for taking the time to review your experience. We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back on your next visit to the area.
Best regards,
Bill, GM

name: Natanael Rodriguez
text: Great place to stay, super friendly employees, and resolved all my doubts.  I arrived at 6:00 and went out to dinner.  I called to ask for a bottle of wine to my room and upon arrival there was the bottle with 2 glasses and a rose.

name: Carol Sorola
text: Room was beautiful, bed was very comfortable and so were the sheets. My only problem was that when I showered, the water wouldn’t go down. It would take a while for it to go down the drain once I was all done. Other than that, I enjoyed my stay.

name: Aaron Alton
text: Beautiful hotel, friendly staff, and super close to NASA. I love it a lot. Rooms could be a bit bigger, but it's all good

name: Zachary Hill
text: The hotel was definitely over priced. The entire hotel is disgustingly humid. Everything smelled like must. Just gross

name: Michael Goffney
text: A great weekend

resp.text:
Mr. Goffney

Thank you for your review.  We hope to see you again soon.

Yours in service,

Bill Dalleske
General manager

name: Megan Morrow
