name: David Bines
text:
Food is actually really good one they get the order right. Third times the charm. Had to send our food back twice since our waiter kept taking our order down wrong. Asked for the Drum BLT with no changes and it took two tries and about thirty minutes.

Edit: Jesus the mngr saw something was wrong and completely rectified the problem. A+ customer service.

name: Ryan Dickinson
text:
Great location in Discovery Green. Really liked the menu and was here for restaurant weeks.. which by the way they offer an incredible deal for HRW if you're looking for a great restaurant to check out.

Great food options.. fresh and delicious

name: Gustavo Camacho
text: The flavor amazing, we had the Blue Crab Corn Fritters and Ahi Tuna Aguachiles as appetizers and the a double cheeseburger with a side of the biggest Asparagus I have ever seen. Everything was on point. The service incredible and the again food was amazing... and to top it off 1/2 happy hour... yes sir coming back.

name: DL Yepez
text: The vibe is laid back. Customer service great. The cheeseburger was delicious.  The 2 cheese charcuterie yummmmm...parking tricky.

name: Juliana Malysheva
text: Service was excellent and food- delicious.

name: L C
text: Yes & yes & yes. Food, yes. Service, yes. Atmosphere, yes. What a gem in the middle of the city. Marcus is the best in the business. Try the avocado toast. People watch until your heart is content.

name: Agustin Diaz
text: Nice vibe, amazing mood. The food is delicious and they put a lot of attention on the details! The service is pretty good too. The location is amazing, right by the discovery green and the convention center. They have valet parking for $9.

name: Maricela Olivo
text: Houston restaurant week at The Grove! They did not have hummus, so we added oysters and tuna ceviche to our appetizers. The tuna ceviche was season well and very tasty. My favorite dish was the shrimp stir fry! So good! The ambiance was pleasant. I was not a fan of the Italian Red wine; it was too acidic for my taste. We ordered a bottle of Ghostrunner wine, that was better.

name: amith ram
text: Fantastic place to grab a bite to eat or sip on cocktails overlooking lush discovery green scenery through celing to floor windows.

name: Heather Deelena
text: We had brunch here at The Grove and it was literally the best food ever! Try the French toast -- it is heaven!!! Simone was our waitress and she had an infectious personality, it made the experience that much better. I recommend this brunch for a date spot. One amazing thing is you pay $15 for refillable drinks with 1 cent refills! One thing to note is that gratuity is already included.

name: Erica Lewis
text: Our food was very delicious and the wait staff was extremely pleasant. I loved the ambience and pricing was great. Such a nice place in the Discovery area!

name: Keith
text: This place is amazing! If you want a great culinary experience; you gotta check out The Grove! We had the blue crab mac and cheese + the absolutely amazing truffle fries. Every item we ordered was fantastic and you cant go wrong at this place!

name: Ellis Hubbard
text: The Shrimp & Seafood Roll plus a good New Fashioned started my weekend off right!

name: J777 999
text: Sunday..Brunch. It is just okay...you can find better options for such value. $35.

name: Travel Girl
text: Amazing experience and so tasty food. I loved It! The service is stunning.

name: Stacy Audirsch
text: The food was fantastic. Small portions for prices but a beautiful location and ambiance.

name: Martina Holmes
text: Good atmosphere but over priced mostly. Go during happy hour 3-6

name: Sarah Green
text: Great atmosphere. Great service. Expensive.

name: James Lefeber
text: Great service. Kind staff.

name: Rashed Al-Mudahka
text:
Perfect restaurant with no mistake at all.
Delicious food, server is too friendly, served the food quickly and great place.
Highly recommended this restaurant.

name: Mario Kato
text:
Great place for Dinner. Great service and fast seating. Had the Beef Belly plate. The BBQ sauce was a little too much for the portion of beef presented. Nice views of the park. Beer and wine list had a well rounded selection. Ended the dinner with a very good pomegranate ginger sorbet (Amazing!!!)
Family friendly.

name: Andrew Ruggles
text: Every time I come here I'm impressed.  The food, service, and ambiance are always on point.  I usually come with a big party and each time they handle the madness with grace.  If the weather is nice I recommend sitting outside as it has one of the coolest locations in downtown Houston.  The price of entrees varies so you can usually find something in your budget but the quality of food is great no matter what comes out on your plate.  Come enjoy!

name: Evelyn Diaz Reyes
text: Friendly staff, great menu items. We stopped by really quick and wanted to go back but ran out of time. Would return the next time we are in Houston.

name: Dennis Garrett
text: New American gem in Discovery Green Park. Innovative dishes, craft cocktails. Trendy crowd.

name: Joey Sullivan
text: I didn't want an entree so I asked for guacamole and vegetables to dip. The melody of colors and vegetable selection was amazing. Also there were very generous with their guacamole portiob. The wait staff were very professional and accommodating. Classy ambiance.

name: Gail m
text: ....this place is absolutely fantastic! Gourmet food at great prices, with a very friendly staff!   Awesome flavors, great prices and wonderful staff! Picture is of Brisket Eggs Benedict during the Sunday Brunch. You won't be d... recommend! 🍏🌶🍞🍄🥒🍔🥗🍲🥓🍤🥂🍸🥃🥛

name: Mohamed Elwan
text: Great food and service! Went for Valentine's and the wife was very happy. The restaurant is in Discovery Green so after dinner walks are awesome.

name: Justin Wong
text: Order the truffle fries and the pork chop... you won’t regret it. Also, ask for EJ as your waiter... simply the best

name: Derek Hoskins
text:
Simone was my server and she is awesome! Great recommendations, great service, and very friendly!
I had the chicken caesar and red sangria based on her recommendations on my questions and everything was perfect!  We will be back to see you Simone!

name: Gabie Woodard
text: Down town at night is really not a place that I like to go to in Houston, but Groves gave us an opportunity to experience great food and a great service. Although, I did not care for the location I certainly would consider going back. The appetizers were very good, guacamole, beet hummus and vegetables. Although it was not on the menu, they graciously made a pomegranate Martine for me. Everyone was trying to be as helpful as possible. Texas hospitality is nice to experience

name: Casey Bergeron
text: Really nice restaurant  right in the heart of the downtown  Houston area.  Great location and great food.  Works really well for a location to host parties at.  I go here about twice a year,  when I find myself in the area, and it has always been an excellent experience.

name: Anita Price
text: Consistently good food with interesting twists. Large dining room manages to not be sterile or impersonal.

name: Angel Charles-Roberts
text: I absolutely loved this place! The ambiance was wonderful. Interior design was bright, colorful, modern and inviting. I was celebrating my birthday with about 22 friends. Everyone loved the food. They were very accommodating to our group. EJ, our server, was the BEST. He was super friendly and catered to our needs. I had the Black Drum and it was mouthwatering.  I found the Blue Crab mac n cheese to be irresistible. I even ordered some to go.They gave me a dessert of my choosing and sang Happy Birthday (facilitated by EJ). The only smear to this otherwise amazing night, was the fact that one of the managers spilled sauce on my husband while serving our food and he (the manager)offered his business card to help with cleaning if it didn't come out. I felt that he could have offered to comp his meal or even mine, since it was a bday celebration and there were 22 people in the party.  Seemed really cheesy to me that my husband had to bring it up. They did end up comping (taking off) my drink, so that was at least something. Overall it was a GREAT night and I will definitely be back.

name: felice simmons
text: I love their soups and veggie dishes

name: Mike Hicks
text: Good burgers and cocktails

name: Debra Benton
text: I'm only going to rate the customer service because I did not get a chance to eat there.  The valet guy was extreemly courteous.  We made a reservation for dinner after hour event in walking distance at GRB. After arriving to the event location we realized we were in the wrong building completely we were in the wrong part of town. So we headed back cancel their reservation receive the car and went on. The find stars goes to the staff at the Grove.  We were not dressed appropriately for the restaurant and they did not  Say anything to us. They were extremely friendly in made wonderful small chat while we were making our reservation. There are 2 different menus a lunch menu in a dinner menu. So when you book your reservation be clear on which menu you are going to be offered. I would say this restaurant is great for date night or in evening out with special friends.

name: Greg S
text: Nice variety and good flavors. Very accommodating to dietary needs. Excellent service, thanks again Rick. Nice setting in Discovery Green Park. Will definitely come back.

name: Aerial Washington
text: Loved the red fish blt!!

name: India Chatman
text: Super disappointed in the service my guest and I received. When I booked the reservation for a party of 20-25 guest! It endeavors up being a little less. There was no one in the restaurant so I’m not sure why our waiter took 10-15 minutes just to take our drink orders. He comes back even later and starts taking orders only to lead with yeah the kitchen will be closing soon. When I booked the reservation I told them I would have a photographer comes and is there anywhere I can take pictures... the manager on duty said no even though it was a birthday celebration and told my photographer he charged a fee to take pictures on the stairway. No one made me aware of all of this when I asked two weeks in advance when placing the reservation. Menu was super limited! I’m just completely disappointed in the upscale restaurant. I have no plans on ever going back

name: Kasia Zajac
text: Absolutely best place for a quality time with delicious food

name: Torri Andrews
text: Horrible drink service, horrible cold food. The only positive was my waitress Emily!! The grove needs to do a better job with their whole staff!

resp.text: Torri - we are so sorry you didn't enjoy your experience!  We strive to ensure the absolute best for everyone.  Reach out to our GM, Jody Fiess, and he'd love to set you up for another try!

name: kat win
text: My husband and I love coming here! They have a great charcuterie board and drinks and the view is beautiful with nothing but floor to ceiling windows of Discovery Green. Then you can go play and explore in Discovery Green and downtown! There is always something going on. Good location next to convention center and Hilton, too, among other hotels. At least go once!

name: Akram Rabah
text: The food was not tasty and the margarita tall glass of ice and water. Dessert was basic and the grapes look old. Wonder why the place was busy. Maybe me. Also $10 for parking. There are definitely many better choices in Houston.

name: Deven Fomby
text: An absolute jewel of Houston

name: Robert E. Svoboda
text: Went there for having a snack-type meal but I noticed some tasty dishes, and so I decided to come here again for lunch someday. They use fresh and healthy materials in cooking all the food items. Smoked Salmon, Blue Crab Mac are some popular dishes here.

name: LeiRoi Daniels
text: Great atmosphere and courteous service

name: Qimar Alfasi
text: If you have the $$ come here. Great food and great drinks

name: Heath LaCoss
text: The Grove is always a pleasure.  The food is great, the drinks are great, the atmosphere is great. The parking at the valet stand can be chaotic.

name: Gaurav Ghoge
text:
Great place for lunch or dinner in downtown - next to Discovery Green.

Done a few work events in the evenings and Grove has a good collection of drinks.

Love the food here. They have changed the menu and I miss one of my favorite items on the menu. Nonetheless whatever is on the menu now is great as well.

Recommend sitting in their outside seating during fall and winter and enjoy views of Discovery Green

name: Jorge L. Flores
text: Very great place eat! Great staff and customer service.

name: Mason Cruz
text: Decent food and friendly wait staff. Came here for restaurant week and ordered the steak. It was ok. Could have been a bit more seasoned. Salad was well plated and tasty. I really enjoyed the chicken tortilla soup as well. Great place to come to people watch. Located right by discovery green makes it a great location.

name: Anna Espinoza
text: The food is absolutely delicious. We ordered appetizers (bread with butter & chips and queso) and 3 entrees (salmon, shrimp primavera, petite beef tenderloin). Food is very expensive though. Each entree ranges from $25-$35.

name: carlos dejesus
text: Good food, over priced. They charge 5.00 for bread and butter... when most restaurants give it away. For the price, food needed to be amazing... and it was just good. Server was excellent!

name: Beau Valdez
text: Went here for a catered party. Great atmosphere and staff were so attentive to me and my family as well as all the other 100 or so guests.  Amazing food as well.

name: Melinda Magee
text: Was good. Loved the  Crab fritters.

name: Rolanda Lewis
text: The food was amazing. The waiter was very attentive. I would recommend this place to anyone. It was date night for us and the Grove made that night extra special.

name: Michael Roberts
text: Really amazing lunch, great food and service, atmosphere perfect. I had the grilled pork sandwich and it was fantastic. Everybody was happy with their food. Also, price/value really well balanced. Will definitely go there a lot more often.

name: Perla Reyes
text: The staff is so nice and the food is delicious. I will definitely be coming back for brunch.

name: Christen Powers
text: Lunch with a dear friend was lovely.  Good menu choices, lovely view, awesome service!  Overall a great experience!

name: Jim Long
text: We had a wonderful time, having a cocktail and appetizer, great service from Laura our bartender!!

name: Nick Beam
text: ran out of what we wanted the most when there was still over 2 hours of brunch left. flies on the food (to be expected for an open-top buffet, i guess?) views we're nice, food was mediocre for what you could find elsewhere in the neighborhood but if you're hungry, you'll definitely manage to get bang for your buck. service was fantastic otherwise. may check this out for non-buffet food. $15 drinks with 1¢ refills were also a great deal if you're ready to drink.

name: Nitin Kashyap
text:
Didn't enjoy my visit here. Portion sizes are small and do not justify the price tag. My friend and I sat at the bar before a Rockets game and had to wait for a while for service. I would have sent the sandwich back if I was not late for the game.

The best think about the night was that the rockets won in overtime. I will not be going back.

name: Linda Uhegwu
text: Undoubtedly my best restaurant and birthday dinner yet.  I enjoyed myself immensely! Felt like royalty, came back again a week later for their amazing food.  The full package!!! And afterward you can always take a stroll at the discovery green!!! Totally worth it!!

name: Michael Sung
text: Great place for a nightcap

name: Paul Dawson
text:
Great food, fantastic atmosphere.  Recently went to enjoy the spring temps.  Waitress graciously gave warning of the "pollen storm" from the live oaks and to feel free to move inside if needed...which we did.
Appreciated the waitress looking out for us and for the great food and experience just inside mother nature's springtime action.
Always a great bet for date nights taking in the city views and some great food.

name: Fernando Mladineo
text:
TLDR; started off with problems and ended on a good note. Would try again.

We arrived about 15 minutes late because of traffic from the Woodlands; we notified the restaurant that we would be late and they said that was fine. We showed up and they said that they had no tables in the main dining and they gave us this table that wasn’t typical place for eating but rather for sitting while waiting for a table. I wasn’t too pleased.

The manager came over to apologize and offered complimentary appetizers. He made sure we had fast service as we had a concert to attend at the Toyota center and made up for the initial bad experience. Will have to try again when we have more time. The salmon was delicious! My wife thought the petite filet and it was good, but not great.  Lastly, it was very loud inside, so if that bothers you, I would find somewhere else or eat outside.

name: Tim Downing
text: I've been to the Grove a few times for a conference social.  It had an excellent vibe and has space for both louder and quieter socializing.  The food is higher end (as conference socials go) and the staff is passionate.  The bar staff is attentive, which is especially nice for a busy open bar at a networking event.

name: Trina Taylor
text: Great atmosphere, awesome location and A-1 customer service. Friendly environment.  The food was fresh, full of favor and well prepared.

name: Humberto Lewis
text: The shrimp corndogs is great plus the Salmon and nachos. Nice comfortable place to have a drink and eat at. The staff are nice also.

name: Ben Winfree
text: Finger foods are good, during happy hour drinks are strong at a great price.

name: George Smith
text: Outstanding lunch spot. Food and service was excellent. Very reasonably priced. Nice leisurely pace.

name: Marc Maxwell
text: Great Ambience, Food & Service.  Try the lobster mac & cheese and ask for E.J.  for your server.  He makes the evening!

name: magda swisher
text:
Not what I expected. Late lunch last Saturday, after a visit to GRB exhibit, JURASSIC PARK.

I had the wedge. Was refreshing but the dressing was a little weak.

My husband had the BLT. He had requested extra crispy bacon, didn't get it the first time; it was mediocre, after he got it back the second time.
---------------------
A few years ago, we had dinner there, which was delicious.

name: Michael Randall
text: We walked into The Grove expecting it to be expensive. We didn't expect to find affordable prices and great food with a wonderful patio that overlooks the park. We were able to sit outside and enjoy the beautiful weather while enjoying great food and drinks. We have been back multiple times in the last year. It has become one of our favorite spots when we come down into Houston.

name: Tracy W.
text: Great atmosphere, excellent food and good waitstaff.  I definitely enjoyed the extensive brunch selection.  The bottomless mimosas, mojitos, margaritas as well as red and white sangrias were worth the price of the entire meal. The only negative was there were times were it appeared that the entire waitstaff vanished for 10 minutes. Other than that, I definitely will be coming back!!!

name: Nick Frazier
text: Fantastic location next to Discovery Green. Lots of nearby metered parking (free after 6pm). Great place to meet after work. Also nice to show non-locals a prettier face to Houston. Good selection of beers and appetizers.

name: Mel A. P.
text:
My mum wanted to have Easter brunch together this year so I thought we could go to a place that I knew had great food and a lovely view. It was my first visit for brunch and my mum's first visit period. The brunch selection was more than I expected, and as a vegetarian I was pleased that there was plenty for me to choose from.

The waiter was wonderful! He treated us as if we were the only ones in the restaurant. My mum just loved it. She decided to call him "Bear"  due to the paw print tattoos on his arm, lol 🤦.

name: Abhishek Prabhu
text: Nothing great to write about the food.  Had a few beers with grilled trout.  Tasted bland.  Portions do not match the price - so not Texas.

name: Marisa Collura
text: Great place to stop by for lunch and have a relaxing time. The food was delicious! I had the smokehouse burger and they did not disappoint. I love stopping by here when I go to conventions at the George R. brown center.

name: FlammB
text: Phenomenal, try the tuna tartare, it will not disappoint! Great happy hour menu, good whiskey selection.  Amazing atmosphere and service!

name: Jaiden Itiss
text: Brought my fiancé here for her birthday dinner! Place was amazing dinner lights, casual vibes, food A1 quality. Reservations are available online. Walking distance to parking garages if you don’t feel like dealing with traffic and congested valet. Drinks and alcohol are impeccable. Food was served professionally and suited our expectations. Waiter was awesome! If your looking for a date, night out with friends, colleagues, Friday night out with a loved one, special occasions this is the place to go to. It’s a bit pricey but you get what you pay for and won’t regret the time being.

name: Alex Young
text: The food, decor, service at the table and atmosphere are great here. The only issue was when standing at the hostess stand waiting to be seated, I was conversing with the manager. It's date night for my wife and I so I'm dressed up wearing a tie. I noticed the manager was wearing one as well with a very neat, tidy knot at the top of his tie. Making conversation while the hostess sorted out which table to seat us at, I noted how envious I was of how much better his knot looked. His response to me is "I don't buy cheap department store ties." This is a restaurant that does many things very well. We were just surprised that a guest's attire would be insulted as it was. I doubt it was intended to come across as it did and it didn't ruin my opinion of the restaurant but it's something to take note of.

name: Laura Haskovec
text: The food is delicious and very interesting! The atmosphere is nice, and there were some kids enjoying the food, as well. Parking is street with meter. Recommend paying for the valet.

name: Daniela Morales
text: My family and I had just enjoyed listening to the Houston Symphony and decided to try this place for lunch for the first time. We sat down and waited for our server. I was a server while I was in college in a restaurant very similar to this one in the Galleria, and I know that sometimes servers are busy or were double sat, so I am usually very patient. 10 minutes passed with no one stopping at our table to even get our drink order. The restaurant wasn't busy and after seeing two other tables get sat and have their drink orders taken, I realized we were just being ignored. We would have left, but our kids were hungry and we didn't want to drive somewhere else at that point. I let the manager know and he finally took our drink and food orders. The food was fine and they did comp our appetizer because of the wait. In the end though, we probably won't return. The restaurant itself is beautiful, food was good, but the staff lacks the welcoming and friendly hospitality that I expect from a restaurant like this.

name: Ronald Beam
text: We dined at The Grove New Years Eve. The food was excellent as was the service. Would definitely go back. The restaurant is within Discovery Green in Houston. Wonderful views through the floor to ceiling windows.

name: Amber Bonds
text: Wasn’t very busy around 2 on a Friday. The Tuna Poke Salad was delicious! My friends enjoyed their beet hummus and double patty burgers!

name: Katt Tulani
text: Went for a wedding which turned out to be a beautiful event. Took place on the rooftop in the evening. The lighting really spruced up the ambiance. There was a plenty and variety of seating available. There's also a bar and restroom on second floor as well as a elevator. Bride took photos in chariot then on stairwell. Food was really good. Staff was superb!

name: Scott Gadd
text:
I went to The Grove for lunch earlier this afternoon and ordered a B.A.L.T (bacon, avocado, lettuce and tomato) sandwich with a side salad for $12. It was a simple and delicious sandwich.

The valet is a bit pricey ($10) but the service was prompt and polite.

My friend and I wanted to sit on the second floor patio but, it was already booked for a private event.  So, we settled on the first floor patio on this beautiful spring Houston day.

The ambiance of establishment is refreshing but the outdoor patio tables could use an upgrade, as they felt cheap, plastic and unbalanced (not a  big game changer but worth noting).

The views of Discovery green are spectacular and I would highly recommend this establishment for a business lunch.

name: Maria Reyes
text: I love there banana pudding tiramisu.

name: Daniel Marklin
text: One of my favorite spots to take friends and family when they come into town. The place has an intimate but relaxed atmosphere right near the park, a delicious "new american" menu, and a moderate price for "upscale dining."

name: Daren McCurdy
text: This is a nice place. Pretty classy with good food and drinks.

name: Patti Westbrook
text: The location is excellent.  The food and drink selections have something for everyone.  Don't pass up the homemade sparkling water!  It is the best in town.  Beautiful inside and a great outdoor seating area, too.

name: J Ortiz
text: Cool place for valentines. Will be returning laid back yet sophisticated. Drinks on point. Comfortable in my Jordan's too**

name: Janice Webster
text: The food was fantastic and  the ambiance was amazing! The reason I gave a 4 rating is because the waiter messed up our bill by adding another table food on our bill. He corrected the error but added a meal to our bill that belong to our guest. I definitely recommend this place for great food and dining.

name: Amber Bonds
text: Wasn’t very busy around 2 on a Friday. The Tuna Poke Salad was delicious! My friends enjoyed their beet hummus and double patty burgers!

name: Melissa Groetsch
text: Excellent place for lunch.  Moderate prices.

name: Jay C
text: I was looking for a restaurant that had good decor and great food. That is exactly what I found in the Grove. The staff were very attentive and pleasant though out our stay. You would not have believed that they were working understaffed. Marvin is definitely the guy to talk to if you come here. The best manager EVER. Come through and enjoy bottomless mimosas til 3p on Sunday.

name: FABIOLA DUENAS
text: Absolutely the most MAGNIFICENT staff and service EVER.  They were creative, intuitive, servaisuve and just on point!   We held our wedding in the Primavera room on 5/25/2019 and almost of our guests were floored at the unique service they provided.  Each had a great service story!  One kiddo asked for unicorn tears and waiter brought her pearl chocolate drops!  Done!  I mean really !?!?!?   Thank you for making our guests know how special they are.  God bless all the staff that shared this special evening with us. ♡

name: Tonia Lachapelle
text: Loved the atmosphere and location right at the park.  Our server was amazing, and so were the truffle fries!😉

name: Hannah Brewer
text: Great service with super attentive wait staff. Everyone enjoyed their entrees at my table. The petit beef tender was so good - the cut of meat was beautiful and the mustard sauce perfectly tied together the beef, sweet potato, and arugula. The only people at my table who seemed to enjoy their dessert were the ones who ordered the fried pie - so I would skip the dessert or order the pie. The location is awesome. Beautifully lit and picturesque garden right outside the glass walls made for a nice atmosphere. Right downtown and central to a lot of locations. Was happy with the valet service.

name: Jimmy Wyble
text: Great power lunch locations and the food was fantastic too

name: Kalyan Pothineni
text: Good service, food was awesome. Burgers are juicy and nice flavor. Truffle fries are must try. Nice view to the green

name: Alvaro Diaz
text: Good drinks nice place

name: Ames Onthuam
text: Dinner for two was great. Dining atmosphere and service were wonderful. Pork steak was tender and delicious.

name: Jurnee
text: Trendy place. Good service

name: Victoria Seibert
text: Mouth watering food, great drinks, excellent service and all around nice atmosphere.  Perfect for drinks with friends, or a nice night out with family.

name: Yeymi Gomez
text: I love going to brunch on a Sunday. The decor is nice and the atmosphere is really good. There is so many good choices on food there.

name: Alexis Chai
text:
I came here for a work function and the food was surprisingly decent.

The fried oysters impressed me. I will have to come back for personal dining.

Note to the girls — the floor boards have gaps in them, so my stiletto heels got stuck a couple times. Wear thick heels/flats when you come here.

name: P Hok
text: The service was not that great. The roasted chicken, one piece was delicious the other one was little dried. I asked for them to separate the side vegetables, the waitress seemed to have a problem with that.

name: Jisu D
text:
Was there today for a Team lunch. The food was okay and well managed place.

Nothing exceptional

name: Dawn Callahan
text: Lived here for three years and didn't venture over to The Grove until Super Bowl 51 pulled us their for work. Great atmosphere! Great customer service! Great food! Will return very soon ☺

name: Hoi Polloi
text: Good atmosphere. For was good, but smaller portions for the price.

name: Bryan Alvarado
text: Amazing table service and food. Great customer service. Would visit again.

name: Chris P.
text:
Came for happy hour for the first time,  by accident,  and it was great. Good cocktails,  $6 mojitos etc
Good food too
You will be impressed

name: C. Paul Courtney
text: The Grove is an extremely nice establishment.  The staff, ambience, and decor are near perfect.  However, the food is just so-so.  In my opinion, they try too hard to make their menu unique.  That's appreciated but what's even more appreciated is focusing on the flavors.

name: H B
text: Great food and service! Our waiter E.J. was fantastic and the atmosphere is nice and laid back on the patio!

name: Adam H
text:
Food is very good.  Walking distance from the George R Brown convention center.

I first came after a conference at the GRB and have made it a tradition to grab lunch here when attending conferences.

Best place for lunch within walking distance of the GRB.  Don't be pressured into the not so good food stands in the GRB.  Do yourself a solid and Google/GPS and walk here for your lunch break.

name: Muntaser Zaheer
text: We came here for the $20 3-course brunch. It is great and well worth the price if you like to eat. The tastes are unique and not run of the mill. I ordered the poached eggs brisket and the wife got the Shimp n Grits...excellent!

name: Mark Jiro
text: This is a great place to take a date. A little bit pricey but the venue and location make it worth it. I highly recommend the red snapper dish super flavorful and probably one of the best entree on the menu. Drinks are pretty good and after your meal you can take a nice walk around discovery green.

name: Isabelle Cassagnol
text: I had the shrimp and grits, very delicious. The ginger margarita is great. The guacamole is very fresh. Walking distance from discovery green.

name: Travis Kelleher
text: My wife and I had a great time at the Grove.  This was our first time dining there, needless to say this place is now on our top 10 list. The food and drinks were incredible, the hanger steak was the best I've ever had. Cool atmosphere, wonderful staff and awesome food.

name: Brad Thornell
text: Top notch. Friendly staff and great food to try. You will not be disappointed with the drinks or food choices.

name: La La Henderson
text: Love this little restaurant in the Discovery Green Park. Every Seat is a great seat in my opinion. The waitstaff is well trained and the food is delicious. A solid place to bring out of towners.

name: Samuel Brannon
text: Wonderful location. Waitstaff is pretty good. Very busy and a bit noisy. But the bar is fully stocked and the food is wonderful. They have vegetarian options as well.

name: Joel Braswell
text:
First trip was a 1 star. Ambiance was nice. Food was good but the menu was a little limited, Main entrees are pretty expensive. My SO and I each ordered a glass of wine. My SO's came with a dead cricket floating in it. At least that's what they said it was, I didn't look too closely. The restaurant replaced both glasses with a different variety, but they didn't seem too concerned about it, and they never even said "sorry about that!". There are a lot of nice restaurants in Houston, so no need to ever go back to this one.

My second trip in early Jan of 2019 was 5+ stars. We were upstairs for a wedding and reception afterwards. Everything was top notch, food was delicious, hot, and served to the right people, quite a feat considering the size of the event. Staff were very professional and friendly. The venue is very nice.

name: Teresa Milner
text: Atmosphere is nice. The ribeye steak was horrible. Thin with lots of gristle. Too expensive for that quality

name: Antonio Barrett
text: After hearing and seeing a lot of good comments from others, my family and I finally found the time to eat a dinner here. Seating and drinks did not take long, and the wait staff was kinda, friendly and welcoming. Before our food arrived, I glanced into the small glass of cream for the coffee I ordered, and there was some form of vegetable puree smeared along the side of it.  I realized after having already sipped my coffee some, at first i thought maybe it was a stain, but as I ran my finger over it it built up and was rather put off by it. The problem was immediately resolved, and I was poured a cup in a perfectly clear glass right in front of me, by who i can only assume was manager/leader at the time. My food, however was phenomenal. I over all enjoyed my visit, just think that maybe its been hyped up to more then it is.

name: Wyatt Dowling
text: One of the best options for a nice or business lunch in Downtown Houston. Great menu with lots of options that are hard to choose from. Highly recommend.

name: Caitlin B
text: The location is great. The food is good. The staff is less than friendly and the prices are high. The bar is big, but don't think you'll get a good cocktail here. I'd recommend another place in the area for food or drinks.

name: GregR R
text: Limited menu, but the seafood was very well seasoned and tasted great. Good wine list .... had a Bordeaux by the glass that was incredible, and several after-dinner Ports to choose from. Full bar. Valet parking $9. Great ambiance.

name: eric curtner
text: Amazing food and atmosphere.  Everything was so flavorful.

name: joeyb196
text: Bit on the tourist circuit, but the steak was really good.

name: Moderately Weird - Socially Focused
text: The high rating is for the location and ambiance. The food is small in portions and great if you are not that hungry. Tasty, great wine selections. Brunch was a little deceiving online. You can order only off the menu and very limited choices, will not return for brunch but still like general lunch/dinner appetizers and menu.

name: vismay desai
text: Good view and good place. Less option in food for vegetarian. Good place for hangout

name: Zach Hughes
text: Food was ok. Atmosphere was definitely the "this is a high end restaurant" feel to it. It was primarily our waiter that deserves the 3 stars. It felt like he barely acknowledged anything my girlfriend was saying. The burger my girlfriend got was pretty good and I'll leave it at that.

name: b. Altshuler-Pacheco
text: The noise level was so bad that even conversation with the person next to you was difficult.  For the high price a little ambiance might help.

name: Robert Stuart
text: Food was good but not incredible and at its price level it should be.  Parking is a pain even valet can be difficult.  I ended up paying $20 to park across the street even though we needed handicap

name: Marina Bousfield
text: Nice place and service. The food and drinks are good. But some of the options are too small.

name: kiesha laster
text: Fresh Food & Splendid Atmosphere and reasonably priced.

name: Blaine Fuselier
text: This place has some really good food. The atmosphere is really nice! The only problem I have with the restaurant is that the menu is small, and the seem to change the menu a lot! Sucks if you had a favorite menu item.

name: cbetn42
text: Wonderful restaurant in the cover of the large old oaks.  Food was great again.

name: Eduardo De La Cruz
text: The service is extremely unwelcoming. The host seemed more interested in talking to each other than identifying me as a guest. I walked in through the big glass door into the bar area and was not greeted by the bartender. I sat at a table by the window and the server was just an order taker. No suggestions or advice in what to get. The lobster roll was okay but not great and I told her that. She did nothing but offer to replace and not find out why I didn't like it. Just not wowed. Great look but not impressed.

text: Lovely place,  Good food, small portions ,

name: Arche Solutions
text: Recently went to a wedding here.  It was fantastic.  The bride still brags about how she was completely satisfied with everything.  As simply a guest, I can say it was great.

name: Steven Capuozzo

name: Nathan White
text: Great atmosphere great food great service

name: Yvonne Villegas
text: The menu was a bit limited but the burger we had there was amazing. Great little place for food and a drink before strolling around discovery green for their holiday installations. They accept reservations via open table, we made one just in case.

name: Jimmy Maddox
text:
My first visit was 4 years ago with high-end clients.
It was a good experience.
However this year I returned to get something to eat for lunch.
I wanted a to-go order.

Thank goodness I didn’t have clients to impress because the food was awful.

This visit was on November 26th about 1:20pm . I needed to get back to work across the street at the Hilton Americas as I was in town visiting from San Antonio working a LIVE conference event.

So I ordered the pastrami Reuben sandwich. She came back 2 minutes later and said that the kitchen didn’t have the food to make it. Great.

Then I ordered the Grove cheeseburger to go ....
I thought I was safe with that.

Well, big mistake.
I hadn’t eaten a more greasier hamburger since 1981.
The french fries well, they were soaked.
In grease.
I took two bites and I couldn’t stomach it. I chunked it.
$13 pissed away.

name: Puerto Rican Amazon
text: It was ok. I asked for my steak to be med well came kinda bloody.... Good thing this was a work outing i might have been a little upset. I just dont send back food you never know..

name: Glen Bertalotto
text: The Grove excellent restaurant Beautiful People beautiful food your chance to check them out

name: Chris Hopkins
text: Upscale dining experience in the heart of downtown. Fantastic food and drinks that are great for a mid week happy hour after work.

name: Olga Magana
text: This place deserves a zero! The wait staff is argumentive. The manager so did not care. She made us feel like we are stupid. She can make us feel like we belonged some place else. Like we are out of place. I would never recommend this place at all. Don't listen to the radio not the T.V.

name: e johnson
text: Beautifully decorated, great ambiance. My friend and I had drinks and dinner at the bar. The bartenders were very attentive and adhered to my muddle-blueberry prosecco request. That was good. I had the salmon salad, it was prepared very well. There was a lot of greens, more greens than salmon.

name: James M
text:
Disappointing food.
The crab Mac n cheese was very heavy and salty, and the trout overcooked and lacking any taste but salt.
Came here a few years ago and the food was much better.
Would not recomend.

name: Arturo Garcia
text: Thank you. Thank you for being such a wonderful spot in the heart of downtown

name: Julie L.
text:
Their Sunset at the Grove event is awesome however, every Wednesday from 5:30-8 during the summer. Unfortunately they rush you off the pleasant patio at 8, but other than that it's great.

I would not come here for regular dinner - looks overpriced.

name: Nathan Cragun
text: You'll notice that most reviews center on the architecture, the building, or the ambiance rather than the quality of the food. The food is good, definitely better than your average bar. I know it's not a bar, but for some reason that's the vibe I get every time I'm there (I've been for work a number of times). I would not recommend the steak. Some of their other food, however, is fantastic. Overall I would say it's not quite worth the spendy price.

name: Jonathan Vaknine

name: cic
text: This review is for the tree house happy hour. The happy hour drink menu consists of wines, cocktails and bottom shelf beers. I ordered a mojito and was completely underwhelmed with the bartenders rendition. Two bartenders one cashier but no cue line to avoid confusion. So on top of a mediocre cocktails we also received frustrated service shooing us out of the way.   I’m also assuming people aren’t allowed in the treehouse past 7 because as we were leaving the manger was turning folks away. This happy hour seems forced .

text: Seriously good eats. Had a party of 4 for lunch and the overall experience was good. Got mushroom mac and cheese for the table and we loved it! We all got different things and everything turned out great. I personally had the roasted pork loin melt and it was delicious. The fries were fantastic, too. I think maybe I would have enjoyed the burger more, but I wanted to try something different. Lastly, we had the Tiramisu and it was gooooood. You should know that it does cost a pretty penny, so personally, I'd go once in a blue moon. It was worth it, though!

I forgot the fish fritters... Oh my! They were really wonderful.  There were a variety of breakfast items, breads, salads, other entrees and desserts.  The brunch price included soft drinks, BUT I wish some type of juice was included!!!!  I will return

text:
Came here with family to celebrate my husband's birthday, and we had a great time. We were a bit late getting to our reservation, but they seated the guests as they arrived as well as received my husband's cakes when they were delivered. Our waiter was very patient and informative about the menu and wine choices/pairings. We ordered an array of food ranging from curried butternut squash soup to various types of grilled fish. The grilled fish in parchment was quite meaty and well cooked.
Mostly, we all loved the ambiance of The Grove and great views of Discovery Green. Oh, and another note, I really appreciated that the valet was not ridiculously expensive (only $8), and they even backed our SUV out so that we wouldn't have to maneuver that thing around in such a small area. I'd definitely return!

name: Stacy Newton
text: My companion & I ordered & ate our food & later ended up moving to a table when friends of our arrived after we did..we moved to their table & ended up being charged the extra gratuity on our tab as if we were with their party from the beginning..we called after noticing this & were told the gratuity would be charged back to our CC & that never happened...

resp.text: Stacy, we sincerely apologize for your inconvenience.  Per policy, we do add gratuity of 20% to parties of 6 or more, regardless of table or diner movement.  This policy ensures we have the best staff giving the most exemplary service possible, and given the majority of reviews, we feel they're worth it!  However, we would be happy to rectify if you feel our policy was unjust in your particular circumstance.  Please call and ask to speak to the GM directly.

text: I have been here several times for happy hour events and always have enjoyed myself. The food has been consistently delicious and the atmosphere beautiful. I finally went for a true sit-down meal this weekend. My friends and I had the Houston Restaurant Weeks brunch menu and could hardly decide with the array of choices. There were a few hiccups during the meal, although not big enough to lessen my rating. My boyfriend's food arrived cold but that was quickly corrected and the bottomless mimosas were slightly slow to be refilled at times. All in all, if you are looking for a trendy restaurant with unique and tasty dishes plus a beautiful view and environment, I would definitely consider The Grove.

name: J. P.
text:
By far, the best restaurant experience I have had, from food to service.

My beautiful wife and I came here for her 21st birthday (no, we don't drink alcohol, if you were curious) and what a celebration it was, thanks in part to The Grove and Gage, our waiter.

The decor and location are modern and pure excellence. In the midst of Discovery Green park, the entire 25 foot North wall is solid glass, providing a wonderful view of the park.

For food, we had the wild mushroom mac + cheese (picked from their fresh rooftop garden), tomato bisque and a perfectly cooked Filet Mignon with a inventive potato mash.

For dessert, Gage placed a tall/thin candle in our Banana Tiramisu, with an edible chocolate "Happy Birthday" note.

The bill matches the high attention to detail and flavor of the food and service. Such a great treat if you're near the area, or want a flawless dining experience.

text: Its good. Burger was good, nothing special for the price.

name: Yvette Alafa

text: Highly recommended,  amazing place, food and service.

name: Gristle & Gossip
text:
I enjoy The Grove but oddly had never been for lunch just happy hour. Great Lunch spot, if you can get there and park. If you work downtown why aren't you here already?

This is a busy place during lunch and it's tricky if you don't work downtown to find a parking space because most of it is street parking should you not wish to valet.

Make a lunch reservation would be best for big groups, 2-3 person party's should be fine.

The Soup & Salad option for 14.00 is the best deal I saw and what I ordered. The CHICKEN POZOLE VERDE is AMAZING and the house made tostone was a yummy add. The BABY ARUGULA was a great pairing with the soup and the pecan made it shine even brighter.

name: Cory Edds
text:
Granted the food and atmosphere were amazing...I would not recommend for dinner.  There are plenty of other unique healthy options for nice meals in downtown Houston...don't waste your time here.

We went for dinner last night however and the staff seemed highly uncoordinated.  Service was poor (e.g., not offered a wine list, knives not replaced prior to main course being delivered, waters not provided), and slow (e.g., we had a table for 6 at 8pm...initially when we arrived (at 8 on the dot) they had to look around to see if a table was available for us.  After getting seated it was 8:35 by the time our drink order arrived, and 8:45 by the time we got to order our meals.)

On a redeeming note, for lunch they are prompt and have a nice healthy sitdown options and would go back in a heartbeat.

name: Meridith P
text: My first time here was coincidentally also the night of the unveiling of The Grove's new menu. Started the evening with a golden beet salad, which was really delicious but a bit large for a salad portion. Next, the chicken and JC rice bowl was splendid and I love the chile oil in it- adds a big pop of spice yet doesn't overpower the symphony already existing on the plate. And oh gosh, the sorbet trio is to freakin' die for. I'm an outsider to Houston, so I don't get to see this side of the city often, but I'm so glad I met The Grove when I did! I'll definitely return.

text: The gnocchi is unreal but don't come here if you actually like to hear the person you're with. They really need to fix their acoustic issues.

name: Jay Francis
text:
I had the opportunity to have a multi-course meal here recently. It began with a roasted poblano and corn chowder which everyone at the table agreed was one of the best we had ever had. The chopped romaine lettuce salad with smoked garlic dressing, radish, parmesan and chipotle bits also included bits of boqueron, a type of European anchovy, popular in Spain. If you've ever had bonito flakes, you'll have an idea of the taste. Dried fish. It was pretty disgusting. The entree was a perfectly grilled redfish filet accompanied by potatoes boiled in Cajun crawfish boil. Both were very good. Dessert was a chocolate "mole" cake. Mole in name only. Valhrona chocolate, almonds, ancho chile. On a bed of pureed figs. It was one of those collapsed cakes, possibly a flourless one, the kind that rises like a soufle and then collapses into a dense, chocolate decadence. The cake was wonderful. But there were overtones of chile that provided a little more heat than some would enjoy. For me, no problem. The other sampled dessert, a "fried" key lime was just too precious and not at all enjoyable. It was like an empanada with a key lime center and was a "fail".

All in all, a very fine dining experience. Were there some mis-steps? Yeah, sure. But at least they were trying some things that could have worked, even though they didn't.

Oh yeah. The waitstaff was terrific.

text: There was blonde hair left all over shower wall, brown spots all over restroom sink like someone dumped something down the drain but the mess never got cleaned up until I took Clorox wipes and cleaned it myself and someone lelt their deodorant, socks, toothbrush  and dirty tissues under the bed. My five year old found them so thank you for that . I brought it up to the front desk and after the second surprise under the bed they asked if I wanted to switch rooms but there was no guarantee that room was cleaned properly.  I ended up just cleaning the whole room/ disinfecting everything myself. The hotel was definitely not up to Marriott standards.

text: Great place and rates for this weekend. We relaxed and enjoyed the time in Houston and the Magnolia was just right for the occasion.

text:
Magnolia is a great choice for a downtown Houston hotel. The prices were very reasonable and the staff friendly.

The room was beginning to show some signs of age, peeling paint and the bathtub had cracks.

Overall a great stay. A little more attention to cleaning detail and it's a five star experience.

name: Lee Hill
text:
We had a great time at this hotel. Although its located downtown the parking was easy. Valet on standby if you need help as well.
Our room was nice and clean with good views of downtown. Restaurant service was ok but the food was great. The lobby was really cool with explanations of what the hotel used to be. The team was fun and front desk in particular were really cool. Kudos to management.

text: Absolutely breathtaking views. Top notch customer service. Our Signature Suite was elegant and refreshing. Love the late night milk and cookies. Valet was professional and polite. We had no complaints.

name: Diana Metobo
text: I thoroughly enjoyed my stay! From Carlos being Soo gracious with the check-in process to the view from my floor, the great tub, and the only thing I played in the tv was their in-house "ad", it was inspired for sure. Also, I'm glad I got to enjoy the rooftop pool area.

name: Caroline Mercer
text:
Our first impression was very good. The check-in process was very accommodating and easy to do. The valet service was disappointing as we were left stranded and had to walk back to the hotel due to a lack of communication on the valet staff side. I'm trying to check out at home we requested a luggage card and ample time prior to check out which never arrived. as a result we struggle to get down to the front to retrieve our vehicles from the valet.

The location was quite good and ease of accessibility to different things in the area was nice. Unfortunately the great location cannot make up for communication issues and frustrations.

Overall this was not a bad experience but definitely not anything to rave or recommend to a new person about. I would not be encouraged to go back and visit this establishment again.

text: We booked through Hotwire and were surprised to find ourselves with a room at The Magnolia.  The room is lovely - very clean and comfortable. The motel is also very pet friendly.  The only downside is the parking situation/valet stop. It is extremely congested at the front, with some sort of construction blocking the lane at the entrance.

text: Absolutely stunning hotel to visit, even if for just a few hours at a time..

text: I love this place. I didn't stay @ the hotel, but I met delegates who were there for an International Convention @ NRG. They treated the delegates nicely & there were green 🍎 in the lobby for snacks!

text: Very nice hotel.   I arrived late in the evening,  the front desk had everything ready and I was on my way to my room in a snap!  They explained where all the amenities were located.  I stopped into the restaurant and had a late dinner, chicken avocado on brioche, was fantastic :)  Room was great,  very spacious-

text: Best kept secret in Houston. Very nice place, better than the closest comparable properties. Big big big bath tubs. Yes that was three bigs. Newly remodeled. My new favorite hide out.

text: Nice hotels and pet friendly. I didnt have any problems the night I stayed.

name: Kim Handy - Wedding Officiant
text: I absolutely love this hotel. I had the pleasure of officiating a wedding here this evening and the staff and wedding space was just perfect! I definitely would recommend.

name: Chris Banuelos
text: Pricey,  but very nice.  Comfortable rooms,  beds and accommodations.  Good service.  Nice view of Htown

name: Steven D
text:
Hotel is in a great location and the staff was great. The room was a bit outdated.

We tried to go to the roof top pool but there was 30 young kids in the small pool. The parents were all around drinking or sleeping on the chairs. The views of the city were awesome though.

The bar seemed nice but was packed and after waiting 10 minutes to get a beer, we left and went a block down and got service very quick.

The bell men were very nice and helpful but you are forced to have them come up to your room to load or unload your luggage. The valets were very nice and you text the number and they will tell you how long before your vehicle will be there.

name: N Kirby
text: If it was possible to give it no stars I would, the bed was the worst bed I've ever slept in my life. The floor was more comfortable than the bed. For the amount of money you spend on those rooms you'd figure they would have gotten comfortable mattress. I stayed there the night of Dec 21, 2019 and 2 adjustments later my back and hips just starting to feel normal

name: Jennifer Y.
text:
Newly renovated although I'm not sure when. It's a very lovely, clean, inviting hotel. Perfectly located downtown from the strip of bars including Batanga, Dean's, Sambuca. We came downtown for a drunken night out on new year's and left happy customers.

Once you enter you're hit with the very lovely yet very strange christmas tree (there are also several copies of this strange christmas tree throughout the hotel) - there isn't a topper and it seems like the tree was chopped off at the top. To the left is a waiting area which was equipped with chocolate chip cookies and milk the night we checked in, and cucumber water on the morning we checked out. The entrance is badge entry only after certain hours so you'll feel safer in the midst of downtown stragglers.

Check in was easy. They make you insert your credit card a second time but make sure to tell you that it's for verification purposes only. There is a $100 additional charge on my card but presumably only for deposit purposes and will be removed. If it's not removed and becomes an issue I'll be sure to come back here and update.

Stayed in a standard 2 queen room. There were 3 windows which faced a building under construction but I think that's the charm of staying downtown - they provided a high floor (18th) per request and accommodated a late check out (1pm) also per request. Between the beds and on the desk are dimmable lamps which come in handy. Each bed is also equipped with an adjustable book light of sorts attached to the headboard; it swivels in all manner of directions and has a very modern chic aesthetic.

The. Beds. They were amazing. The comforter was thick and warm but light, there were four pillows which were all fluffy but not too thick. I sound like goldilocks - if you know how hard it is to get comfortable with a cold on alcohol, then you'll know how good these beds were.

On the desk there were two $6 voss waters. In the bathroom were complimentary coffee and tazo teas with assorted sugars and coffee maker. Also in the bathroom was the mini fridge which surprisingly wasn't stocked with anything; I quite liked that - usually there are too many things and you can't put your own things in the fridge. The bathtub and toilet are separated from the rest of the restroom by a sliding door. The bathtub amenities (shower gel, shampoo, conditioner) were in refillable containers and not in disposable mini containers. For those who like to take home endless tiny samples this is not the place for you!

Morning after went to the lounge (2nd floor) to try some of the breakfast. The buffet was pretty standard $18 for pancakes, bacon, yogurt, etc. I chose to get the breakfast croissant with bacon $15 which was... the croissant was old; the edges were hard and the center was cakey. The egg was most of the meal; the bacon was overcooked and hard. The cheese was somehow un-melted in all this mess and tasted like kraft singles. The best thing on the plate were the side of potatoes sauteed in bell peppers and onions - notably not mentioned on the menu.

There is apparently a gym, and a rooftop pool and hottub - I didn't personally get to use either of these amenities.

Another weird quirk I noticed is that the numbers on the elevator are all crooked.

We even used the shuttle this time, had to wait just a few extra minutes, but the driver was friendly. Definitely my choice for mid-range hotels!

name: rasha white
text: The valet staff really make this place awesome! But, I also love all the windows. My views during my second week weren't fab, but it wasn't horrendous. Management and housekeeping did a great job of ensuring their service stepped up a few notches compared to my previous stay. I will definitely return to this location.
