text:
Wifi signal didn't cover our rooms. We called the front desk a number of times,, they tried to reset the wifi,, but across 6 different devices/phones zero signal.
1st room wasn't turned over when we walked in the door and had leaky appliances. They moved us to a new room though but now we have the wifi issue.

name: Sarah Michelle Tijerina SarahSmiles777
text: So family and I are taking over this establishment so we invite you all to make a reservation and keep in mind we are going to be on air so don't reserve hear unless you don't mind us in your business

name: Atraio navarro
text: Don’t expect room service here. There’s no food or drinks here. And my first night here upon arrival the street was closed because a man was shot and killed outside.... not super cute.

name: Michelle Solitaire
text:
Such a cute Texan hotel. The one complaint I had was the way they have the air conditioners set up. It never stayed cold and would switch off to fan mode in the middle of the night. I called engineering about this and they said it’s a way the hotel saves money on electricity. I’m sorry, but I’m paying to stay there, and if I want to sleep with the air at 72-74 degrees, no one should tell me I can’t. 🤷🏽‍♀️
But cute spot!! Loved the hotel bar as well! 👌🏽
Room service was quick and they cleaned the room every morning. Great customer service.

name: Cat G
text:
Staying at the Magnolia was a great experience. We brought our dogs because this was a last minute trip to watch the Astros beat the Yankees. Not only is the Magnolia perfectly located in regards to the stadium but there are multiple places to walk your dog. There is a dog run or park in 5 minutes walking distance no matter what direction you go. The walk to the stadium was easy and there are plenty of new places to visit for a quick bite.

The staff here was very friendly. Our dogs were treated well and the rooms were great sizes. No charge for your pups either. Our ride out of town was delayed and the lobby on the second floor was a perfect place to lay low after late checkout. I would recommend this hotel for anyone looking to bring their pups and especially if you’re here for anything in downtown. The rooms are clean, the bathrooms are well stocked and updated. The one drawback is the elevators, they can be a little slow. Also, the TVs are a bit outdated but we didn’t come here to watch TV. They do have quite a few channels. I would not say that these drawbacks warrant losing a star. We will be back!

I almost forgot to mention, the valet is very fast here. With all the construction downtown, getting your car quick is a big plus.

name: Chris Velasquez
text: I stayed here during Hurricane Harvey because it was the only place that had power.  The staff was beyond accommodating to everyone.  They made sure everyone was always fed and comfortable.  The new renovations are also extremely nice.

name: Kagami Hiiragi
text:
I like the old-school feel of the building, makes me feel nostalgic in a way.. Rooms were perfect and beds felt like clouds for me. Everything (concerts, food, and bars) were within reasonable walking distance, so no driving around and struggling to find parking!

I would most definitely come here again (assuming the city isn't flooded by next year)!

name: Mel G
text: Highly recommend the bar menu for a quick bite. Great service all around. The bed and pillows are comfortable.

name: felice simmons
text: The renovation has made this hotel even better!

name: James Novis
text:
clean and quiet, I really enjoyed dinner at the restaurant. However the food for breakfast was terrible and expensive. Vallet guys were jerks.
With that said, the room was very comfortable and had a great view.

name: Amanda Horner
text: We loved this hotel. It was beautiful inside and always smelled good. Milk and cookies (delicious!!) in the lobby every evening. Very friendly and helpful staff at the front door and front desk. Loved the rooftop pool (but it was only 3’9” deep!) and hot tub. The rooms were very nice and we had an oversized tub. It was luxurious and relaxing all around. Just a few negatives, reasons I gave it four stars instead of five: the housekeeping on the second day. And third day. And fourth day! Second day we were gone all day, came back and one of our two rooms hadn’t been done, not made up, no towels, etc. So we called and complained and they brought new towels and emptied the trash. Next day, same exact thing! But the second day someone had put the privacy sign on the doorknob - NOT US that we could recall - weird. So that explained that, and again they brought up towels etc. We took off the privacy sign. The following day SAME THING. This time neither of our rooms had beds made, no cleaning, no towels, nothing. For such a nice hotel, it was so odd that the housekeepers were late every day or inattentive and that they didn’t make sure to keep it from happening multiple times. Oh, and the hot tub was never actually hot. Other than that, it was a wonderful hotel. I’d  still stay again and recommend it.

name: rodney alejandro
text: I only attended a conference that was catered by the hotel. The conference room was nice and comfortable. The food was not very good. Chicken dry, fish bland, noodles were sticky, dry and look to be sitting all day. Veg was tasteless and dessert offering slim. The morning coffee was brutal. Not sure how a overnight stay would be, but their catering services are not great.

name: Blazing Walrus
text: Dirty bathroom, wall paper falling off wall, dirty and heavily dusted walls. Bathroom sink doesn't drain. The vent doesn't work.  Nl door sweep on base of door. At check in the hostess said "let's find you a better room" talking about this filthy room like it is an upgrade. The only thing this is an upgrade from is the dirty renovation area they have, which they did not disclose.

name: Lora Hansen
text: I love it here, and I want to stay again. Very pleased with my room.

name: Joshua Lenz
text: Excellent front desk staff. They did a pretty good job remodeling this old building. Only a 5 minute walk to MMP! The swimming pool could use an update and the toilet handle was loose in our room but other than that it was a great experience.

name: James Timmons
text: Beautiful hotel!

name: Nick Curcio
text: Cordial and helpful front desk staff. Comfortable and quiet rooms. They are in the beginning phase of renovating some floors. Room we were in was not newly renovated, but was clean, comfortable, and quiet. In-house breakfast offerings were pricey, but good. Loved how a historical building was saved and repurposed into a nice hotel.

name: Andy Deguzman
text: The hotel and rooms are nice. I have stayed here a few times with no issues.

name: Lisa forbus
text: Wow! Talk about e cellent customer service!!!! Northon knew exactly what we needed and took great care of us.

name: Lance Rosenquest
text: Really nice boutique hotel near Minute Maid Park. Room was nice and clean.  Front desk lines and especially the valet waits were the only issues. They definitely seemed a bit understaffed at times. But, more importantly, the staff were very professional, helpful and friendly.

name: Stacey Marie
text: Clean hotel and I am glad that I didn't smell the carpet or smoke in walls.  (Something only hyper-senses can take as important).  Will probably be back.

name: Jake Dewald
text: Awesome hotel. Pool is tiny. Otherwise no complaints, awesome place.

name: Toi Toi
text: The customer service was outstanding! Mr Holiday who checked us in was so informative on the hotel and all our questions! The bartenders were phenomenal the pool top pool has such a beautiful view!! This hotel is a must see💎💎💎💎

name: Norah Gharala
text: Great value hotel with interesting design touches and professional staff. The room was very comfortable with minimal noise. Located near a tram stop, which made it easy to get to museums.

name: Rachel Fahrig
text: I'm not sure what I was expecting but this hotel definitely surpassed it! Let's start here: GARDEN TUB. Yes, you read that right. Also, reasonably priced, really good room service. VERY comfy bed (no, for real). Historic touches with modern amenities. Wonderful city views from the upper floors. A swell lounge, and attentive, knowledgeable staff. Excellent valet service. I would definitely come stay here again.

name: Adam Ward
text: An amazing place

name: Steve Northrup
text: First time we have stayed at the Magnolia Hotel. Very clean and hospitable. Was called early in the afternoon prior to check in - wanting to upgrade our room for us - very agreeable to us. It had been a very busy checkout day so when we arrived our room had not yet been serviced. Called down to the front desk and housekeeping came right away and remedied the situation. In the meantime the front desk called up asking if, while we were waiting, if we cared yo go to the lounge and enjoy cocktails on the house. We politely said we would like to change first since we were going out that night. The response was to take our time and they would still honor the invitation. Ended up eating a delicious, large salad for dinner accompanied by the complimentary cocktails. Nest time we are in Houston the Magnolia Hotel has our business. Very courteous staff all around and one of the most comfortable hotel beds we have ever slept in.

name: Bennie Hunter Hooey
text: I had a Lively Birthday here. The staff was great. The service was amazing,  the hotel has a fabulous look. Everything was fine!!!😁😁😁

name: Shakira G
text: Beautiful decor, accommodating and pleasant staff. Comfortable beds, spacious bathroom with garden tub. Milk & cookies evening treat is always a bonus! Definitely a gem in Houston's thriving downtown. Expect to pay $30+ for overnight valet parking

name: Hannah Jahani
text:
Staff was a little unorganized and check-in took forever. Elevators are veryyyy slow, but if you're in a hurry wouldn't recommend going down 12 flights of stairs lol. Valet was also kind of slow, but they are very much downtown.
Very beautiful regardless and within walking distance from some great bars!

name: Dana Guillory
text: By far the quietest hotel ever. The rooftop pool had great views of Houston skyline and wonderful ambiance. Restaurant could be improved, but the staff is friendly and attentive.

name: Tammy Nix
text: We had to wait in line for a long time every time we needed to talk to the front desk and the staff were not very friendly. The room was small and the view was the side of another building. It was clean but left a lot to be desired on service.

name: Freddy Elmesselmani
text: Good spot, attentive staff. Located conveniently downtown.

name: Brent Middleton
text: Amazing rooms. Beautiful spaces. Seemed to have an issue with a desk clerk allowing white guests in without question but needed to see room keys for my black guests. Had to go to the lobby to show my room key to get them in while I watched other people walk in unobstructed. Other than that, the night was awesome.

name: Laura Fager
text: The staff was friendly and welcoming, the room clean, the bed comfortable and the cookies and milk at 8pm most welcome!! I enjoyed my stay - nothing beats the comfort of your own home and bed but the magnolia wasn't a shabby replacement. Recommended!

name: Chris Bell
text: Great so far. Room wasn't ready when we arrived. Estimated another hour. I suppose that's fine. The rest of the hotel is fancy as hell. Staff is friendly yet not in your face.

name: Stephanie Garcia
text: Beautiful hotel. Definitely home like Houston feel. Great views of Houston Main Street

name: Emily Stickle
text: Fun happy hour and cookie bar for free. Wonderful location, dinner and drinks within walking distance. The breakfast is unimpressive, go ahead and splurge in the area. Good for travelers and visitors, but don't expect a boutique hotel. It's fun, functional and cost effective. Enjoy it for those reason.

name: Bucket Macker
text: So nice this is where we had our jobs Christmas party at.

name: Mz Diva
text: Management was rude and did not want to resolve my card charges. they charged my card 3 times it took 3 days to get this issue resolved. No refrigerator in the upgraded room with a stove and microwave? And trash was not emptied in room. No extra towels or washrags but gorgeous view and lovely room very quiet. Just a bad experience for my first time. Cookies and milk were a big hit too. Hot tub was not hot and very dirty pool also looked nasty. Was not happy valet was $40 so dont expect to park for free at that hotel.

name: Roxanne Green
text: Great mattress tub and shower. Nice extras. Sexy, elegant hotel.

name: Collin Myers
text: An excellent, clean, modern hotel with wonderful service. Easily accessible and near delicious dining options, the hotel boasts a rooftop pool. The only reason I don't give a full five stars is that the pool is relatively small and the fitness center is as well.

name: Mario Raygoza
text: Staff is super helpful, the hotel itself is nice but parking is a joke!

name: Kevin Seamster
text: Very good customer service.

name: Kellie Buchanan
text: I went to a 1-day workshop at the Magnolia.  Only complaint was it was very cold in the conference rooms, colder than most.  Other than that audio, breakfast and lunch provisions were great. Appreciated the Voss bottled water they provided.

name: Carly Vahldiek
text: Awesome place with awesome staff! It was our Anniversary and Daniel C. at the front desk surprised us with complimentary champagne & chocolate covered strawberries delivered to our room!!! Magnolia Houston really is THE place to stay when in town!

name: Caine
text: Pretty nice hotel, parking is a nightmare. I would recommend this for others.

name: George Danner
text: I went to the Magnolia hotel not as a guest, but as a conference attendee.  The setup was excellent and the wifi was unusually stable and strong.  The food was very, very good as well.  In short, this is probably a better conference venue downtown than a lot of the other better known names.

name: X IV
text:
Amazing roof pool with cinematic views. VOSS water in the room with a complimentary cookies at the bar.

Lovely place.

name: Michael Kidd Klover Rinehart
text: Classic! 💚🍀

name: Eric
text: They really maintain the feeling and look of the hotel. The bar was great. The gym was just okay. The food was good. Rooms were very clean.

name: Janice Sellers
text: Have always loved the hotel,only one complaint..Women visit your hotel too ..There are 12 channels that cater to sports...I mean really!!! No TCM,no Western channels,nothing  catering to Women,or just a person like me, that would love to watch a good movie....12 stations for sports enthusiast is ridiculous....will be visiting again soon,I'm a cancer patient,from out of Town,being treated at M D Anderson, if that haven't changed, I'll have to find me another Hotel...Thanks....

name: Philip Gregory
text: Visited fellow international conventioners while in Houston, Texas very nice accomodations at hotel.

name: William Hopkins
text: Definitely one of my favorite hotels.  Great atmosphere, superior service and always a very hip and cool decor.    The room was spacious and had everything you need in it.

name: Jonathan Durst
text: I love this hotel, it's charming, beautiful and the staff is helpful and nice. They have cookies and milk at 8:00pm, the kids loved it. The pool is small but on the roof and there's a hot tub. The room was clean with a great view. The only down side was that the elevator was really slow. All in all I can't wait to come back.

name: John Broady
text: Rooms are nicely appointed. Friendly staff. The breakfast buffet was disappointing, featuring cold sausage and crusty eggs.

name: irene portillo
text: So far it's been great but this is the first day that we're here we're spending the night.

name: Roman Perez
text: The hotel is beautiful! At first glance it looks a bit decrepit but as soon as you walk in, you know that the hotel is a four star hotel. The room I stayed in was beautiful as well. There was even a fully stocked mini bar!  There was a rooftop pool and a workout room! The workout room was state of the art and immaculate! The pool itself was kinda small though. In the morning the complimentary breakfast was amazing. One of the best complimentary breakfasts I have ever seen.

name: Jaden Richards
text: Stayed here last weekend and it was great. Room was spotless, complimentary shuttle service, and friendly staff.

name: Mark Collingwood
text: Good views decent price but good luck parking your car. Homeless around the area make you feel unsafe.

name: Jonathan Blassingame
text: I had a wonderful stay at the hotel. Every one was polite and respectful!

name: Jordan Neill
text: Great location and service. Our room wasn't quite ready when we were checking in and and the front desk gave us credit to use at the bar while we waited. Free breakfast and happy hour are great. Rooftop pool has a nice view. We stayed on a Saturday and there were a lot of wedding parties which were loud and made using the elevator take a while - but that's not really the hotel's fault. Would definitely stay here again next time I need a place downtown.

name: Kyle Sampson
text: Seems very family friendly.  The rooftop pool is pretty small but has a decent view of downtown.  Location is great!  Rooms were clean and well kept.  Nice older hotel feel with all the modern stuff you want.

name: Timothy Hamlett
text: Customer service at the front desk left a little to be desired but the bar was fantastic

name: Veronica Delgado
text: It was very cozy and clean, big comfortable bed, and a large soaking tub. Great view from my room. Enjoyed the nearby restaurants and bars. Overall a very pleasant experience

name: T Web
text: Loved this place and it's history. Staff was very nice and the rooms had great views. They were also very comfortable. This will definitely be a go to when we stay in Houston, which is frequent

name: iDriveTX
text: By far my favorite hotel in Houston. You will not find a better value for your dollar and location. Great place for couples, the nightly milk & cookies buffet is bliss, will put a smile on any woman's face. Then to top it off every guest receives 2 complimentary drinks and a filling breakfast buffet in the morning...I could go and on about the Magnolia. Great, great, great hotel!!!

name: Flor Rodriguez
text: Loved our stay here. Great location, the rooms are spacious and clean. Wish I could have stayed longer.

name: Dillon Marsh
text: This beautiful hotel is a must if visiting Downtown Houston. It's location is perfect so that you can walk to any prime time event and relax in the rooftop pool at night. I loved the interior and was amazed at how friendly the staff was. This was a great stay and look forward to visiting again.

name: Connie Fornea
text: We we're there for the Green weeding reception and dinner. The food was fabulous. It's a beautiful place.

name: Andrew Lockley
text: Too many service glitches. Pool wasn't open at the advertised times, room wasn't serviced, complaints weren't acted on. I left early.

name: Arzina Ali
text: We decided to stay here with family for a week long convention. The rooms were great, housekeeping was wonderful, the interior decor was awesome, and the front desk staff was always friendly. In particular, TAJ who checked us in was very sweet! One thing I would definitely watch before booking this hotel is the parking fee. There's no free parking. The valet is $33 a day! Our total just for parking came out to be super expensive - $290 in parking. I was super disappointed with the car situation. The hotel needs to have better parking rates because this is beyond ridiculous and a rip off. I may not stay at this hotel again due to the ridiculously high priced parking fare. I would rather book somewhere else and use the $290 for something more fun and useful. Also, if I had known - I would have booked elsewhere. And unfortunately there's no where in the website stating the $33 parking charge.

name: Shanetia Hill
text: Texas Size ROOMS! LOVE IT..

name: Erin Gutierrez
text: Came during winter weather advisory and most accommodations were unavailable. The breakfast was not included and cost $12.99...for basic food, nothing special. Kitchen menu was incredibly overpriced, and room service also included a 21% gratuity (!!!) AND a $4 delivery fee...for room service! Nice room, comfortable bed, nice bathroom. But more accommodations for less money at other hotels.

name: Onesimo Solis
text: This hotel has all the expected amenities. Complimentary warm cookies and milk in the evening is a nice treat to end the day. There is also a happy hour offering in The Lounge. The room was clean and the staff friendly. That being said, some rooms have no view. And while the staff is friendly and apologetic, the service can be lacking for a hotel ranked 4-stars on the travel websites. I was disappointed with my stay, but not so disappointed that I would say, "Don't stay here." Hope you have a better stay than I.

name: Brittany Austin
text: Great, friendly service from staff. Only a few minor, cosmetic things wrong with our room.

name: Glen Bertalotto
text: Magnolia Hotel Downtown Houston fabulous place beautiful customer service a lots to do around here your chance to check them out

name: Donna C
text: Very friendly staff, very helpful.

name: Amanda Sullivan
text: Had a wonderful stay. They offer complimentary drinks for happy hour and a night time milk and cookies. Nice clean room and really enjoyed the lounge. Also their staff was very polite and helpful.

name: Sherrill Davis Delafose
text: Nice ambience, professional staff, and clean and very comfortable rooms.

name: onlao mbsrz
text: Located in the CBD and only 4 blocks from the Minute Maid Ballpark. Many cafes and restaurants located near by. The room was spacious and nicely set up. Bar service was excellent. We would happily stay here again.

name: Paul Davis
text: Valet provided excellent service. Good knowledge of area. Hotel is very clean and modernized. Welcoming to a weary Traveller.

name: Marina Crabtree
text: Love Love Love This Place to Stay.  Customer service is friendly rooms are super duper clean showers nice and big and the water comes out very clear unlike other places I've stayed downtown Houston

name: Perry Hearne
text: Great location. Friendly staff. Top notch amenities. Roof top pool was excellent. Free breakfasts, happy hour, cookies and milk. 10 min. walk to Minute Maid. Reasonably priced. Loved it. Thank you.

name: Ricki Escobedo
text: Awesome hotel! Fantastic rooms and customer service!!!

name: Carey Rote
text: Just so charming. A beautiful spot.

name: Jack Ascher
text: Average at best. Awful price to value ratio. Due to a wedding, there was a makeshift bar in the lobby. Beer in coolers, plastic cups for drinks. Breakfast was late and I've had better at a Hamptons Inn. Maybe an off day, but hotels only get one shot at a first and lasting impression.

name: Jennifer Phoenix
text:
I loved the view from the roof top at this hotel.  Beautiful.
Pool and hot tub are kinda small
Parking is going to cost you at least 25 bucks.

name: Bay Home & Garden
text: Great place to stay among others if you're downtown! Love the rooftop access views! If I could only give downtown Houston traffic a rating....

name: Courtney Payne
text: I expected more from a boutique hotel. Dirty towel and coffee maker was off putting. Their continental breakfast was as joke. They served juice out of a machine, artificiality creamer instead of real cream with coffee and jam packets. The cookies were a nice touch but overall pretty unimpressed. Oh and $30 a night for valet when there is no self park option is obnoxious.

name: Ernie Boling
text: The rooms were comfortable, and the showers were absolutely amazing. The valet team was spot-on. There had been a mistake on our reservation, but the front desk fixed it for us right away.

name: Jacenta Stallworth
text: My husband planned my Birthday Staycation at Magnolia Hotel. I was blown away with the warmth and hospitality of the staff. The hotel was beautifully decorated and our room was perfect and spacious. I would recommend Magnolia Hotel Houston to any of my friends, looking to get away from the norm. The breakfast was awesome, however, I didn't know about the free happy hour and milk an cookies. That would have been an added treat, had we known about it.

name: kimberly ross
text: Very disappointed in my last visit

name: Melanie Halbert
text: Beautiful hotel in a wonderful location. It made an excellent event space for our company meeting! Valet parking was wonderful as well.

name: Nicole Buergers
text: A friend of mine came into Houston and we decided to go dancing and crash at this hotel. We were swayed by the cookie buffet. The cookies were the least impressive thing about this hotel. The rooms are spacious and the tubs are deep. The building is very cool. When I stayed there, wooden benches lined the end of the bed. In the middle of the night I got up to go to the bathroom and in the dark, tripped on the bench. It was hard and I had a giant bruise afterward. So, be aware of that and don't make a fool out of yourself.

name: Rafael Mercado
text: Great staff, nice rooms and great location!

name: Henry McDonald
text: The room was nice and comfortable and the staff was helpful. I had some difficulty in finding an ice maker as there was not one on the 5th floor not signage telling me where to find one. No one answered at the front desk when I called, but luckily I spotted a guest in the hallway that knew where it was. The hotel was within walking distance of the convention center and had plenty of places nearby to eat at.

name: Jessica Mireles
text: Overall we really enjoyed our stay at the hotel. The location is great and the room was nice. The staff was friendly. The breakfast that is included with the stay was nice. The only issues we had was the hot tub on the roof was freezing and we thought we booked a room with a microwave but there was not one.

name: jae stop
text: My little cousin had a hotel party

name: Edgar Iroba
text: Excellent place. Very nice building. I went to a workshop everything was great

name: jairy garcia
text: Beautiful hotel wish I got to see the bar upstairs since it was sold to a private party but the guests were nice there too

name: Seher Dholakia
text:
I was extremely satisfied with my stay at the Magnolia Hotel. I (admittedly) get swayed by great perks (who doesn't like free things?), and boy, did the Magnolia have great perks. For a boutique hotel in downtown Houston, I was surprised by all of the amenities of the hotel and the excellent service. All you need to know:

Rooftop pool overlooking Houston (such a great view!)
Complimentary happy hour that serves unlimited beer and wine (incredibly fun!)
Complimentary bedtime cookie buffet (amazing cookies!)
Complimentary breakfast buffet (and not just cereal and milk guys, this was the real deal!)

I took advantage of all of those and boy did I leave a happy (and full!) guest. The hotel itself was also really nice - the room was big and spacious, the bathroom was really nice and had an actual tub (haven't seen that in a hotel in a while), and when I called for toothpaste it was delivered within a couple of minutes. Everyone at the hotel was extremely nice and I definitely felt as if I was being treated well. The free wifi, complimentary downtown shuttle service, and amazing staff are just a few more reasons to stay.

name: Jessica M.
text: Excellent service. I had a wonderful time. The room was gorgeous. The view was nice. The parking is valet only. You can park in the parking garage. Either way, parking was kinda pricey. Everything else was wonderful.

name: danielle scott
text: The service was mediocre considering it is a 4 diamond hotel.  The vallet service is very hard to get in contact within it is not through a text message.    It will not be my first choice for a stay.

name: Casey Bee
text: Beautiful boutique hotel located in the theater district. Within walking distance of restaurants and nightlife. Beautiful rooms and a rooftop pool.

name: Vanessa Lopez
text: Great hotel! Everything is always so clean, and front desk is amazing.

name: Abby Ridge
text: This place was awful. There were two staff members who were nice to us our entire 6 day stay here. We ordered Amazon Prime twice and they lost it for 2+ hours twice. We were told we could use our free breakfast in our room, and then we couldn't, and then we could, and then that we had to pay for it since we had it in the room. Nobody had the same answer to any of our questions. They tried to put us in a 1 bed room when we had ordered a King Suite. They tried to tell us they "didn't have any rooms available" when the exact room we booked was open for US the whole weekend we stayed. The place is old, it smells like mold, all of the staff is horribly rude. The valet guys are super nice. They undercook all of their food in the restaurant. Go to Aloft or the Meridian. NOT HERE.

name: Timothy Glover
text: From the outside I would have never thought it would be that great. We pulled up and the valet's we right there to meet us and get our vehicle parked. We walked in and were amazed at how beautiful the entryway and reservation desk area were. Beautifully decorated for Christmas with a beautiful fireplace flaming it's warmth. We proceeded to check in where we met the most friendly and most professional person I have ever experienced when checking in. Blair was accommodating and made our initial experience feel awesome. I asked her to tell me why I should stay here versus the competition in town and she told me to let the experience of her hotel begin and that question would be answered by morning. We proceeded to our room which by the way was wonderfully decorated and warm. Went to the lounge to get a couple glasses of wine and to no avail the experience of the staff in the lounge was wonderful. We then proceeded to go to the top of the hotel to look at the view and the view was amazing. The front desk knew it was my wife's birthday and when we headed out for a little stroll we came back to a bottle of champagne chilled with a couple glasses. before we headed to the Hobby Center which by the way is less than a half mile from the hotel we stepped into the lounge for a real "Free" Happy Hour. 5:30 to 6:30 wine and beer (two drinks max) is free. After the show we came back to the hotel to be greeted by milk and fresh cookies before bedtime. At 10:30 I ordered room service and the food and the timeliness of the delivery were awesome. Great nights rest to wake up to a wonderful breakfast buffet before check out. To all the staff and especially "Blair" don't change a thing you guys are doing it right. I will never stay anywhere else when staying in Houston. Thanks for the awesome experience!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

name: Todd Aronson
text: Very nice very clean and a very helpful friendly staff.

name: Micheal Martel
text: The experience was great my wife and I was invited to a Christmas party on the third floor, she didn't think I enjoyed myself because I had just got off of work but I really did. I can't wait to next year.

name: Russell Horton
text:
In a vacuum the hotel was good. It's In a pretty centrally located downtown area. I gave it this review because the hotel was recently bought by a mega corporation. That normally wouldn't be a big thing but they immediately started reducing or taking away all the perks that the hotel used to offer.

They had a happy hour and milk and cookies in the evenings. Now all that is gone. If the company that bought it cares about money that much then they don't deserve mine.

name: Montanna Smith
text: The parking situation needs to be worked on, the garage that contracts with them also forms their valet and were selling spots that didn't exist (admitted to garage that had zero spots for the evening). Other than that, the staff was courteous and friendly, the rooms were super clean and roomy, and for the environmentalists out there: large dispensers for soap/shampoo/conditioner in the showers.

name: Constance Daniels
text: Great location for stadium but outdated and small. Pool looks way better in pictures but the view was cool. Charges $33 per day for parking you have to vallet which I don't like

name: Vân Le
text: When for a drink before the Christmas mass at the church next door, the bartender was friendly and nice. Drink was served fast

name: Pamela Parra
text: Enjoyed our stay here. Staff was very friendly and accommodating to us. They first put us in a room with a view of rooftops and AC, but we called and requested a different room and they accommodated us with no hassle. We enjoyed the free breakfast, happy hour and cookie bar. Only gripe was when checking out they tried to charge an overnight parking garage fee of $29 that we didn't use. When I spoke to them about it, they apologized and deleted the charge. Had we not looked before we left, we would have been charged a fee we didn't use, so just be cautious of fees before you check out.

name: Mark Tarrien
text: So I got what I thought was a great deal on this hotel downtown (second time I've stayed here), but of course sometimes great deals come with great compromises. Perhaps if I hadn't had such a long and busy work week or had been told up front when I checked in that there would be some work that would be an inconvenience to guests, I would have been more understanding. But instead, shortly after check in they began painting the floors in the lobby. Instead of doing it with guest inconvenience in mind, they simply created a narrow walkway while taking two of three elevators out of service. Again, if I had been on the first few floors, I would have simply taken the stairs. But being on the 20th floor I wasn't very excited to walk up a flight of stairs after a long 12 hour day working strenuously on my feet. Instead I had to wait and wait on the one elevator, from a few up to 20 minutes. This work could have easily been done in a way where nearly the same amount of work could have been completed while allowing all 3 elevators to remain in service. The work from what I can tell was only in the lobby. I have no plans to stay here in the future.

name: Angela S
text: Beautiful hotel in walking distance to Minute Maid park!

name: Michael Gochis
text: Nice and clean property. Staff was super helpful and head great personalities. Rooms were big and water pressure was good. No issues.

name: Jeremy Champagne
text: We had a lot of fun with this hotel. The room was beautiful and so was The View :-) we would come here again

name: Vinh Pham
text: Pretty good value for the location. A block away from Main St. Decent sized square footage in the rooms. The room we stayed in had a coffee table, desk couch and mini kitchen with fridge. The pool is small but has pretty decent views and the fitness facility is above average compared to other hotels. Usual cardio equipment as well as a bench and free weights that go to 50 lbs. Negatives, the bed felt a little old as the mattress made a mini U shaped from the constant usage of someone sleeping in the middle of the bed. Above average hotel that is dog friendly.

name: NORWOOD GREENE,III
text: ILA 1351 Christmas party location last year/2018. Splendid everything, from decor to accommodations!

name: Edwin Trainer
text: This is a nice hotel in an older building. Great amenities. They have a restaurant and bar. As well as a swimming pool on the roof. Conference rooms are on the 3rd floor. Located in downtown Houston near the convention center and Minute Maid field. A lot of restaurant and bars are withing walking distance. I attended a meeting here and the catering and meeting rooms were good.

name: Sergio O
text: Beautiful hotel and not overly priced.

name: Sophia
text: Nice and friendly staff there is a young lady that makes it elegant and comfortable PEACHES from the dining area. Good choice to stay at.

name: Alexander Jolley
text: Employer chose this place to have a holiday party. Altought the scenery and environment was great the catered food was not. I didn't ask if the hotel provided it, but if they had then I recommend another place.

name: Patricia Martinez
text: Great boutique hotel! Friends were staying there for a bachlorette party and I met up with them there. We arrived just in time for happy hour. Free drinks were available to guests staying there which was nice. The bar itself was very elegant but not stuffy. I did see the rooms my friends were staying in and they were luxurious with practical sizes. I would recommend this hotel to my friends and family.

name: HeinousStorm 602
text: Nice historic building and friendly staff. Small pool up top with nice view and ok size gym. Ok breakfast selection, not complimentary.

name: Orlandria Medlock
text: THE MAGNOLIA HOTEL IS ONE OUR CITIES MOST PRECIOUS GEMS! HISTORY LIES IN THIS HOTEL! THE BEST HOSPITALITY A 4 DIAMOND HOTEL MY OFFER!

name: Ashley Sommers
text: Great place to stay for a amazing rate!

name: Smoky Doggg
text:
They've forgotten how to treat their guests. I stayed here a few years ago and it was great. Now I would give negative 5 if I could. I first noticed the aging dirty floors. Then I got into my room and it was literally 90 degrees, nobody was nice enough to turn on the AC before my arrival. If anyone says breakfast is included call them a liar because they nickel and dime you to death; a bagel is $3.00. There is absolutely no free parking so plan on spending an additional $30 a night over the  room fee for parking.
Nickel and dime nickel and dime...

name: Douglas Willis
text: Great hotel restaurant with great breakfast buffet!

name: MelAnthony Catholic
text: The bed is so comfortable I fell right off to sleep,. The view is awesome bit would be nice if the window could open up just a little so I can get that fresh air in the room. The pictures are beautiful I want one .  The shower head shoots out the right amount of water to massage the body.  Snacks are high though but I understand why.  Im enjoying myself alot though 4 hours left to check out.

name: Shakoha Roby
text: I love the hotel room lay out however when purchasing on through priceline ive always received a window view of the opposite side of the hotel.

name: Anny B
text:
So much to like about this boutique hotel!! Clean room with a comfy bed, big tub with good water pressure for showering, and the quiet room despite all the construction right outside our window - which we were informed about prior to booking! The hotel didn't have the historic vibe that I thought it would, so if that's what you're expecting then, well, sorry! Oh, and parking is valet only. I think it was around $29/night.

FYI - All the little complimentary perks the hotel offers guests:
- Breakfast from 7 am - 10 am (not 100% sure about the time)
- 2 drinks (choice of red wine, white wine, or beer) per guest between 5:30 pm - 6:30 pm
- Milk and cookie bar from 8 pm - 10 pm
- Shuttle to nearby places until 11 pm (not sure when the service starts in the morning)

name: Patrick R
text: The crown molding had spattered fluids, possibly blood spatter? Foot stool infront of chair in room had dirt spots, pealed wallpaper in bathroom Lobby and bar/restaurant was nice. Friendly staff and xmas motif was very nice. Wanted to love this hotel but needs a deep clean and TLC for their roooms.

name: Mesha Raglin
text: Valet was awesome and food was delicious

name: xcesiv rob
text: Great hotel. Large rooms and great roof top pool and hot tub.  Each question was answerwnjthe awake

name: Estela Perez
text: I don't consider this hotel to be a 4 star it's ok  the food is great the housekeeping wasn't great when I went to go reach for the menu in the restroom where the fridge is at it was nasty and sticky the glasses were dusty like they haven't been changed if it looks like no one has used them then I think the person cleaning leaves it my sheets were dirty the curtains were all broken they wouldn't open at all and some of the staff was not so nice only a few were nice. drinks are expensive and not that strong

name: Lamorn Allen
text: I had a blast. The staff was very accommodating.

name: live for god
text: New chef, good food, good services. Overall their job is excellent

name: Matt Jackson
text: This is a neat hotel in Downtown Houston that is on the upscale side of lodging.  The room was very nice and the beds were very comfortable.  We enjoyed cookies and milk at the evening cookie bar.  That was a nice touch that my children especially loved.  The elevators can get very busy on Sunday Morning when people are trying to check out so plan a little extra time.  The breakfast buffet was much better than any other hotel I've been too.  Over all I'd say it's a great downtown hotel option worth checking out.  Another bonus is that it's one block away from the famous Flying Saucer.

name: Raise a fist FOR ANGERFIST!!!
text: Beautiful lobby, great location, easy access to different places around town.

name: Erik Roberts
text: Hotel was decent, room was fine. Service. Well, the same person checked us in that checked us out.  Is it common practice for the magnolia front desk clerk to belittle its customers?  Clerk was female in here 20's was working at night. The overall experience was that me being there was a problem and she was happy to help my wife. I am not used to customer services representatives teaching me a life lesson when i'm trying to check out.

name: david mckemie
text: The hotel lobby was dirty restrooms were dirty and no water for my dog to drink out of never coming back!!!!!

name: Atanacio Garza
text: Great plsce to stay at

name: Searching 4 Adventure
text: Sent to room 2015 which was already vacant. Awkward. Sent to room 1513 which faced a fire escape. Bathroom was nice. Everything else was basic. There are better hotels at this cost. Avoid breakfast if possible

name: William Bradberry
text:
Stayed for the Eagles concert and not worth the almost $300.00 I spent for one night.
With as many people who also stayed for the concert, poor planning for staff as the bar service on the second floor sucked.  We sat at the bar and it took twenty minutes to get a drink and another fifteen to place an order for food.

name: John Kitto
text: Wonderful property in the heart of downtown. Great staff and roof top pool and hot tub was an excellent end to a long day.

name: Anna Din
text: Loved it! Hot tub was a bit too packed when I went, but overall had a great experience staying here.

name: Jess Max y Alex M
text: I was very excited to stay in this hotel w my husband when we got there everything change. Is so expensive for what it is. I did nt like this hotel at all never going back. The only things i did like was the soap and it has a nice view in their roof of Houston that's it!

name: Bruce Soo Chan
text: In the heart of downtown houston! 5 mins away from the Houston Aquarium, lots of landmarks to see, & things to do

name: Zane Forsythe
text: This is a very nice hotel in a fun part of Houston. My wife and I loved our stay and the restaurants nearby.

name: Nathan Welchert
text: The hotel is in a fantastic location, and has really nice rooms with a view of downtown Houston. Just stayed overnight to see a basketball game and was in walking distance of the stadium.

name: vkl0253
text: The photos are pretty deceiving. I like the location, but everything is pretty worn down. I picked this hotel because of the photos. During my trip to Houston I stayed at the Marriott Marquis and here. There's no comparison.

name: Matty Buckets
text:
We were considering buying a beverage out of the pre-stocked refrigerator so we moved the items around to make a decision. We decided not to buy any but the items have sensors that caused us to be billed 179 dollars. They rudely dismissed the charge but threatened us with a 25 charge if this happens again. Don't worry about that Magnolia...there won't be another time.

On top of this, we were given a room that was not what we booked, the drains were clogged, and the carpet was filthy.

name: Laura W
text: Nice.  Good food.  Valet parking a little high for my taste.

name: Felix Hernandez
text: Great place to have a wedding reception or just to stay while visiting Houston

name: Alf Raju
text: First visit to this hotel & brand, late check in was great, overall service very good, check out stopped them getting 5stars

name: Guadalupe Aguirre
text: Magnolia is the place to stay when in Houston. Excellent service.

name: Dexter Williams
text: You know why,The Magnolia hotel gives you that feeling of privacy & among others ,is that international symbol of class like your in another foreign country in while your in North America all alone i like the veiw as well.

name: Chicken and Watermelon network
text: Just somewhere to lay your head. NO PARKING $35 charge... Staff is nice but Super ghetto... Only had 1 shower robe so called 4 times never got one... When we first checked in they have pubic hair and cum in the bathroom... They did come clean condom and pubes out of the tub though... Valet dudes work hard and are kool but slow...

name: Chris Hokanson
text:
Very much enjoyed our stay here.
Pros: Comfy rooms, quality complimentary Breakfast, complimentary milk & cookie bar from 8-10p, tons of great bars and restaurants within 2-3 blocks, rooftop swimming pool
Cons: Tiny swimming pool, rooms not very large, not much for kids
Good for romantic stays, not really good for families.

name: Gabriel Terrel
text: Newly updated space for corporate events. Good catered food.

name: Laura Espinosa
text: Beautiful hotel!!! View was amazing staff was very friendly. My husband and I will be coming back

name: Charlie C.
text: Very nice place!  My room is a reasonable size and the lounhe/bar is fun.

name: Sam Houston
text: I came to the Magnolia for a private professional event. The food was fine, the attendants at the door were friendly and the facility was modern and clean. My only gripe would be that parking was $14/day in the nearest garage, which was inconvenient since I only really needed to park for two hours.

name: Julia N
text: Beautiful older hotel.

name: Jim Johnson
text: Great location for downtown venues and the staff was very helpful during our stay. The rooms are above average but not overly fancy.

name: Kevin King

Also, valet is the only way to park here, but it isn't complimentary, so expect an additional $30 charge for that when you check out. TL;DR: Magnolia hotel is dirty in more ways than one. Best to avoid it.

I tried several times to get the incorrect charges reversed but to this date I haven't had a single call returned.  I would NOT recommend this hotel.

text:
Romantic getaway in the heart of Houston.
Mg and the misses recently spent the night here and when we arrived, it began to pour down rain. The valet at the check in counter was quick to grab an umbrella and help me with my bags and get our car out of the street and into the garage. Once inside, you wouldn't believe the clean subtle beauty of the lobby with a fire place to warm us up and the check in was quick as we had arrived early thinking we would have to wait but not here. The room was over looking the city and on the second floor hosted a complimentary happy hour with free drinks! The dinner was excellent and a shuttle bus was on call to take us to the theater district with little to no wait.
You want to impress your significant other, book a night at the Magnolia!

absolutely BEAUTIFUL hotel!!! Modern decor.

What will not make you smile?
Parking... $24-28/night
But you've been warned!

What will make up for that?
-Suites have a full kitchen-- oven, fridge, plates, silverware, wine glasses
-Terry cloth robes
-Gilchrist & Soames shampoo/conditioner
-Complimentary wifi
-Complimentary full hot breakfast-- bacon, eggs, pastries
-Complimentary beer/wine during happy hour
-Complimentary cookie buffet at night
-Rishi organic tea & good coffee

Our room was clean & service was good!
Definitely recommend :)

text: Always love going to Benihana. The place is always busy. If you come with a larger group they will not seat you until everyone in your group is there so make sure your whole group is there and ready to be seated. The food is always great, the alcohol drinks are good but are a little on the weak side, they could be a little stronger. My kids love to see the chef prepare and cook the food. It's a wonderful experience and the food is SOOOOOO GOOD!! The only thing that some what upset me is the waitress added a 18% gratuity tip to my bill. We came with a party of 15, everyone paid for their own and I paid for my kids and myself which was a total of three. So technically it was really a party of three for us. Even though it was separate tickets for everyone in our group, is it still considered a party/group of 15? What was my concern is the 18% gratuity was automatically added to my bill by the waitress, I wasn't given the opportunity to decide for myself what I wanted my tip to be or if I wanted to leave a tip at all! There is no option on the receipt to write what you would like the tip to be. They hand wrote and added the 18% gratuity to the total of my bill and then  circled what that total was and gave me the receipt. If anyone should be getting a 18% gratuity it should be the chef because they do most of the work, the waitress just takes the orders and bring you your drinks. I am basing my five stars on the great food, the wonderful experience and the great time my kids had!

I normally like to enjoy my fried rice with the rest of the meal but had to eat it quickly so i could enjoy it.

Food overall was great, but we were there for a total of 2 hours. left the place smelling like the food and on top of that freezing cold.
Wait Staff was great and kept everything filled.
Final note: kinda lame you cant use your birthday certificate on the weekend or at lunch. its a sizable discount so i was excited to use it, but i dont go out on weeknights so its gone now.

name: Terry Pierson
text: Very disappointed. Got the Lunch Duet, which is two entrees, planning on eating one for lunch and one for dinner. Got the Yakisoba and Hibachi Steak. It's about 4 oz of meat, which was overcooked (asked for medium, it was well done), and lacked hardly any flavor. The Yakisoba wasn't much better, it's enough food and the vegetables were well cooked, but also flavorless. The side of veggies were overcooked, though. Their "signature" dish onion soup tastes just like it sounds, just some onion boiled for a bit and a few mushrooms tossed in at the end. The best quality part was the vegetable fried rice, but again that also lacked any flavor, and really any veggies too, a couple pieces of carrot is it. For paying $16 I expected better quality and flavor, to eat it I had to cover it in Sriracha (my own, not provided). I might as well go to the cheap Chinese restaurant and pay half the amount...

I don’t know if my server was just overwhelmed or new but could not be found when I needed something. I can most definitely say that both the cook and server Catered to the needs of the other family more so that to me and my children.  He placed the salt and pepper on one end of the table but never got me one.  Why would you not provide the other end at the same time.  Like they are more likely to leave a bigger tip than me so let’s do everything for this side.  Because I was stereotype I left well over the suggested 22% tip.  To prove a point.  I don’t know if it was the cook or the company that decided to cut back on the ingredients but the food was favor less and for the price you pay I expected a lot better than how I was treated. name: Kevin Adcock
text: This place serves the absolute best Pho anywhere in Houston. I've tried the vast majority and Pho Binh beats them all hands down. My family loves this place so much we regularly drive across town when we need our fix. The location is tucked away in a strip where parking can be tricky during peak times, but well worth it.

name: Marie Neely
text: Bahn Mi and Pho is ALWAYS on point. This place isn't fancy but dining area is clean and the food is good. You can order to go as well. No waiters or waitresses. You order, get a number and they bring your food out to you. Price point is as it should be for the food received. They have various teas, fresh juices and smoothies too. Can't go wrong. Give them a try. Masks required for service.

text: Vietnamese coffee is delicious but the one here is the best I've had. I can't even describe it properly but it's chocolatey and STRONG. All the other food was delicious and fresh. ☺

Although you get a very generous portion of beef it stays a bit to red for how hot the broth is.
