text: I am an extremely particular customer but I frequently visit this place. I like the red juice. The staff is superb.

name: deadlyhandsomeman
text: The meat is very tender and marinated perfectly. The price point is appropriate for lunch. Very delicious.

name: Fernando Sanchez
text: Great service and good pho. The spicy marrow with bread was extremely greasy and flavorless.

name: marky mark
text: Chicken pho was bland. The springs rolls were just ok. Wouldn't recommend of you're wanting pho. Would be better off eating a bag of Ramen noodles. And alot cheaper.

name: Jean Dib
text: Food is always good, affordable, and they are generous with their meat and noodles. This is one of the good ones in the area. Their broth isn’t oily either like many pho restaurants.

name: Robin Smith
text: Excellent Pho, Vermicelli and iced coffee with a friendly staff.

name: W Trent Pokorny
text: Delicious and well worth trying.

name: Gerardo Reoyo
text: Excellent pho, have been here several times and tried various dishes. Have never been disappointed.

name: Ralph Fite
text: Excellent pho and spring rolls.

name: Merci Lim
text: My co-workers eat here almost 3 times a week. The broth is superb and the quality is super consistent. I love order the Pho with tendon and a side of bone marrow.

name: William Rankel
text: Great service!   Really good Vietnamese food for the area!  Been here several times over the years and you can't go wrong!

name: Alejandro Rodriguez
text: Soup is great , coffee also amazing.  Egg rolls complete the meal. Outstanding.

name: Rodolfo Mayorga
text: Me and my wife went to this Restaurant for lunch and it was amazing. Thank you!

name: Hande Berilgen
text:
I really do like Pho Binh for Pho. I think the pricing with the amount of food you receive is well delivered. I also love their smoothies.

I wish they would serve to tables rather then ordering at register like I do understand lunch time but maybe at night they could switch :)...

But among that is a place I would advise everyone.

name: Stephanie mcbride
text: The pho was good.

name: Falcon W
text: My favorite pho place in town. Great broth and fast as can be.

name: Jaime Diep
text: Pho is so so.  Not authentic, has been customized for the non Viet customers.  Not as flavorful.   Space is clean and spacious.

name: Alex Casares
text: Very good food

name: Valencia Dotson
text: I just moved to the area and I was so happy with the prices and the food was good. I loved the quick and correct service also. This may be my new favorite restaurant for a while.

name: Mary Tran
text: More like a more expensive fast food joint than an asian restaurant. Pretty much order at the counter and then get your utensil/napkin/fountain drink. The pho came out pretty quickly, not much in the bowl and the meat isn't premium.

name: SayWHA Radio
text: Open on New Years Day so friends and I decided to go. Got a Banh Mi sandwich. It was very good but the chicken was a bit bland. My friends said the pho was very good but felt like there was MSG in it. As they got the itis afterwards. That may have just been due to being full lol. Great atmosphere.

name: Caitlin Zeigler
text: This place is always great when we come here! Amazing Pho!!

name: Herbert A. Quintanilla
text: Great Vietnamese food. The place is cozy and has good vibes, they offer a big parking lot and great service. Call them ahead if you plan takeout so you don't have to wait akwarly on one of the tables.

name: Jenny S
text: This spot is close to my apartment and I think their pho is okay. I prefer the 59 south location off Beechnut. Their food entrees look good though every time I saw an order come out I turned my head. I will come back and try a rice dish. My cousin always raves about their cakes so that’s on my list to try also.

name: Albert Moyer
text: The soups here are fantastic! I am a big fan of Dac Biet. This soup has four cuts of beef. The spring rolls are delicious too. I have loved everything I have eaten here for several years.

name: sebastian rodriguez
text: Great price great phó!

name: michael chang
text: Great and consistent food with friendly service.

name: Autumn Stuch
text: This is my favorite pho spot! Good portions, delicious food, good prices and nice atmosphere. Food is really fresh too!! I also really enjoy the calming music paired with a hot bowl of pho. Really comforting place. Would recommend to anyone!!

name: Critical Reaction
text: The food and the atmosphere was great, the servers were ready and happy to help with any questions I had

name: Ashima Joshi
text: We usually eat grilled chicken and grilled pork + rice combo... it’s the best we’ve had !

name: Sherwanda Foster
text:
In the door I was pleasantly greeted. Without asking I was informed of staff picks, standards and customer faves😊. Awesome from the start and nowhere to go but up.  Haven’t gotten the order yet....spoke too soon😏!!!!
I’m back. The sunrise passion fruit smoothie was awesome. Not too sweet, smooth not icy texture and very filling. It’s all I had room for. My sons dumplings were really good. Tender hot and steamy. Made to order. If you in a hurry get em fried. His lemongrass beef bahn mi( recommended by the greeter/cashier) was gone in a flash. Either he was starving or it was just good. This place is located in a strip mall with Minuit coffee on the outer corner and a newly opened Karaoke restaurant nested in the inner curve with a Yougurtland right next door. It has patio seating and was nice and cold inside but the greeter pleasantly obliged me by turning on one of the space heaters to knock a lil chill off.
The food was really good and fresh but I’ll be back for the customer service 1st😏.

name: One Service
text: This is me possibly in and around the time that I enjoyed one of the best combination large bowl (Phos) photos of my life.

name: Lucien Zaldana
text: Have been dining here for years. Obviously the Pho is great some of the best broth and they give you cilantro also which many places do not. Everything is very tasty but the cakes are an unexpected treat there.

name: Sergey Sarcembek
text: Nice place with great food and nice staff!

name: Josh Lavian
text: Delicious pho.

name: Jason Monteiro
text: Friendly staff, fast service, good food, and cozy environment. It's all you can ask for

name: Brett Tapoyo
text: I love the food! It is tasty and filling. The bubble tea is also a must try!!

name: Pedro Erick Muñoz Torres
text: Excelent food, clean, great price, but the cashier unpolite, agresive, is the worst service around....

name: George R
text: Great place to eat and a good selection to choose from. Hot soup on a cold days makes for a great meal. Worth a try and recommended.

name: Jose Ortiz
text: I always order Pho Ga... This one was light on Ga but overall tasty.  The fresh vegetables tray was also smaller than I would have liked... Perhaps I was too hungry.  I'll definitely come back and see for myself if this was a one time fluke.

name: Jutikant S
text: Excellent Vietnamese food that comes with affordable price! The egg rolls and fried dumplings’s sauces were amazing as well

name: Siwan LEE
text: Taste of noodle is not good, sandwich is pretty good tasty for Asians. People can go there with low budget. It's best reason to go!

name: LM Ulloa
text: Can't believe I live on the next street over craving vietnamese eggrolls for a year and this place was right here. I definitely got my eggroll fix. To dine in and take out. Oh and my lychee smoothie with boba. Haven't had one since Hawaii. Will DEFINITELY come in again and often and try out more of what they have to offer especially the pho.

name: Wolf Husky
text: Close to 59 and Chinatown. One of the best pho place in houston. Broth and noodle are amazing. Friendly service and delicious noodle soup on a cold day!

name: RJMcEathron
text: This little restaurant is tucked away in the corner of a shopping center off of Westheimer and Fountain View. The staff is friendly and the food is amazing. Their phö is great but my personal favorite is the grilled pork bahn mi. Check them out!

name: Chiti Ho
text: Very generous portion of the Chicken Vermicelli. Big bowl loaded with mountain of grilled chicken breast. Very healthy option for the quick lunch.

name: Britt S
text: Bubble tea and pho were great. Very excited to come back.

name: cupcake cc
text: Pho Binh is delicious.  Great customer service, friendly environment and the pho is delicious!   They use fresh beef broth and no msg unlike other restaurant.  Another delicious food is the nem nuong sandwich top it w an Italian cream cake for dessert!!

name: Kate Smith
text: My favorite pho in town.

name: Andi Marban
text: If you like chicken pho like we do, this place is a go to.

name: Kathy Wells
text: Pho, super delicious. Normally I would have posted a pic but food looked so good I couldn't stop. Service is typically good. The bill was well within reason for the quality.

name: Stewart Rasberry
text: Great place to eat!  Good food and great service!

name: Dinara Jones
text: I love this place! Their food is always fresh and delicious! The prices are affordable and the menu is extensive. I usually get their brisket phô. They also have a buy 2 bobba tea, get one for free deal!

name: Larry Sellers
text: This hidden gem is the best pho in Uptown and one of the best in Houston. I love the pho with brisket, but don't overlook the fried pork dumplings. Get some chili oil to dip them in and it provides a great spicy kick to complement the pho. Fast service, good price.

name: Sebastian Nguyen
text: Really good broth and noodles good quality. Beef is nice and tender to the point that it melts in your mouth easily. I would recommend to prefer the bone marrow it is a like butter I personally love it if you never tried it then give it a try see if you like it or not. Enjoy your meal.

name: Javi Salom
text: This restaurant has pretty good Pho. The the consistency of the broth is spot on, the taste is good, price is fair for the dish, location is convenience, customer service was great. If you are really in the crave for a good lunch pho this is a good place to go.

name: Jose Andres Chirinos
text: Soup is the best

name: Eric Montgomery
text: The pho is ok; the broth was on the weak side.

name: N C SINGSON
text: Just tried the Shaken Beef & it was very goood!! Tender:)  I usually don't like bell peppers but I like the way they cook & season these! Cooked with love♡ The lady(maybe she's owner or manager also took care of me very well, made me feel very welcome:):)  The Pho & other items are always good too!  I'm so glad they're right here & I don't have to drive all the way to Chinatown ..just wish they had more Vietnamese desserts

name: Bill Mendoza
text: Best place in town!!

name: Lori Ruiz
text: Best Pho in town hands down!

name: Mara Martinez
text: If the best pho ever. It’s tasty and the meat is well cooked in the p5 compare to other places that is served raw. I love this pho!!!!!

name: Isaias Amaya
text: Ordered the steak and brisket pho. The noodles were a little hard. The broth was great tasting. The fixing were enough. Overall, I enjoyed the pho but I've had better noodles. It might be because we went late at night.

name: Trillion Phoenix
text: The Banh mi was...meh. Didn't try the pho.

name: Jennifer Bezdicek
text: The food and service is always on point

name: Jeff Oldham
text: This place is a gem in an otherwise less than attractive, typical Houston strip mall.  The chicken pho is delicious and I'll definitely be back to try other items.

name: Louis, Felton Williams
text: Delicious soup and service with a smile is always appreciated and the egg rolls are divine!

name: Adam P
text: I come here regularly. It may not seem swanky, but the product is as good and authentic as you'll get in Houston. I'm a fan of the P4 and P6 myself. Spring rolls are also good.

name: Allycia Mallory
text: Affordable and delicious. The only place I’ll go to for Phò. I’ll go from the North side to the Southwest just for it.

name: yari
text: The food here is consistently delicious! They have my favorite Vietnamese sandwiches and dumplings. The pork is so tender and flavorful while their chicken is lean and tasty.  Even their veggies, thinly sliced carrots and cucumbers, are sweet and tasty. There's lots of options for drinks and yummy, creamy cheesecake.

name: Yuanming Li
text: Best Vietnamese restaurant I've tried.

name: Oleg Kim
text: My favorite place. When I want Pho I go there. Hight recommended!!

name: Jimmy Kilpatrick
text: Outstanding soup.

name: Ivan Villanueva
text: Excellent service. Great food

name: Gesina Miller
text: Super yummy and great priced

name: Travis Morgan
text: Very clean and friendly staff. Excellent Pho!

name: stace face
text: Always serves a delicious bowl of pho. Quick for a lunch break.

name: Stephanie Hall
text: Excellent! The beef (steak) pho had a nice robust flavor. Additions of jalapeño, basil and cilantro kicked up the flavors a notch, lime was a small wedge, but juicy enough to cover the regular bowl.  Chicken looked amazing and had a wonderful aroma.  I will definitely be back.        Fairly easy, free parking.

name: Krista Hoffman
text: I've had better Vietnamese food, and this place is always super busy.  I'll only come if I don't have time to go to another place to get a spring roll.

name: ADE Freeman
text: I absolutely love this place. The prices are great and the food is A1! It’s akways fresh and the 🥟 are 😋!!Great place for lunch or whenever you 🤧 or just want some 🍲.

name: Mark Kirschke
text: Very good Pho, lots of things to put in it to customize the taste to your liking.

name: Brittany C
text: By far the best place to get Pho or Vermicelli noodle dish in the galleria area. I have tried 3 or 4 other places before I found Pho Binh they are outstanding people. Fast. And great food!!

name: Veronica Reyes
text: Fresh and delicious pho! Fast service during lunch

name: Brianne F Beatty
text: Pho is awesome. Grilled chicken is very good. Fast service. Great lunch spot.

name: Mike X
text: Great pho. Good price. You serve yourselves, but don't have to tip.

name: Brohan
text: Great value, amazing tasting meats and broth

name: Adriana
text: Affordable, delicious, and worthy of five stars for great service. I recommend trying the coffee drinks they are amazing.

name: Grace Abbott
text: Best Vietnamese coffee I've come across in Houston. Great environment and friendly staff.

name: Sha Sha
text: I came in no one greeted me and so then I went to sit down and still no one came to service me. I finally got up and went to counter and asked if I could get a menu. 😡😡😡Mgr apologized and sent some one over. I did eat there and maybe they put something in my food. 🤔🤔🤔Mgr said he would give me a discount on food. My bill was $15.00 and he gave me $1.50 for my inconvenience. I will not be going back to this restaurant.

name: Franklin T
text:
I liked it... O went there for Pho. Soup was good. A lot of choices available., and staff was nice. The place is clean and very modern. It doesn't look like some Asian restaurants on Bellaire with a weird smell, old waiters and dirty clothes.  I will go there again.
The only problem there is finding a parking spot there on weekends for dinner.  So if you are going in family, you better grab only one car. Lol

name: Yolanda Thakidd
text: Didn't care for this location at all. First one I've been too where the grilled pork was tough and unflavorful....not to mention my noodles were cold. If the manager/owner would listen more than making excuses it probably would be better.

name: Amanda Buchmuller
text: We got the pho with steak and brisket as take out. It was delicious! I also appreciated their attention to detail. They give you plenty of meat, noodles, and veggies as well as sauce packets. The presentation was nice with special spoons, chopsticks, and nice packaging for the individual soup elements. Definitely the best looking take out pho I've ever had. It tasted great too! The restaurant seemed nice and clean when I picked up our food and the staff were helpful and friendly.

name: Michael Broussard
text: Ordered Chicken Pho, it was suprisingly bland, maybe watered down? A little disappointing.

name: David LW
text: Inexpensive, no frills, Vietnamese restaurant. Tasty food.

name: Wes Waldroup
text: So delicious!

name: Victoria Fisher
text: Never disappoints.

name: Lisa Bialas
text: Juicy pork banh mi, good lunch special deal

name: Anthony Nguyen
text: It's the same as most vietnamese restaurants, but what separates it from the rest is the environment. Has coffee shop vibes and it really went with the dining experience.

name: Pinkiezup
text: Omg their iced coffee is the best!

name: Alicia Patino
text: My husband & I have come here a dozen or so times and we've been MORE than satisfied each and every time. It doesn't matter if we go together or if we're taking someone new during their lunch rush. They're very clean, friendly, and have quick service that's always correct. The soup is flavorful, the sandwich bread is nice and crisp, the pan-fried pork dumplings taste light & aren't oily, the veggies and sides are always fresh. Plus they have an online ordering option for delivery or pickup.

name: Diego Segaline
text: Friendly service, great food, clean place.

name: Greg Coe
text: The food was good, but not great and there are any number of other Vietnamese restaurants that offer better service at better prices. For my family of 3 we had a shared appetizer that came out after our Pho and 3 drinks. Before tip it was $49+. You order and pay at the register before you get your food so if you are paying with a card you have to tip first. We got there at 9 and I ordered ice tea (self service). They broke down the ice  tea and turned off the soda fountain before closing so we couldnt get refills. They closed at 10 and kept trying to take our dishes while we were still eating. This started about 20 minutes before closing.

name: Michael Jones
text: Very good pho and spring rolls. This is our go-to spot. Broth is delicious and meat is tender.

name: B Montoya
text: I really love the pho here. Try it some where else but I always find myself coming back to this place! Pork dumplings are also good!

name: S. Toro
text: It's a really good pho

name: Mark McIntyre
text: This was a good place two years ago.  Not so good recently.

name: Rachel Ortega
text: I had never tried Pho before my first visit here. It was so much better than I expected. I also tried their banh mi and Vietnamese coffee, both of which were excellent. I will definitely be back when I’m in the area.

name: Jessica Cordero
text: It's almost always one of my favorite places, they have excellent smoothies and it's not expensive

name: brand71984
text: Had the steak and brisket pho, spring rolls and fried dumplings. Everything was excellent! Will definitely be back. Very friendly staff as well.

name: M
text: Food was decent. Person ringing up the order was funny.

name: Sam Meitzler
text:
Love this place
They have everything
I love that they have great desserts and boba

name: Elissa m
text: They have the BEST pho! I could eat there everyday 😋

name: Erica Wright
text: Great food. Fast service.

name: Jill Sorensen
text: Delicious food in a casual atmosphere!

name: Stefanie Wozniak
text: MY FAVORITE Vietnamese spot in Houston! We even moved and I’ll drive 20 minutes to get my regular P3 bowl of pho. This place is soooooo good.

name: Royal Highs
text: Lovely noodles very healthy place to eat any time off he week and the prices are accordingly fair 👍

name: rubi patino
text: That have changed the booths in here look a lot more open food it awesome I always order p7 my husband order p15

name: Hima Neckers
text: Delicious pho! Will be back here again

name: Top Shelf
text: Chicken dumplings were good, not so much for the sandwich. I asked for chicken and pork but the chicken came on the side which was weird. workers were polite but don't think I will be returning, wasn't as good as their heights store or nobi.

name: Zachary Gibson
text: Magic Avocado Coconut Smoothies are.... MAGICAL! Mind blown does not sound amazing and it totally is. Google said "fast places",  holy cow Google nailed it! Before we sat down our Pho was on its way to the table. Definitely a place worth trying. We came out on a friend's recommendation and it was a real treat.

name: Erik Richards
text: Affordable and delish

name: Victor Mann
text: Fast and friendly service. The restaurant is clean and the food was very good. I recommend the Pho with chicken and the spring rolls.

name: Travis Hookham
text: Delicious Pho close to the Galleria. From the broth you can taste the quality ingredients and time it took to make. No instant soup here!

name: William Texas
text: Nice small Pho restaurant. The Pho and dumplings that I had were both delicious. I'll go back.

name: Niaz Mustafa
text: Really good pho and great service!!

name: Alfredo G
text: Great Pho place. Prices were reasonable and service was prompt. Definitely recommended.

name: Javier Fadul
text: Amazing food, wonderful service, really, I mean it, some of the best pho in Houston. They have a great selection of traditional dishes from Vietnam, but the pho really stands out. Get the p7 which is sort of a sampler plate with different kinds of meat. The split rolls stand alone as a great appetizer as well, and if it's an extra cold or rainy night ask for a small or medium bone marrow to put in your soup. It will heal you.

name: Tanya S. Khan
text: Great food and service

name: Holly Cordova
text: This place is really good. It is reasonably priced, I usually pay a lot more for pho. I wouldn't say it's the best I have ever had but it's very good. Would def recommend.

name: Google User
text: I work nearby, and this is some pretty good pho for the area. I don't feel the price is right for the portion, but within a several mile radius, it's the closest thing you can get to pho from the International District (commonly referred to as "Chinatown on Bellaire") in Houston.

name: Cristina Munoz
text: Great as usual! They also have a great variety of desserts 😋

name: Chad Austin
text: Ignore the haters. This place stays packed for a reason. Solid pho, clean place, good fast service. They just need better napkins! Ha! Pho is messy and the napkins are tiny and frail. But I don't come for the napkins. I come for the phoooooooooo with extra cilantro thank you ;-)

name: Mirle
text: Simple pho but very well done. Drinks with tapioca are great. Momos tasted delicious as well.

name: Honey 4
text: Service was very good food was delicious

name: Ashley Guzman
text: Love at first bite! Awesome pho. Eat here every time I'm in the area. Great coffee too!

name: john cast
text: Much better than the one in 59sw frwy and gessner/westheimer already tried at least half of the menu, I have had coming here since 2014 no complain, food taste is really good but there is always room for improvement.

name: Donna Smith
text: Great food! Good location. Courteous staff! Clean.

name: eddo cino
text: Not the best pho... pretty meh

name: Michael Delagarza
text: Great food, at an even better price.

name: Kevin Pham
text: Way overrated. Food just mediocre. Cater to American style and taste. I am not a fan of self service at Vietnamese restaurant. It's not very inviting place.

name: Sergio Orellana
text: Fast service with delicious food. If you have never tried pho, this place is a must go.

name: Lisa M B
text: Great service and food!

name: Erica Biz
text:
Google led me astray on this one. Girl at the counter misunderstood my order. Pro tip: Don't name menu items "G7" and "P7" if the people who work the counter don't understand the difference between the letters G and P!

Pho was mediocre, bland, and very stingy on the meat. The restaurant looks nice, but there are many better places nearby that have better pho. I would not return.

name: Derek Doredant
text: It was ok at best. The pho broth was kind of bland. I wouldn't go back.

name: Mike Dines
text: The Pho here is great - the broth has loads of flavour.  Have tried 4 or 5 other places looking for good Pho and now will stop looking and always go here.  The staff are really friendly too and that, plus the décor and atmosphere makes for a really good experience.

name: Michael Dominguez
text: Bad service and very bland food

name: Sandi Ramirez
text: Wonderful noodle soup. I love the desert that they have here also. And they always have great lunch and dinner specials. Get the pho.

name: Sam B
text: Ordered the chicken noodle pho and tasted very plain. Chicken broth from a can had more flavor. Honestly it tasted like it was watered down for profits. The chicken which tasted like duck was very good thou. I must just ate the noodles with the chicken (duck) and left the broth. Waste of $9. If it was $3 yeah I good see someone paying that for the meat and noodles. Guess I'll stick to pho 45.

name: Taylor Medina
text: Great food, great drinks. Lots of vegetarian options! Super friendly :)

name: A List Real Estate Group LLC
text: Been going here years

name: Candace Green
text: Best place ever

name: Neal Cobos
text: One of the pricier pho spots, but have never left disappointed.

name: Shalini Sarkar
text: This isn't as good as the other Pho Binh locations. They offer rice plates, spring ros, egg rolls and vermicelli bowls. They also have many different cakes.

name: Candice Walton Hyman
text: Every single time. Just the ABSOLUTE BEST!

name: John Zero Signal
text: I give it 4 stars because the guy at the register was nice. The pho wasn't great, but I ate it. Prices are higher than what I'm used to and the food was really just ok.

name: Ray Losoya
text: Sort of expensive. About $40 for two people which included an order of egg rolls, an order of spring rolls, one small beef pho and one large beef pho and two fountain drinks. The brotha was pretty good but AC was out or turned off making it uncomfortable. I could only imagine how the kitchen staff felt.

name: D Griffin
text: Great food..good service

name: Kristee Valdez
text: BEST PHO AND VIETNAMESE COFFEE IN HOUSTON

name: Esther Uche
text: Great asian place. They are fast... no long wait

name: Jason Wu
text: Great food. #7 pho with crispy fat is the best.

name: underoath1516
text: Always love eating here

name: Diane Tarver
text: Had the pepper steak. It was delicious!

name: Morgan Cain
text: Binh mi so delicious fresh ingredients and plated nicely every time. The pho great especially when you add in lime, Sriracha, and hoisin sauce! Tried the fried dumplings today and the sauce so good, I want to put it on everything. Always pair my meal with a thai tea.

name: Jodi
text: Yummy and good price :)

name: Charles Adiukwu, Jr.
text: Great food. Good customer service. If you're looking for amazing pho, this is the place!

name: I Hasan
text: I ordered a thai iced tea with no ice and they gave me a cup half filled. Where is the rest of my drink? NOT COOL

name: Jarrod Stringer
text: Just unbelievable pho... what else can you say?

name: Kara Nguyen
text: Visited the new location @fountaiview and was very impressed! Very nice atmosphere, great service and love the food. Definitely going back :)

name: Johana Herrera
text: Good food and excellent prices

name: momo Bouabca
text: Worst customer service ever specially if you don’t know how the item look like they sell you other than you order and blame the mistakes on you by the dumb owner him self .

name: Luis Rodriguez
text: Good Vietnamese restaurant with very good bahn mi’s. Great place to stop by for a quick lunch.

name: steven song
text: Poor pho in the town be sure!

text: Fresh, with plenty of options and deliciously addictive.

name: Ayodeji Olurin

name: Katie Thomas
text: Best banh mi you have ever had. The pho is really good if you like pho. Spring rolls are out of this world.

name: Brian Barrientos
text: Food is always good, savory, and fresh!  Love eating their Pho Has when sick

name: K Edws
text: My favorite all time place to go. Their pho is phenomenal and so are their smoothies. I like them with tapioca sometimes as well

name: Shirin Delsooz
text: Great food, friendly courteous staff.

name: Nicholas Anthony Montes
text: Great service. Simple Environment. Great, tasty food.

name: Kristina Tran
text: Had to go here cause my usual Pho Bing spot ran out of pho. Same great taste, but I think the portions are different. I ordered a medium but it seemed like a small bowl.

name: Matthew Stephens
text: Ordered a sandwich online $6.95. When I arrived there was a sign stating that all credit card purchases need to be $10 or more. They didn't bother to tell me that when I ordered online. Had to order more food since I don't drink soft drinks. So my sandwich sat and grew cold as they spent 15 minutes making four egg rolls.

name: Haley Bloch
text: Delish, inexpensive, and fast. Love it.

name: Ariana Mata
text: They put a good amount of protein in the pho!

name: Omar Solaija
text: Favorite pho place. They have fast service even during rush times especially around lunch. And the pho tastes great!

name: Amanda Holt
text: Service is great as is the food. Thank you!

name: P G

name: Josh Zhang

text:
One of the best locations for this chain... Far better than the Pho Binh on Bellaire and the one on Barker Cypress. It's one of the better places in town for pho of you like the deep, rich broth (as opposed to clean, crisp).

I usually divide my pho places into two camps: crisp tendon broth or rich marrow broth. This is definitely the latter. I like both and I choose based on the mood I'm in. This is one of my go-to places when I want a rich bowl of pho.

Also try the Lemongrass Beef sandwich. It's a little fatty but good.

This place is a tad pricey for the portions though. You might think you're paying for an x-large bowl, you're not. They also don't load up the meat like some other places.

name: P Doan
text:
Pho Binh has a permanent place in our rotation because of the taste, quality, and price/convenience.

While many of the other dishes are good, I don't go to a pho place to get anything other than beef pho. My go-to choice is the P7 (steak, brisket, and fatty flank - 9/10), but if you're afraid of the flavor of fat, get the P2 or P4 (8/10). My wife sometimes gets the G8 (Grilled Pork & Shrimp Vermicelli Bowl - 8/10) when she wants something lighter.

They have a secret weapon for their pho: marrow. For those who don't know, you can get a small side cup of marrow and concentrated beef juices. Pour some of that into your bowl of pho for a kick of savory flavor that will have you coming back for more like a crack fiend. A small side of marrow is enough for two diners, and they often run out.

Now for price. Some people may argue that you can have cheaper Vietnamese food on Bellaire in Alief, and they're absolutely right. But I'm not interested in driving half an hour both ways just to save $2.50 when Pho Binh is  down the street from my place. Your values and choices may differ.

text: Heavier broth, okay meat. I ordered the large pho dish that came with flank steak, tripe, and fatty brisket. The broth is fragrant and has a meatier taste leaving the broth a bit more heavy than the usually lighter beef broths I enjoy when eating pho. The slices of steak were smaller than I expected and the fatty brisket was kind of lean, and I don't recall seeing any tripe in my pho. They serve in addition a side tray of fresh basil, cilantro, bean sprouts, slices of jalapeno, and a slice of lime; all of which were smaller in portion compared to other pho places I've visited. Overall, my meal wasn't bad and it was filling but it just wasn't great. This is a place where I would go when I crave pho but rather not drive further for better pho.

text:
If you find yourself jonesing for a walk while you are staying in Houston’s Chinatown district, give this place a shot.  It’s just shy of a 2 mile loop and entirely paved. Waterfowl galore can be found at this park.  Most of it is in the sun, but it’s still good for a quick walk.

There’s plenty of parking and there are 3 entrances from the Sam Houston Tollway frontage road, so don’t panic if you can’t change lanes quick enough to get into the first entrance.

There’s a playground, a water fountain near the trailhead, bathrooms with running water, and shaded picnic tables with BBQ grills.

You can do EET!

text: Love this park. The place is huge. There is a playground for the kids with plenty of room and grills for bbq and picnics. There are also 2 restroom areas  along with water fountains, one at the front of the park and the other one further in. There is a small duck pond in the back of the park with plenty of ducks, fish and turtles. There is also 2 workout areas for adult consist of pull up bars and ropes.  Front of the park also have a volley ball area and a raised cement platform where you can do tai-chi, or any aerobic activity. Saw a class of zoomba in the evening, last fall, here. However, the trail around the big lake, which also encompasses the park, has got to be our favorite. The whole thing takes about 45min-1hr walking. Dont know how long  it is, maybe 2 miles or more?  Lots of scenery, the big lake helps bring down the temperature and every breeze flown across the lake is literally a breath of fresh air. Security wise, a lot of time there is a police car at the parking infront of the park and plenty of people walking/running/biking/skating in the morning and evening so the any ladies exercise alone should feel safe enough. The only thing stopping me from giving this a 5 stars is the parking. The thing is too small. A lot of time I have to park at Home Depot and walk over the park due to no parking space. However, they are currently doing construction to expand the park, finger crossed for a new, bigger parking space.😁

As far at the excercise went I put in about two laps in the outter circle of the park two to three days a week, thats a total of 2.14 mile long trip been trying to lose wieght and even cut off from soda lately I have been feeling better about myself and my health.

The view is spectacular, breath taking even great for taking time away from the daily humdrum activities at home best of all the about the greatest thing you will hear about this park is the fact that there is a feeling of security with Security vehicles upfront on standby. Their closing times are established for safety reasons and the Security even enforces it strictly but that's one of the things I like if it weren't for that many of the park's visitors would be forgetting all about the return home it is so relaxing at Arthur Storey Park.

One thing that concerns me however is how alligators got into the center of the park in the first place, were they migrated into the parks "Lake" or did the Alligators all one flooded day decide to just swim in the "Lake" in the middle of the park and decide to just stay there? And if so how many are even in there???    Not enough is even talked about on that subject and I for one was concerned about all this to begin with.

In the end I still love coming to the park as long as there are secure matters about the park today and well the fact that no one has really spotted an Alligator on the trail or on the outer cirlce of Aurthor Storey Park

text: I give the SUBWAY located inside the William P. Hobby Airport at 7800 Airport Blvd Gate D18, Houston, TX 77061 FIVE FOOTLONG STARS. Such great service given by a real kind Sandwich Artist who sure made a delicious Foot Long Tuna Sandwich. Thank You. 5️⃣ 🌟's

text: Quick service as they rush you through the line.

name: Jan Poscovsky
text: This is the best value for a quick bite at Hobby. There subs are always consistent and the price is fair. You can also make your sub a salad. If you are buying 2 subs consider getting a foot long and sharing!

name: Anton Hauglie
text: This gem is hidden towards the end of the gate numbers between 45 and 46. Since it's out of the way you can expect a little less of a wait. Also, it's probably the healthiest food you'll find in an airport. Here's a protip: they serve breakfast all day with the lowest price for a foot long of 6.50. What you can do is order a breakfast footlong and just turn it into a regular sandwich! I recommend steak, egg and cheese

name: Lyndsey Hicks
text: Don't expect much at this location. Awful service. Rude employees. Barely speak to you then get annoyed when you can't hear them. Everything clearly inconveniences them. Zero eye contact. Rush you through the line and do not provide the quality of service most Subways do. It wasn't one employee behind that counter it is all three. Didn't get their names but it is Sunday February 23, 2020 at 9:30 am. They need an action plan and retraining. Awful. I cannot stress this enough. . . Awful.

name: A McDaniel Hamilton
text: What is it about this restaurant that makes the kids want to go here. They had just finished the pizza we bought and now they want a sandwich!?!? Really? We bought two club sandwiches for the flight and a spicy Italian for me...you know... just in case I get hungry on the flight...LoL!

name: todd keller
text: I get through this airport at least 6 times per year and this location is one of my stops because they provide good product and quick service.  The part of the experience that needs improvement is maintaining the dining area.  the space is tight for most travelers with bags which is ok but the tables need to be bussed/wiped off more often, and floors need to be swept more often.  Not a deal breaker...….just an observation.

name: marsha goldstein
text: In an airport setting, when you want to grab a sandwich fast, this may be the best bet. But, overall,  service was slow. The person in front of me had a detailed order, and I was skipped over for the people behind me. I had to say twice that I hadn't ordered. The bread was not as fresh as Subway boasts, and my very simple order seemed to confuse the sandwich makers. When I finally got to the checkout, no one was manning the register and again I waited. It took less time to eat a half sandwich than to make it.

Tastes fresh, with a notch over my preferred spice level, but I can’t find the use of emptying the oil bottle on my dish and the others table dishes too. Not sure if I would come back though, I prefer to save my oil intake for a manchego cheese quesadilla, Nutella bread or pesto pizza.

Great authentic Thai food in Bellaire location.

text: Take the name of the place as gospel; it's Thai, it's fast and it's (very) spicy. We decided to take the set lunch which was 2 or 3 meats with appropriate sides. Unfortunately, the pork dish was very fatty with not a lot of meat and the food itself was very spicy. Frankly our lunches were not very appetizing.

text: Oh my word! this place from the outside you may not look like the place to visit but trust me as a person who enjoys different types of food and considers herself a foodie, this is the most delicious Thai food I've ever had! the staff was so friendly and if you are not sure what to get, just let them know it's your first time. and for the record you must try their fried plantains!!! so so good!

name: Nina Gutierrez
text: Casual cafe style. It's good, order at the counter and then they serve your food to the table. They have vegan options and they are happy to adjust the spice level. Its very fast and if you are in a hurry, choose the instant buffet options! Very good service here, and nice people:)

name: T Mannis
text: Excellent. Modern decor but warm and comfortable. Impressive menu, authentic dishes. Reasonable prices. Located in a nice mall; felt totally safe there at night. Don't miss their beautiful aquarium!

name: M. Nguyen
text: Forget to take pictures. We ordered the red curry with chicken, bamboo bamboos and basil. Of course  perfectly and extremely spicy spice. Also ordered the #46 ground pork, chopped crunchy green beans, onions, basil, jalapenos and thai red chili peppers. Yummy in the tummies.

text: Its been around forever and with good reason.  The food is always good to great here.  You'll rarely ever get a bad dish.  They continue to change the decor up which keeps it fresh and new. People who work there have been there for a very long time so the service is efficient and you get your food out fast.  The 5.50 lunch special is great as well since its a very good bargain for what you get.  The Iunch special selection is the greatest but its fresh and tasty.  Their packaged mango and sweet sticky rice is my favorite amongst all Thai restaurants in the area.

name: Max Capacitor
text: Most dishes here look to be served family style, big entree plate in the middle to be shared amongst all at the table, each with a bowl of rice. I ordered the beef Pad Kra Praw and wow it was out of this world! Really savory, the Thai holy basil spice gives it a very nice sweetness, and the jalapenos a balanced heat. It can be sightly on the oily side so best eaten with rice. The chicken Taste of Ginger dish was a great follow up to the spicy Pad Kra Praw. Lots of stir fried vegetables and chicken but it's a much lighter dish but still moderately strong on the ginger & herb flavor. Overall, one of the best flavor adventures I've had in a long while. Will definitely come again!

text:
One of my favorite Thai restaurants. Their pad thai regular comes as non-spicy which really helps when I go out with friends who can't handle spicy and don't like curry. I LOVE their fried fish. SERIOUSLY!!! So delicious! I know the number by heart. #40. So freakin good! Their mussels are, by the way, the best mussels I've had in Houston. One of the must-trys when checking this place out. Every other table has an order of mussels. The dessert is very popular as well. It used to be $2, but now it's $5 probably from popularity. It' really the only thing I've seen rise in price over the past decade. :P

The decor has improved over the years and two renovations. The service is excellent. I never had a problem with service and they happily help with anything you ask for. :)

name: Kristina Do Nguyen
text:
My friends spoke very highly of this place so when I finally came here, I was highly disappointed. First, it's similar setting to a fast food place, you go up to the front and order first, they bring you your food, and you pay after which doesn't make sense to me. Second, the food was extremely mediocre...It definitely is spicy but there's no flavor or taste really to it. The fried chicken was really tough that it was impossible to cut with a butter knife they give you. The beef and vegetable thing (not sure what it's called because my friends ordered this) had no taste to it. The only semi-good thing is the fish thing (not sure what this is called either) and I don't even like fish. Overall, food is just meh, I would rather go to Thai Gourmet or Nidda Thai Cuisine. Price is decent, but not enough to make me want to go back.

What I ordered:
- Sticky rice with fried chicken
- Papaya salad
- Some beef thing with vegetable
- Some fish thing

Pros:
- Cheap

Cons:
- Food is meh

text: We tried visiting this museum on Saturday, February 13th, at around 1:45 pm. We scheduled an appointment as requested on the museum website. However when we got to the museum, it looked like it was closed. There was only one car in the parking lot that looked like it was abandoned. We tried calling to see if any staff were there, but we got no answer. I saw that there was a review on here from just 2 weeks ago, so I assumed we would be able to visit the museum as planned. I'm not really sure if they were just closed due to the weather because there was a winter storm warning for later in the weekend or if they were closed due to covid. But either way, this should have been posted on their website or on their answering machine/service if they have one. I was looking forward to visiting. Which I was unaware of when I dropped in, but the young lady that was working was super friendly and helpful. She informed me that they wasn't busy and if I could go online with my cellphone....that she could get me in for the 3pm appointment. The museum itself is very beautiful and not to large, so all I needed was maybe a hour. All the artwork was very nice and I'm sure that I would visit them again to see any new pieces. Their elevator was not working during my visit,  and since it was 2 floors....it's not currently handicapped accessible.

Note.....The museum has it's own parking lot on the side, so there is no issues with parking.

name: Angel Fultz
text:
Well, this is a sad, lonely little museum that needs some press! I'm shoutin' from the rooftops that you should get over here! It's FREE and the exhibits are exceptional. HMAAC features unique exhibits that give you the opportunity to experience a piece of Houston culture through different lenses.

I popped in because I read about the Kingdom of Gold: Photos of Ghana exhibit. I spent a bit of time in Ghana, frequently miss it and just needed a little comfort. The photos took me right back to my small village in the Eastern Region. I really felt as if I was there celebrating, dancing and smiling with Ama and Kofi all over again. Ms. Kaplowitz definitely captured the very essence of Ghanaian joy and spirit!

The great thing about HMAAC is that the exhibits are short run, always changing and you never know what you're going to find. Just a few months ago, there was an exhibit focused on the Houston rap scene. I wish I had known and could've seen that!

Check out their site and get over there to experience something you won't find at MFAH (although MFAH is awesome and I am a member!)

Had a dent  on my rear passenger door and was told by another Nissan dealership that the outer panel had to be replaced. Originally, I wanted to pay out of pocket. But if parts have to be replaced, it's more expensive. So I had my insurance adjuster inspect it and he told me that it could be fixed without replacing the parts. But if it needed to be replaced, they can work it out with the dealership.

I decided to go to Sterling McCall instead because of the reviews, and I felt that the other dealership would try to push to replace my door instead of trying to take out the dent. Brandon was my estimator and he looked at it and said it could be fixed. Got my car back faster than I thought! I am satisfied with the service I received from Brandon and the Sterling McCall Nissan Collision Center.

resp.text: Thank you Alexandra for the kind words! It is always great to hear that we were able to make a customer’s experience truly exceptional! We thank you for your business and look forward to your next visit!

name: Jo Castillo
text: I dropped my car off 2 & 1/2 weeks ago to get repaired on two different claims.  I asked the estimator (Don) if my car was deemed a total loss and he stated if the damages to my car were from one claim, then yes it would've been a total loss.  I had two separate claims from two different months.  No one has called me to give me any form of update.  Upon initial drop off, I was told the repairs would take 2-3 weeks so I figured calling them today just to check on how the repairs were coming along, I wouldn't be bothering them.  (I used to work in a body shop so I know how it goes).  When I called, I left Don a message on his v-mail to which he called me back within 5 minutes.  He wound up telling me my insurance company totaled my car a week and a half ago.  Why didn't anyone call to inform me??  My car is just sitting there and I hadn't received a single call from the collision shop or my insurance company (which I'm trying to deal with NOW as well).  No communication!  And please don't reply back saying how "sorry you are and would hope l'll give you the opportunity to earn my business back.." Blah blah blah... Just save it please and thank you for nothing.

resp.text:
Hello Jo, I am sorry but we are not licensed adjusters and therefore cannot officially tell customers their vehicle was totaled. We'd get in hot water if we did that.

The insurance company informed us they were deeming it a total at which point they will get in touch with the owner and go over everything for the final settlement. All of which we cannot see and do not know the final numbers on.

I am sorry this did not happen for you.

Kyle Helmke
Collision Center Manager
281-243-8783

name: Monica Roy-White
text:
I'm so angry! Terrible customer service this morning. Just rude and ugly. So I wind up getting something unstable I really didn't want. No suggested sales. Not helpful.

If you don't have an item, you should take it off the menu. If you don't have ores JUST SAY THAT! IF YOU DON'T HAVE MC FLURRIES JUST SAY THAT!! RATHER THAT GETTING AGGRAVATED WITH ME FOR ASKING REASONABLE QUESTIONS.

I've spent 14 years in the fast food industry and placed most of my focus on the importance of window interactions. This is how you bring in the revenue that funds your tiny pay checks. The speed and efficiency of those interactions determine how your customer base grows and establishes repeat customers.

Management shouldn't allow this and the the window team needs to be retrained. Fortunately, you'll not have to concern yourself with me again.

name: Nexus Fantismo
text: I will preface this by saying: Please read my other reviews. I am not unnecessarily harsh and, if I can say so, I am fair to all of these businesses across Texas. With that said, this McDonald's is the worst. The absolute worst. I pulled up to the speaker and it took over 3 minutes (the song we were listening to on a low volume started and finished before we were even greeted) before I could even place my order. Then they were rude to me, which was odd because our order was not complex (a happy meal and a large drink) and I was absolutely respectful to them in the process. I pay for my order and pull up to the second window and am handed a drink with a lid that was already falling off.... Ok, whatever. I let that go. I am them handed the happy meal box without a word said to me, no thank you or have a good day: nothing. I ask if my daughter's apple juice is in the box and the lady said yes. I took her word for it and pulled off. As I hand my daughter her happy meal she tells me there is in fact no juice in the box. We are already pressed for time, which is why we even got fast food in the first place, so I am very annoyed by this as I asked the employee specifically if the juice was in the box. I hurriedly went back to get the juice, mostly because I am sick and tired of getting incorrect orders from McDonald's, which at that point has happened 3 times in a row from different locations. When we went back and asked for our missing juice, the staff was very rude and and gave me the runaround. After finally getting our juice the employee (the same one that told us our juice was in the box in the first place) didn't so much as offer an apology or say have a nice day. The manager was standing there and offered nothing either. At that point I was furious and made it clear I will never go to their restaurant or any McDonald's for that matter. I will leave negative reviews everywhere that I can and no, I will not take a free menu item becausewhay I wanted was half-decent service and THE STUFF THAT WE ORDERED THE FIRST TIME!!! Please read this: Do not go to this McDonald's or any McDonald's for that matter. There is a Burger King up the road, a Jack in the Box up the road and many more other options of you so choose. Avoid this place like the plague.

For someone that likes to argue with customers, shouldn't be working in a restaurant at all. She thought she was right & I was wrong. My opinion, she should be fired for having an attitude & not taking care of the customers correctly. With that attitude she shouldn't be working there at all.

If anyone is working at a fast food restaurant, let me give you a little tip:

1. Customers are always right, no matter if they are wrong.
2. Never assume that what they order is just that. Always ask if they want the meal or just the sandwich.
3. Never argue with a customer. Don't think that you are going to win solving the problem by arguing.
4. Any personal problems you have, leave them at home. Don't take them to work.
5. Someone who works in these type of places, should show respect. Don't expect the world to revolve around you. This is not Burger King, you can't have it your way.

If I didn't had an appointment nearby, I would've saved $ & gas on eating at home, instead of seeing her stupid face & arguing with her because she thinks she can take the orders wrong. It seems like other customers had complained about the staff: rude, no people skills & blame the order wrong on the customers instead of themselves. Need to close this McDonald's & make it a Whataburger.

text:
Read the reviews and the common theme is wait time. Here’s why:

STOP THE MOBILE ORDERING. Given its location, it’s for people who need to grab and go. Mobile ordering is increasing orders by 2x-3x, but you’re not increasing staff = long wait times.

There’s 20-30 people jammed inside, all content to wait 25 minutes for their latte. I don’t know where these people find time. If you can wait 25 minutes for a cup of coffee, go out to another Starbucks with ample seating and waste company time there. There are no tables. This is not that kind of Starbucks. This is GRAB AND GO.

I’d give it 0 stars, but the staff is friendly and likely over-worked. That’s the only positive about this locale. I feel bad for them. Same problem at Salata.

text: When Toyota announced they were discontinuing my Land Cruiser I figured I was far enough behind the times even though it was a lovable beast. So I picked out a little gem GLE 580 and completed the transaction in 4 hours instead of the usual 6 and with none of the tiresome sales push for the useless add-ons, except for windshield insurance, which from experience I actually wanted.  My salesman, Rhett San Angelo even got me a little discount, which I chalked up as a victory. name: Keertana Chary
text:
We had quite a few terrible experiences here. I recently took in my vehicle to get a simple service done. When I got to the dealership, the gentleman who helped me with my paperwork told me that since I live close enough to the dealership, they will be able to drop my car off for me. Once my car was done, I called the dealership to ask if they can drop it off and was repeatedly told that is not doable.
Trying to get a hold of someone at this dealership was also a disaster. I called my service manager around 1:30 in the afternoon and left a message on his voicemail. Two hours go by and I didn’t hear anything, so I went ahead and called the main Mercedes phone line. The lady who answered, Tammy, said that a drop-off wasn’t possible but that she will connect me with a sales manager. I told her that I already tried to connect with Chris but that he didn’t return my call so if I could speak with someone else that would be great. She told me that Chris was out of office for the day but then guess who my call gets forwarded to? Chris! Of course, I did not leave another voice mail but called the main line back again for my calls to be screened. It would ring a few times, someone would answer, and then transfer me back to Chris’ phone. I decided to try my other phone and guess who picked up! Tammy finally transferred me to another sales manager, Marco, who also kept telling me that they can’t drop my car off today or tomorrow because I didn’t get a full service done and that they don’t provide the service for an oil change, which is different than what I was told by the service guy who checked me in.  After several back and forth, as well as relaying my concerns about contact-less drop off option given that I lived less than a mile away, I was told that they won’t drop the car off.  I further requested that I was flexible with my drop-off and was willing to get my car the next day. However, the manager refused saying once again that they don’t do this for an oil change. We concluded the phone call, deciding that I will just go pick up my car, but the manager eventually called back saying they “found someone to drop off the car.”
Although the outcome of all of this was what I was initially told, I am still extremely disappointed in the lack of customer service at this dealership. Not only are they significantly more expensive than other dealerships, it really seems like they only care about how much you spend. My family has five Mercedes and I have been taking my car to this dealership for four years now. I have had problem after problem at this dealership and only kept going back because of the convenience of having them down the street. This is officially the last time I will have to deal with this place. Half of the stuff they tell you is a bunch of lies and the other half is just ways they can make more money. Take the time to just drive to another dealership and have a more pleasant and peaceful experience there.

name: Hiram Gibbard
text: This review is for the quality of maintenance work conducted on our C250 at Greenway dealership. The two instances we experience were the following. Getting a tire patched at this location will yield you a poorly installed plug. They told the wife they would patch it, and then later after the same tire went flat, we identified they plugged it. Patches should be a standard in the tires of these precision machines. Not plugs. Plug are for the 85 Ford pickup. You shouldn't even have plugs in your department. After the wife finally realized that her husband did better quality of work then the Geenway Mercedes service department, she ask him to replace her spark plugs. While doing so, I found oil on the threads and center electrode of the number one spark plug. This lead me to believe that the oil ring went bad in that cylinder. After further investigation, we realized that the service folks at this same dealership accidentally poured some oil down the opening where the number one plug went into during the  previous oil change. The oil fill cap is right next to the number one spark plug port. When I was taking the spark plug out, the oil had ran pass the threads leaving me to believe that there was something major wrong. In the end, the charges rendered for service do not match the quality of work at this dealership. Word of advice to viewers... have your minor services such as as oil, air, and spark plug changes conducted by a reputably non-Mercedes Benz service auto shop, or a competent DIY husband. You will save a ton of money, and get better quality of work.

Growing up in a Japanese car household, Honda/Acura and Toyota/Lexus were touted as the kings of reliable cars. However, all of the models on these lines the last few years seemed to have regressed into family-oriented, boring cars, and the sporty ones just weren't evolving.

The latest Mercedes C300 caught me eye as it was sporty looking, yet had that classic Mercedes look. Classic-modern - yes please! The dealership actually posted a great price that was unbeatable, even the MB dealer in Austin admitted they couldn't touch it. David helped reserve the car and schedule an appointment so I could make the drive to Houston. The process went smoothly, was straightforward and within a couple hours, I was driving off the lot.

Overall, excellent experience and would highly recommend David and MB Houston Greenway.

The third time I went there the car was only washed, but the small scratches and dents I was told would be removed were still there. I also saw a big crack on the windshield that I did not notice before. The car was however in good shape so we agreed on the price (although they used some pretty aggressive sales techniques that I don't like) and they signed in to perform all cosmetic repairs and replace the windshield. We agreed the car would be ready in a couple of days.
Days are passing and it seems the deal we made does not exists. I keep saying the car will be done tomorrow, but it never does. The interesting part is that I call in, I am told the car will be ready tomorrow and when I make a courtesy call the day of the pick up they say the car is still not ready. They suggested I pick up the car as it is but I refuse to get the keys without the car being 100% ready.

Long story short looking back I would have not have made a purchase there, and that's regardless of the product, it's the way they treat customers.

text:
Imagine a car dealer that is friendly, transparent, helpful, and patient even when your funding doesn't come through as planned. That's what you get with Mercedes Benz of Houston Greenway.

I recently purchased a 2013 Hyundai Genesis from Autonation MB of Houston. My sales advisor was Mohammed, a pleasant and capable young man who listened carefully to what I was looking for and then came up with multiple options for me to consider.

I looked at and drove multiple cars, but having been a previous Hyundai owner I was inclined to work out a deal on the Genesis. On the lot, the car was advertised at $21,998, but once we got back inside, surprise the sticker price was....$18,998. Honestly, I would have bought the car at $21,998, but the sales team was honest and passed along the new price happily.

I asked for a couple of small price adjustments, to which the sales manager readily agreed and we were in the finance office within half an hour. We were preapproved by our credit union, so Kevin our finance advisor, drew up the paperwork with that in mind, and within an hour we were driving our new car home.

But that's not the end of the story. The credit union had some sand in their gears or something, because they kept delaying the paperwork day after day. name: Melissa Joy Yanes
text: PLEASE read this review!!! I am a first time customer to the Mercedes-Benz product and after seeing and hearing all about their product I will say my expectations were set high.  I've dealt with Audi, Lexus and BMW before and I can tell you my service with the salesman, finance manager, and overall experience have been phenomenal.  That being said, I had a horrible experience with the GLA I purchased three weeks ago. First off, the salesman we had sold us a product with "extras" that were not included in the vehicle.  Sirius XM and Apple car play were two features that the salesman explicitly said we had even after asking "tech experts". These missing features were discovered the day after purchase when I went for my tech support appointment (where you sit down with someone to "learn about your vehicle.")  It was at that point where I asked to speak to a manager because I was being told by the tech support expert I didn't have features I was told I had by the salesman.  I don't want to blast the salesman here because after speaking with the manager he went above and beyond to apologize for the lack of experience and knowledge the salesman had on the GLA and Mercedes-Benz product.  Another MAJOR issue was with their warranty. The Certified Pre Owned Extended warranty was advertised as an additional 1 yr/unlimited miles (whichever comes first) AFTER the 4 yr/50,000 mile warranty expired. Numerous employees including managers told us we had a 5 yr/Unlimited mile warranty (they just added 4+1 to get 5 yrs and took the greater of 50,000 and unlimited). This sounded too good to be true (and it was). I called corporate the next day and they confirmed my understanding - that indeed after the factory warranty ended that only a year remained. This is critical for our situation since we drive 30Kmiles/year and thus would exhaust the factory warranty in 1.5 yrs then have an additional year for a total of 2.5 yrs NOT 5 years!!! Overall, my experience at this dealership was not at all what I was expecting from the Mercedes-Benz product.  I am giving this dealership two stars ONLY because of the manager who took time to listen to his unhappy customer and apologize for my experience and for his staff that provided wrong information on several occasions.  My advice... ask questions and if something sounds too good to be true, it probably is!

name: Mark Melish
text:
Excellent experience with Mr. Derrick Hoskins at Greenway Mercedes in Houston. At the end of 2013, towards the end of Mercedes "Winter Event" I was looking for a 2014 E550 with a definite list of options. I am from San Antonio and went to one of the local dealers only to find the E550s were very difficult to come by -not just locally, but nationally. I scoured the online inventories looking for available E550s and went back to the local dealer on New Year's Eve who scoured inventories only to find nothing.
By that time, I had convinced myself that I would be happy with an E350. I didn't have that great new car feeling when I left my dealer, like I should have, only to find an email from Mr. Hoskins who responded to emails I sent everywhere a few days before.
To make a long story somewhat shorter, Mr. Hoskins had located an E550 with the equipment I wanted and worked  tirelessly over New Year's Eve and New Year's Day to make sure it was available and was what I wanted. He also knew I had committed to buy the 350 and although he made sure I knew he had the car I wanted, never pushed me to break the commitment I had made with the other dealer over the 350. I truly appreciate his professionalism in that respect. Most salesman would not have that much respect for another salesman, especially at another dealer.
After making the decision that, for the amount of money I was spending, I should get what I really wanted, and letting the other dealer know my decision (they graciously accepted my decision), Mr. Hoskins worked diligently to close our deal including getting what I was asking for on a "blind" trade-in.  Even until the day I arrived at Greenway and met Mr. Hoskins, I was waiting for something to happen because everything had gone so smoothly.
Mr, Hoskins, is a true professional and I never felt like I was dealing with the "typical car salesman" that many people fear they will have to deal with.  Our deal went smoothly and quickly with no hidden obstacles or tricks and I was very impressed with Greenway Mercedes and especially Mr. Hoskins.
This time, when I drove away from the dealer, I had the feeling you should have after buying a new car!

name: Nate Church
text: I am a big fan of places that have a great atmosphere downtown. Pappasito’s did not disappoint! The food was delicious, the service was fantastic, and the location was super cool. We ate outside and it was so much fun to eat with downtown Houston all around us. I had the chicken enchiladas, which absolutely did not disappoint. The menu pricing is not too high, be prepared to spend between $15-$35 per plate. I would recommend this place and hope to return to enjoy their food again soon.

name: belinda sierra
text: I went yesterday late afternoon to have a drink with my dad and brother. The restaurant was very clean,  the host was nice. Or waiter Quintin was very nice also. He made recommendations and seemed to know his drink menu very well.  My dad liked the alcohol beverage that Quintin recommended, based on what my dad said he liked.   Thank you Quintin.

name: The World I See
text: The food was great! The only issue I had was my server paid more attention to tables he had more than two people at in fact if it hadn't been for a waitress that came by and saw me looking around for 20 minutes for the guy to come and grab my credit card that it already been sitting on the table for 20 minutes. She came up and asked if I wanted her to take care of the bill and I said yeah that'd be great, I don't even have a bill yet because he won't come back over here and acknowledge me. so she went and took care of it and as much as I think his service was absolutely horrendous, I still loved him a little bit of a tip more than I think he deserved. But the restaurant is absolutely a chill atmosphere and the food was extremely good!

name: Kimberly Effinger
text: The cost for the amount of food is pretty insane. I would never eat there if I hadn't had a gift card. The other problem is that the food is quite bland- the salad had no flavor and the "guacamole" is basically just cut up avocado- barely any salt, barely any lime. No other flavors. Ridiculous for almost $14. The steak was cooked beautifully and it was very tender, but not enough reason for us to go back.

name: James DeGhelder
text: It is a good restaurant, the only problem is this Pappasito's is about 30% more than the other outlets.  So bring a strong credit card.

name: Marko Isaac
text: Our favorite Mexican restaurant no matter how many other ones we try! Great location in downtown

name: Happy Days
text: This is lovely Mexican food place. Food were perfect. Service was good. I love this place. I never drink watermelon margarita with watermelon flavor

name: Caitlin Lowery
text: My boyfriend and I got the Chicken Fajita Nachos (I got my chicken on the side and gave it to him. Double chicken for him and Vegetarian Nachos for me). The nachos were good. Not the best nachos I've ever had or anything. The Wave drink was so good! His Margarita was pretty good, too. Worth the price. The atmosphere is fun and classy. The service was good. Fun place to drink and watch a game.

name: Joann Rice
text: Food & service were great as always, but WOW! The prices are not the usual for Pappasito's and limited menu.

name: Charity C
text:
We ordered our appetizers and meal at the same time and explained to the waiter that we would like our appetizer to come out first. After waiting about 25 minutes, our entree comes out and we never received our appetizer. My boyfriend speaks to the manager and explains what he asked for and the manager offers to take the plate away, put the appetizer order in and then remake the entree meal when we’re ready for it. By this time we’re hungry and don’t want to wait so he says we’ll keep it and to cancel the appetizer. The manager continues to drag out the situation and upsets my bf who says he’s done talking about it and then manager asks us to leave. So we waited only to not eat anything.

I was very disappointed in how they handled a situation they messed up in the first place. Definitely will not return. When they ask if you know what you would like to order, just tell them the appetizer even if you know the enteee so you don’t have the same problem we did.

name: Bryan Singer
text: A more paired down menu from others in town, but the ambiance, staff, and location more than make up for it.

name: Shawn OBrien
text: Great place, wide open spaces, fresh breeze.

name: Kristin Brown
text: Place is pricey BUT they use actual steak for their fajitas. It makes a huge difference. And the queso was awesome with the beef in it. The hubby and I dont get out much bc of kids and covid, but this place helped us have a date night.

name: Monica Rivera
text: Good Tex Mex restaurant. Portions are huge. The crema on the grilled fish tacos was very salty. The shrimp fajitas were very salty too. Loved their rice and beans. Flour tortillas were very tasty but corn tortillas were not very good. Great non alcoholic drinks (lemon-pear/pineapple-cinnamon were fresh and tasty. A bit overpriced. Service was fast. Staff was friendly. The venue was great. Not too loud, temperature was perfect. Clean WCs.

name: Kennesha Forson
text: What is there not to love? This is one of my favorite places to eat! Being an island girl we normally cook our own food, however, not when I'm near here!!! 😍😍😍

name: Brandy Comeaux
text: Good food and great service. It seems pretty busy when we got here but we are a family of five and was  seated right away. Everyone was friendly and helpful. My husband and I shared chicken and steak fajitas that were really good. I had a zombie Margarita Awesome choice!

name: IntrepidTeach
text: Portions are huge, decor is colorful, and there's plenty of options on the menu. Everything we had was a hit. The calamari is pictured. Our server, Ms. Destinee, was so attentive and kind!  Prices have gone up since we used to visit in Dallas, hence 4 stars.

name: Herakles Li
text: Came here with 6 people and were seated quickly. The server was attentive and helpful despite us having different arrival times and requests. The chips and salsa were good and surprisingly spicy. I had the fajitas and they could easily have fed two people given their proportions. Big fan of the steak, and the fresh guacamole. Overall a satisfying meal with lots of leftovers.

name: Dserious
text: This is the best food I ate!

name: Joseph Merkley
text: Very nice restaurant. The staff was very professional and always attentive. I found the variety of food and on the menu to be a bit limited,  but the food order was flawless. So I give it the benefit of the doubt and say be excellent at a few dishes rather than good at many. Here whatever you order,  it will be delicious. Honorable mention for the chips and salsa dip!

name: Joe Rice
text: Excellent food,  but definitely overpriced.

name: Aretha
text: Great Tex-Mex options. We were ignored for a bit, but the server, Alissa, made it up to us because she was in the kitchen area. She was nice and thoughtful. Walking distance from nearby hotels and the Convention Center. They also validate parking for 2 hours. Park in the Hilton Garage.

name: lluvia grace
text: Billy was great the food was sooo yummmmm and the service was excellent...

name: Hope Williams
text: Great place to grab some chips & salsa and a delicioso margarita!! Walking distance from the Marriott Marquis and the staff were super friendly!!

name: Haas HD4K
text: Their tortilla soup was great. Complementary chips and salsa sealed the deal. A+😎👍🏽

name: Fernando Martinez
text: Was a great atmosphere and great location.

name: Jessica Sanders
text: Very good!  We were going to a Rockets game, and this was the perfect location for dinner - less than one block from the toyota center.  We were seated quickly, served quickly, and the food was very good!

name: Chante Garcia
text: The waiter was very nice and the atmosphere was very friendly. The fact that it's inside the Hilton is an extra bonus!

name: Cowboy Troy
text: Great food and service. Matamoros Platter is half-rack of ribs and half order of fajitas...great combination!

name: Karla Barrett
text: This Cantina it's pretty good. Great environment and the food it's great!

name: Clara Narvaez
text: Came for some drinks after an event. The restaurant was pretty clean and we had great servers.

name: tariq selod
text: Excellent Service and Menu, fast serving good atmosphere.

name: Monica Garcia
text: They've been close since the day Covid started

name: Supriyo Mukherjee
text: Good food and service!  This is one of the better Mexican food chains in this city.  Also, the environment in this particular location is nicer than some of the others.

name: Dennis Garrett
text: Popular Downtown favorite. Excellent Tex-Mex dishes. Strong cocktails. Trendy crowd. Friendly and professional waitstaff.

name: Michael Jackson
text: Great food...and a few drinks.

name: Priscila F
text: The best Mexican restaurant in the downtown Houston, TX.. Delicious food, excellent service and great time.. I recommend this place to everyone👍

name: Tst Mkr
text: Loved Papasito’s Cantina. Steps from Discovery Green with a dog friendly patio was the perfect mix.  We started with some grande house margaritas that were very fresh and lasted (frozen) the whole meal.  The queso and salsa were top notch to get us started then our fabulous mains came out. My companion got their salmon dish which after tasting was some quality and fresh salmon as I’ve ever seen. My fajitas were quite original with ribs, steak, and huge bacon wrapped shrimp. The decor inside was beautiful with high ceilings and a funky chic decor that had a suave element of class. Our service (Emily if O remember correctly) was some of the best I’ve had in Houston and commend her with her excellent promptness and attention to detail. Would recommend!

name: Yolanda Rodriguez
text: Great service. Assorted party plates were delicious. Not first time holding birthday parties at this location. Overall party guests were happy and comfortable.

name: Jisu D
text:
The food and experience is always amazing at the place. The luncheon with Colleagues is always good.

Make sure you are hungry before you visit because the proportions are Texas size and in a good way 😃

name: Rick Garza
text: After having just arrived from out of town, my son and I were looking to get in a pre-game meal and some drinks before heading out to Minute Maid Park. The convenience of having the restaurant located in the hotel in which we were staying at was the determining factor of why we ate there. It was really busy but we were seated almost immediately. Big plus there. Chips & salsa were very tasty. Another big plus there. When our server finally did make her to us, she asked what we would like to drink. I told her that I would like an Estrella Jalisco(a brand of beer). She had no idea what that was, and even said that they didnt carry that brand. We had to show her that it was on the menu. She responded with an,"Oh. The bartenders should know what it is."  She seemed very tired and disinterested in her work. She even admitted that fact to us. And it was because she was working a double shift. I appreciated her honesty on that matter. Food was delicious. Drinks were tasty. Restaurant itself was proficient. My only issue would be our server. I sympathize with her having to work a double shift. But when you end our time there with a somewhat jokingly, "You Astros fans need to get up on out of here already" request, that's not good, double shift or not.

name: Freddie King
text: Food, drinks and service was great nice location as well.

name: Leslie Fuller
text: Some of the best service that I’ve ever had. Lizzy and Mason was absolutely amazing! I loved my overall experience! Thanks for everything. Everybody go visit Lizzy or Mason! ☺️

name: Karl Chapman
text: Sat at the bar.  Was ignored for the first 10 minutes.  Service sucked.  Food was tasty.
