When we got there and explained, the senior manager, Chad Cruz, dismissed us completely and said he never recieved any calls from Apple and that there was nothing he could do. He blew us off completely and said we could go up the street to another Apple store to see if they could help. I asked if he would call to confirm since we'd driven 70 miles to get to this store and Apple had said we could just walk in and pickup the phone we'd already paid for. He said he was too busy and no. He made us feel inconsequential and was very rude. Long story short, beautiful store and awesome layout, and although I'm sure most Apple employees are not like that, this gentleman's behaviour was very demeaning and uncalled for. For a senior manager to ignore and not show any compassion for customers was a shock.  We will never go back to that store again and will make sure that every Apple owning friend/family we have hear about this incident.

name: Ivan Groznii
text: Liked everything in here. Helpful people and plenty of gadgets to sample!

name: Dr ArEn
text:
Such a lousy service.
Went on a Friday evening around 7:50 PM. In spite of more than half of the service technicians roaming in the store with no clients to attend to, I was put on a overflow list (their waiting list for appointment) for a direct warranty swap of a shattered iPhone, and made to wait. Just to prove their arrogance, that you have to make multiple trips if it is anything related to warranty coverage! Don't you hate when these big brands show you who the real boss is?! Experiences like this makes you wonder if there is any true customer care in service industry anymore. I may be a one-off customer who has had this bad experience here... but believe, I am also a customer who should count!

name: Borislav Ganov
text: Happy with the service.

name: William R
text: When everything is up and running like mostly normal, why would they be closed? Oh yea they’re run out of a socialist state. Maybe they’re not aware that normal cities are back open and functional.

name: James Rice
text: Came here due to a bad repair done by Baybrook Mall Apple Store, cracked screen replaced then the screen side camera wouldn’t work. Apple Highland Village looked up and found I should have received a new phone for replacement, was sent back to Apple by accident this caused a 24 your delay. Apple Highland Village Artrise set it up for me to get the new phone at the store near my house so I didn’t have to drive as far. Two thumbs up to these people for their help. Thanks for reading, clicking like is appreciated.

name: Rashunda Endsley
text: The check-in process was quick and easy. The wait time was extremely short, less than 5 minutes. The technician was thorough and explained everything. This part has nothing to do with this amazing store, but parents, don't buy your kids the Beats EP or you will be in the same spot I was.  The plug part is weak and breaks off into your device.

name: LINDA R
text: This was my first time to visit an Apple Store - I own an Android. After checking in at 10:10, our wait time was over an hour. I don't know if this is typical or not (I've never had to wait that long at Booost Mobile). The young lady that served us was very helpful, patient, and knowledgeable.

name: CINDY GUARDADO
text: The people at this apple store were all really nice and helped me with what I needed to do. I gave it a 3 because the wait was extremely long. Once I checked in it took almost 40 min to get my new phone brought to me and I had already ordered and paid for it online.  Much better experience  than the galleria one though

name: Jami S
text: Amazing service and taking social distancing and cleanliness procedures seriously.

name: samiullah safi
text: Good customer service 👍🤙🏻

name: Complete Salvation
text: Based on my experience here they are very reasonable and professional. I came here for Apple care warranty and it was handled quickly. The Galleria Apple store could learn from this one.

name: Katie
text: We received THE BEST customer service from D’Marrea today!  He is exceptionally friendly and went above and beyond to help answer every question and to meet every need as we were purchasing Apple Watch accessories and setting up our watches.  We could not be more pleased with our visit, simply on the basis of D’Marrea’s exceptional customer service.  He is a tremendous asset to this Apple Store, and we will be on the lookout for him the next time we return!  This man should receive a promotion.  He is phenomenal!

name: Charles Sanders
text: The people at the apple store are really nice and cordial. However, the wait can take a couple hours. However, every Apple store location has a long wait. Highly recommend this location, just make sure you make an appointment before  you go in.  Good luck to walk-ins!!!!

name: Asia Green
text: Love it love it. Beautiful store with great customer service

name: Carla Jordan-Martin
text: The store is beautiful. The staff is wonderful, and the service is always amazing!! How Apple manages to service so many of us customers without it FEELING as if we're in there for hours is a mystery.

name: Mark Feferman
text: It's craziness, with a lot of cool products.

name: Sri S
text: Parking is bit a problem near the stores.

name: Bryan Wester
text: Great location with good retail stores and restaurants around it. Beware parking can be a hassle as there are more people then there is parking spots. Be prepared to wait to especially on the weekends. Store stays very busy. But overall a great store with helpful staff.

name: Bob Martin
text: Went in to the store today to purchase a Macbook pro. Had such a bad experience with the person at the MacBook table I left the store and will buy online. The staff needs a lot of training in customer service, empathy, customer care. Likely a management and hiring problem at this location. If you can avoid this location until they change out management.

name: Emma G
text: Not particularly to the employees of the location but to the whole Apple store concept. This is the worst customer service model to take Apple watch for diagnostics and repair or replacement and leave a customer for over a week with no connection. I use it for business and personal communication efficiency. Why else would you buy cellular version of it if you can’t use it without your phone? And there is no loaner or replacement on the spot, or even expedited overnight service. Now I am left without communication device as I have to travel overseas.  Oh yeah I was offered to buy a new one. Seriously?! Is this the only way to keep up the sales for Apple store? Plus, why do you make me wait in line for a technician if they act in a role of shipping agent? Just have someone process if faster if you already know you don’t fix them in store. It doesn’t take a tech to package a watch and ship it out.

name: TANIA RODRIGUEZ
text: The store has a big beautiful space and it’s full of people which could make you think that your wait won’t be too long with all the employees working there. Nevertheless the wait times are usually 1-2 hours minimum just to be seen by someone who can help you with your case. They  told that it was going to be about an hour and that I’d get a text then an hour passed and i had no text yet so i went back to the girl who took my name because i saw she was not busy. I asked her if she could tell me how much longer I’d have to wait and she was really rude and bothered that i had gone back to ask and told me that i hadn’t talked to her and then i reminded her about my case and then she remembered and rudely said you haven’t gotten a text from us so it’s not time yet and said she told me 1hour and 30 min wait time. I had bought the new i phone 11 pro and it came in defective and all they had to do was swap it for a new one. I waited a while longer and they still didn’t text me so i decided to leave.

name: jose guzman
text: Great customer service

name: Jimmy Montenegro
text: Bad customer service

name: Austin Nash
text: Vast majority of the stuff are very helpful and want to help you out as fast as possible. Would be 5 stars, but I interacted with a select few staff members that were less than thrilled about having to do an extra task to help resolve and issue with their system,

name: Eric Vu
text:
I arrived at the Apple store for my appointment.  I was not greeted by a single employee.  I proceeded to walk around the store looking for the genius bar.  There is no sign or help available so it is very confusing.  The store albeit is busy so many employees are helping customers.  However, I see many employees socializing and walking away when I try to approach for help.  I can only assume that they are doing something else that is important and cannot help me. I continue searching for an employee for help and it is frustrating as you can imagine.  Finally, I find an employee who says he can check me in.  Due to all the confusion he says that I am late (now 5-10 min from appointment time) and he has to see if I can even be seen.  I wait for an additional 15 min for him to ask someone if they can see me. Luckily, the second person says of course.I am seated and wait about 15 min for someone to help me.  The iPad was replaced but in an extremely cold and customer-unfriendly way.

I understand the brand image is to be sleek and streamlined.  However, what I experienced was a weak attempt where customers and employees were confused and disgruntled.

name: Nolan Robinson
text: The store is nice and clean. The staff is very friendly and helpful. But the concept is terrible. I had to wait 10 minutes in line to be told it would be 20 minutes before somebody helps me. All to buy a phone I already knew I wanted. Please bring back old fashioned customer service.

name: David Sauceda
text: Fast and quick service

name: CJ Duncan
text: This store does no favors to dissuade the notion of what an Apple store is like. An employee was kind enough to acknowledge us after 10 minutes of standing in front of their display of laptops. It took another 20 of their precious minutes before we left since nobody with any actual knowledge of the laptops bothered to come over to assist. Thanks Apple! Steve Jobs would be incredibly proud.

name: Carlos Martinez
text: I always shop at the Galleria but recently vistes the store. The service is much better here and the waits seemed to be so much smaller. I recommend this location over the Galleria and Baybrook mall.

name: Michael Benissan
text: I've picked up a couple of online orders at this location and always been helped by friendly attendants. The layout is fun and interactive, with all the latest Apple products on display. It's great that visitors to the store get to actually try out the products to get a feel of how they work as well. Parking can get tricky sometimes because of the location. Just something to have in mind.

name: Braeden Quirante
text: May seem daunting with all the people on there, but there are people right at the doors that are eager to help you. I was able to set my appointment, come back and have my laptop speakers fixed without any long wait times during drop off or pick up. Employees seem competent and are efficient in their work.

name: D Green
text:
Apple is nothing without a quality product and great people! Great job here Ken; walking me through my new Apple products while delivering on great customer service!

The ambiance of the store front inside and out also added to a great experience!

Cheers,

name: Hui-Lin Yao
text:
It say open in google map but it is close today
Please update map to avoid wasting people time

name: kathleen vandenbout
text: Do not even answer the phone for a cancellation. 4 hours on ohone yestetday and getting bounced all over again. Its simple. IM.NOT COMING TODAY. Only.way I could.tell.you.   rediculous

name: The Wonderful World of Tangie
text: The employees were very nice and we were helped as soon as we walked into the door

name: Rich Rich
text:
Same as any apple store really. Always best to make an appointment ahead of time, otherwise be prepared to wait your life away. Nothing in that store can keep you preoccupied long enough as a walk in.

However, staff are always knowledgeable and helpful. Biggest downside to this location is the parking. A massive store sells a small lot with other shopping places so if you come at a bad time be prepared to park a little further than you’d like and walk

name: Richard Smith
text: If your going here make an appointment online.  Otherwise you can expect to spend 1 and a half to two hours waiting for service.  The nice thing is they put you in line and text you when it's close to your time to be helped.   So you can go shop, eat, or whatever.  The service folks are very good at handling repairs.

name: Latoya Ellis
text: Service was quick. It is always packed so make an appointment if you can. Parking is available but tight at times.  As usual modern looking store.

name: Divine Priestess
text: I absolutely love this location. This is definitely on my top 3 list of Apple stores in Houston.

name: Andrew Zimmerman
text: Made a 6pm appointment to pick up a product. They closed early and I was unable to pick up my product.

name: Pete Romfh
text: OK, I’m not normally an Apple fan. But they helped me solve a problem with an iPad that someone gave me. The guy at the Genius Bar was very helpful and didn’t laugh at the “bonehead” mistakes I was making.

name: julie woof
text: A bit confusing with the help yourself model... I was told by 1st staff to go look on the wall.... luckily a 2ndstaff person had mercy on me and helped me out.

name: Linda Qualls
text: Very nice Apple store amd helpful employees.

name: Gilberto Cantu
text: Poor customer service.

name: Prabuddha Mohanty
text:
Once you have made the purchase, they forget that you are there and have to hail someone to help you with your set up.

The lady in front of us was treated far worse. The same guy was very apathetic to her inexperience with technology. Wow!
But then again, one can't expect much from Apple.

name: Wes Nemec

name: Eric Yu
text:
Always delay for my appointment，ask me wait for 1.5 hr but actually wait for more than 4 hrs，interesting.
Some stuffs still friendly.

name: Nikki Pham

name: Ian Hill

name: Wilberto Lopez
text: Great place!!!

name: Emery Mitchamore
text: service was faster than I thought it would take.  they have programs to entertain the kids while you are migrating your data from old device to new device

name: Phil Colligan

My last experience was also really positive at this location. I will only go here from now on.

name: Random Fandom Pins

name: Christopher Hernandez

Needless to say I’ll just go somewhere else. Poor store. Poor organization.

name: B B
text: Lovely shop. It’s an Apple store not much else to say! Helpful people, great location.

name: John R C
text: Its fine and what you would expect.  Incredibly busy and you need a genius bar appointment to get anything done for service.  It seems their inventory is tight so you may want to check on line before you go to buy anything.  Parking can be challenging since there is not much of it but a lot of it is very close to the store.

name: jay jani
text: I understand it takes some time to one of the staff member to come as per an appointment. But there is a way to explain that to me. If I am standing there to buy a thousand dollar phone I should be guided well.

name: Danielle Young
text: Helpful, friendly staff. Love the training.

name: Hector Ayala
text: Quick service even though store was packed!

name: siavash ranjbar
text: Good and fast service.

name: Felix Brena
text: Had to make a stop to get a my phone check and they helped me out. Real awesome ppl.

name: Susana Salas
text: It's a good store and provides good customer service. However, this location can get very crowded and full. Parking can be difficult to find depending on what day/time you go to visit

name: Melissa S
text: We’ve had battery replacement done twice at this location. The first time my husband went by himself so I can’t provide a review from that. I can say that they did not have batteries and he had to leave his phone. Also there are not any bilingual employees there so he struggled to communicate. The second time we went together and everything was fine. We arrived a bit earlier than our appointment time and were seen promptly. The battery replacement diagnosis was done fast and we were given about an hour wait for it to be ready. We walked around Highland Village for a bit then went back to Apple so the kids could play on the kid’s tables. The phone was done on time and we were on our way.

name: phillip murphy
text: I loved the fact that soon, as I walked in I felt as tho if I was the most important person in the world. The associate directed me to the rite place very promptly,  to were I had received great customer service. And fairly quick I May And....

name: Zoya Sheikh
text: Great friendly service. Got me in and out as walk in!

name: Dustin Johnson
text: Visited this location with my mother to get some help retrieving her login and password. Apparently she was locked out of iTunes, and there is some sort of algorithm that is as confusing as figuring out why their "wait time" is so mind numbingly long. However, I must express my appreciation for the clean and sleek aesthetic of this particular store.

name: Kevin Rivera
text: Came in with and iPhone pre order appointment got there early. They were quick to help me, and the guy was the best. I think his name was JR. I could be wrong, but overall best visit ever.

name: Clemens Duerrschmid
text: The absolute worst. People just loitering around, customer "service" nonexistent. Now you need to get an appointment to come and wait another 45 minutes to BUY a phone that you already know you wanted. Take my money! Seriously, I can't see apple survive much longer with service as bad as that. Customer service used to be their forte, now it's their weakness.

name: Jaime Castro
text: Upscale tech boutique with all the futuristic optimism of Apple.

name: Matthew Rasch
text: Too many people and not enough worker bees. As much as it provides the typical “Apple” decor and atmosphere, I had a harder time finding those super friendly customer helper agents. There was a long line at the door, keeping the air conditioning wasting away while people seemed impatiently waiting. I’d recommend going to another Apple store with more mignons for faster service.

name: Steve Beeman
text: Good store. Wish there was more parking, but at least it's not the galleria mall.

name: Sam Rotma
text:
You pay top $ for the products, the minimum you will except is service .
I need to stay without a computer for 7 days until They can even have someone to take a look at it.
I needed also a battery replacement for my iPhone the rep told me That i will need to wait at the store for about 4 hr just to place an order for the battery replacement, not to get it replaced, to place the order!!
Same apple that offers you 4 types of music you can listen to when you call, makes you wait at the store 4 hr for something you can do in a click
Not wondering anymore why Appel stores are always full of people .

name: George Ankar
text: Best apple store in Houston. No doubt about it. Always busy though. Best to go very early if you’re in a hurry. Very helpful staff.

name: Jacob Jose
text: Waiting.. waiting.. waiting.. nobody available to help us with product details which we want to know. Last we leaft after 1 hr of waiting. 1 hr wasted.

name: Robert Gavlick
text: The technician Rey Sanchez was helpful but my problem was with the automated recovery system used to change forgotten passwords. I told them i had done the recovery two weeks prior and had never received any response. So they walked me through it again and told me to call apple support if i don't hear anything again. Then i heard one of the employees watching my situation unfold tell another co worker that he has heard of the recovery responding randomly and sometimes not at all. Get it together Apple. If I am standing in an apple store on the phone with apple support someone should be able to change a freaking password.

name: techqin
text: If an Apple Store has what I need and want most of the time they're good in my book.

name: María Laura Mues
text: Ashley did an excellent job helping us choose a computer. She was very friendly and patient.

name: Kirt Martin
text: Considering the amount one pays for an Apple phone one would expect better service. Initially parking is a hassle with signs of all sorts warning of towing for this that or the other. I made an appointment for battery replacement only not to have any batteries when I arrive. The "genius" sits me at the wrong table for a phone diagnostic. The next "genius" does not perform a phone diagnostic but informs me that my phone is part of a batch that received bad batteries and I should be able to get a free replacement unless of course water damage is found. It should not make any difference if the original battery is defective. I talk to the manager and explain a more detailed version of the story above and he proceeds to inform me of the media mistaken portrayal of the malfunctioning batteries. I ask for a diagnostic on my phone he directs to another "genius" who also informs that I get a free battery then asks me if I feel better. I am not aware of Apples definition of genius, as in genius bar, but the bar is pretty low. Maybe they should start out with a competent bar and work up from there.

name: codey church
text: Run from SINGULARITY!! RUN AS FAST AS YOU CAN!

name: Jocelyn Stubenthal
text: Had to wait about an hour and a half for service but they were able to put me on a wait list while I left to go get food, which was helpful.  The girl who assisted me was very knowledgeable and assisted me quickly and efficiently.  Got my battery replaced within 20 min of service. No hassle at all.

name: Frankie Muniz
text:
Impressive location in a pretty busy part of town. Unfortunately the customer service is seriously lacking.

I went in to retrieve an item we purchased online, was met with a polite "hello and how can we help you." But once I was assigned to a rep it was all down hill. Full of condescending attitudes and it just overall felt like my presence was a bother. I never even got his name; he never introduced himself. I wanted to be just in and out. I did have one simple question regarding accessories, but the individual smirked and behaved like the question was so stupid. Their answer was "no, of course not." Came home and found it online ...So there's that.

I'm enjoying Apple and it's products. But I certainly feel like someone should look into this location and how they treat their customers.

name: Anelle Rugebregt
text: Drove all the way to see the store closed on a Saturday. It appears the store is being renovated. They could have updated the status online.

name: taylor rebel
text: So I did have to wait about two hours for my appointment, but that's normal with this location, and they let you go run errands while you wait, sending you text messages as to when your appointment comes up. I had a super helpful employee named Thomas who was very nice and explained things easily. I'm really happy I went.

name: Francisco Mendez
text: Hectic. There’s no intuitive direction for the customer to follow.. just a big room with several tables. I went to return a case and had to interrupt a clerk who was helping some people, as no one was around to answer questions nor were there signs signaling a check out line or anything (the line is awkwardly formed behind a table along a wall).

name: fred trotter
text: Was able to quickly find help.

name: Chris Vaughn
text: Excellent, courteous and knowledgeable support. Be sure to make an appointment first because there's a backlog of people.

name: Ayotola Folami
text: We went to a free digital tree house drawing (on the iPad) taught by the amazing Lady K.

name: Ms Duncan
text: My daughter and I came in and needed help. My daughter was locked out of her phone and we had a guy named Andrew assisting us. He was super helpful and patient. Thanks!!!

name: Reid Hawkins
text: Staff is not very friendly.  They told me that their software update broke my phone. Did not offer to fix my phone or give a discount on a new one. Apple customer service has.gone downhill the past 10 years. Not everyone has 1K to spend on a new phone every year.

name: RONNIE BLACKMON
text: GREAT CUSTOMER SERVICE VERY PROFESSIONAL AND FRIENDLY I HIGHLY RECOMMEND YOU GO THERE FOR ALL YOUR APPLE BUSINESS AND NEEDS

name: Navid Sayyah
text: Long wait but good service

name: Daniel Tobias
text: Fast service and friendly if u go do appointment first sp u. No wait for 1hour or 2 and delete icloud. And do u back up so the process can be more fast

name: Quenton Greggs
text: I believe that this is a great store but at the same time it always depends on the staff. My girlfriend and I where in hunt of a new MacBook Pro and of course why not come here. The reps did the best they could with the questions we where asking but referred us to talk with the Genius Bar. Overall it depends on what time you go.

name: Oleg Kim
text: Be prepared that at the end of the purchase, they will tell you to pick up the purchase in your hands. Very RUDE!!!

name: Chris Hernandez
text: Nothing against the polite greeter at the door, but why schedule you in for a pickup just to put you in the same line as walk in customers who want to buy something. The line was literaly across the whole store. It's funny how Apple is supposedly known for customer service.

name: Faris Raza
text: Worst customer service. Made me wait almost 2 hours to tell me my phone is out of warranty and they will charge $169 to fix minor issue. When i asked the girl if it is out of warranty i don't want to waste my time. Then she goes oh no we will be able to help you. They have nice tactics to rob people. I expected higher standards from apple, but they are turning into thieves and training the employees that way too. It's time to leave apple.

name: Daniel Ngo
text: This is one of the nicest Apple stores I have ever been to. It is an extremely aesthetically pleasing building, with opposite facing glass walls that wrap over and make the roof as well. It is also very large and houses a ton of products to try, so you won't be waiting around too long. The staff is also very friendly. My biggest complaint is that their credit card scanners often won't work if your card does not have a chip, so have a different card ready.

name: Carlos Razo
text:
I give this place 5 stars simply on customer service and tech help.

The parking is always a hassle but it shouldn’t take away from the apple experience provide from Sam Yi.

The guy knows his stuff and how to fix iPhones. I didn’t want to talk to another rep aside from him. I’ve gone to the Memorial and Galleria area locations and none of the reps articulate their apple knowledge words better than him.

If you need the apple tech man, call them and ask for Sam Yi. He got your back, on the reals.

name: nils
text: Simplicity and efficiency at it's best!

name: Chris Jitta
text: Cool place, great products, great service. Every time I've had to go in to purchase something or get my phone/ computer serviced I was always taken care of. Great group of people!

name: Shayan Alkhiro
text: Love this location! All the staff are helpful knowledgeable and nice. Never left without all issues fixed and taken care of.

name: Om A
text:
They told me bring you phone 4 hours before store closing time to replace a battery. 4 hours?!! BS

The guy who called me told me you have a week to come by!! Again BS! In the email they gave me 4 days!!

I am seriously looking to get an android phone. Shame!!

name: Sensei Victor

I will never get another Apple product again.

name: Blake Armstrong
text: Terrible inventory management. Then when paying to get item shipped to me their system crashed and they wanted me to re-enter all info. Get it together.

name: Linda Demaray
text: Very knowledgeable staff! They offer free mini classes. They will spend the time with you to show you how to get results. I will go back as needed.

name: Roy Hight
text: I went to the Apple store and as usual the service was fast, friendly, and knowledgeable. Highly recommend!

name: Niharika Enugula
text: Exclusive Apple store! Must say beautiful place with more variety n high end  branded stores available at highland village do visit.

name: Ariel Nixon
text: My phone is under warranty. They Did not answer phone calls. Did not call to let me know status of the phone. Gives me phone back without fixing the issue at all. Did not give a ticket for pickup.

name: Tammy Stone
text: Good Service after waiting for 1 1/2 hrs to be seen. Don't expect them to Hurry. Service is Slow..

name: Liz Pollard
text: Super nice and friendly staff

name: James Griffiths
text: Fanstastic genius bar support. Apple's strong suit. You pay more up front, get more as you go.

name: Raksha
text:

text:
For one of the world most recognized brands, Apples customer service is in stark juxtaposition for its negative and demeaning approach to business. Despite an appointment at this store in Highland Park we waited 35 minutes before being seen by a technician. My son in law is one of seven people in our family who uses Apple products, and he recently discovered a crack on the home button of his iPhone. This was not caused by impact, contusion or accident; this simply occurred. The technician initially explained that the three month old phone was under warranty and that they would therefore replace the screen. After returning from a conversation with his supervisor however, he announced that because this was caused by an accident that the screen repair would not be covered. After reiterating the same explanation for the crack, he said that Apple would only repair it for a fee of $150. At this point we asked to speak with his manager. Much to our shock and dismay Heather the manager added to insult to already existing injury with icy cordiality which insufficiently disguised her distrusting attitude toward the customer, and inability to think out of the box to reach a satisfactory conclusion for the customer and made insulting comments that added to the disdain that we the customer already felt. We left the store having been given no option for a solution apart from paying for the repair of a clearly defective Apple device.

Within an hour we called Apple care who immediately offered a free of charge replacement screen, apologizing for the rude treatment we received at the Highland Park store. this absurd drama was unnecessary and dispicable. The highland Park geniuses and managers need a hefty dose of etiquette, people skills and customer service - Shameful!

This is the best Dairy Queen I've ever eaten at.  The staff is always very friendly.  The service is great.  The food is perfectly prepared.  Other Dairy Queens should study this one to up their game.

The best item on the menu:  the Flame Kickin'  Hunger Buster combo, with tater tots.

name: Q Man
text: I only go to Dairy Queen for ice cream. For myself it’s always the banana split. This location is the only location that doesn’t make the banana split as advertised, with 3 tall towers of ice cream. They’re always flat and I consistently ask them to add more. They tell me that its measured but I don’t believe them. I’ve been to many locations around the world and in the USA and this is the only place that doesn’t do it right. It’s a bloody shame.

Worst of all I called customer service 2 days after my daughters birthday and they told me the manager should contact me soon. It's been 3 weeks and nothing. Not even an apology. Don't order a cake. I wish I could have gone to Kroger. At least  it would have looked pretty. We won't be doing business with this location anymore.

When we got our chicken and steakfinger baskets the fries were cold they missed 2 steak fingers on a 6 piece , the toast was stale, and the steak fingers were not fresh and hot-they were cold. It's like the workers here were on auto pilot, not taking pride in the work they do, I didn't see a manager on shift to ensure the customers were satisfied. We had been here 3 weeks ago at night and the burgers were cold, bread stale, tacos cold. I think the problem is with this location is there is no management on night shift to ensure the team has integrity (Doing things right even when no one is watching), and to ensure the customers are taken care of and satisfied at the least so they can become regulars and tell their friends of the positive experience. However this paragraph im writing says how negative the experience is. I cannot recommend coming to this location till a superintendent puts a thumb on the management to turn this location around as it is going downhill rapidly.

name: Gregston Chu
text:
upscale ice cream with bold delicious flavors. the ice cream is rich and creamy. the flavors are bold and striking. it’s a little spendy. little to no parking. there are some tables and chairs outside to eat.

during the pandemic they have a modified ordering process; line up outside, one party at a time orders inside the front door, then picks up order inside the side door. the line moves quickly.

name: B Keo
text: Always a line. Worth the wait. Awesome ice cream and awesome people!!

name: Neda Esmaeili
text: Love the darkest chocolate flavor, if you’re a true dark chocolate lover, it’s amazing! It’s the right amount of sweetness and bitterness. The wildberry lavender also was great, it tastes like a spa but in a good way. My husband got the brambleberry crisp and salted peanut butter with chocolate flecks (tastes similar to butterfingers), which was also very tasty. Essentially this place is worth the wait in line!

name: Spencer Phillips
text: The ice cream was so good. Rich n creamy like old school. I tried the pineapple upside cake. My peeps had the milky chocolate and coffee flavors. We all agreed Jeni you make wonderful ice cream!! Worth standing in line for.

text: Pleasant friday evening to enjoy ice cream. Line about 12people at least. $5 for a pretty decent sized 2 scoops.

text: This ice cream is absolutely fantastic. They have several non dairy options and the sugar cones are Vegan. 👌❤️Texas sheet cake is my favorite.

name: Alex R
text: Despite the name, Jeni's Splendid Ice Creams offers perfectly average ice cream. I find nothing about their ice cream over-the-top outstanding.  I normally get a milkshake at an ice cream shop. Jeni chooses to not offer something as basic as milkshakes. Combine the lack of milkshakes with merely average ice cream and you get the two stars I rate the place.

text: Love their ice creams. Have tried all flavors

Always great ice cream! They now have a different set up to ensure social distancing. You go in the front door to order, the pickup at the side door.

Love it!

text: Real great and friendly service,  the ice cream is buttery 🧈 and delicious,  different flavors to try and new/seasonal flavors all the time

name: Catsur na
text:
Pros: Creative flavors, great service
Cons: basically no parking, no outdoor seating (to go orders will probably have to be eaten in your car), hard to eat until it melts, very weak flavors.

I applaud them for trying something different (with regards to ice cream chemistry), however I don't feel it works. It's too dense to enjoy before it melts. Even stabbing it with a spoon barely makes a dent in it until it melts! My bigger problem is the lack of flavor; I tried several of the flavors and I could barely taste any of them. If I can't taste it, what's the point in all the exotic flavors???

My advice, if you want unusual and creative ice cream flavors, go to Fat Cat Creamery. Even though they're a bit overpriced IMO, at least you can definitively taste the flavors.

name: Ada
text: Well crafted and worth the money! I ordered a single Dark Chocolate Truffle :’) Perfect for people like me who are health conscious. It’s DF,GF, and V. Loved it!

name: Courtney King
text: I've been going to this ice cream parlor since they opened up anytime I'm craving something sweet. The staff is really nice and I LOVE their waffle cones/bowls. My favorite ice cream flavors are coffee with cream and sugar, roasted peanut butter, gooey butter cake, and salty caramel. I highly recommend this place.

name: Lucy Santos
text: On a warm and sunny day you can scream  for ice cream.  As as a matter of fact,  you can have more than ice cream.  You can sit outside and enjoy the view. Try it!

name: Elaine Flores
text: I'm saying it. Best Ice Cream in Houston and I don't say that lightly. We had coffee, bumbleberry and Banana Daiquiri in their waffle bowl. We also got a pupcup for my dog who enjoyed it thoroughly. They are also very covid safe (2/28/21) no indoor seating but they do have outdoor seating. Can't wait to come again!

name: Krishna Babu Yerubandi
text: Coming from India, I always miss Butter Scotch flavor of the ice cream. 'Brown Butter Almond Brittle' does come very close to it in flavor and texture and of course order of magnitude better in all the other ways. Jeni's during the COVID19 pandamic are doing everything to keep employees and customers safe. It has been my go to place I'm the recent past.

name: Sean W
text: Great ice cream with super flavors.  Did COVID restrictions well.   Good experience!

name: Nate Church
text: I LOVED this place. As an ice cream connoisseur, I thoroughly enjoyed the many delicious flavors that Jeni’s has to offer. They are well-crafted, unique, and absolutely delectable. It’s also a cute atmosphere and great for a date night or fun night out with friends! If you like ice cream at all you will be glad that you tried out Jeni’s. Line was quick, service was great, place was clean, I would recommend.

name: Anyanwu Onwa
text: Get to Jeni's asap! I would have taken a picture of my cone (blackout chocolate cake - a real chocolate lover's chocolate, not for the faint of heart!!) but I ate it too quickly.  The aroma of fresh waffle cones will meet you before you open the doors. Try a couple of samples before you pick your favorite. Cozy seating area, friendly gentleman behind the counter.

name: Stacy Williams
text: Goat cheese & berries or the brambleberry crisp are the most amazing ice creams!

name: Hannah White
text: As soon as you open the door, you’re greeted by the incredible smell of their waffle cones. Next, it’s the incredibly friendly staff. I’m assuming they’re all so kind and helpful because they work in an ice cream shop that smells like heaven! Anybody would be happy in that environment! And to make it all perfect, their ice cream is DELICIOUS!!! Jeni’s is the perfect addition to the neighborhood! Our family will be back very soon!

name: Stephen Forrester
text: Delicious, housemade ice cream with a lot of unique flavors. Staff is super friendly, and they're really great with following the COVID-19 restrictions in place, limiting how many people can be inside at once. On a beautiful day, it's nice to take your ice cream to the little sidewalk seating area on the side of the building.

name: Michael Fulmer
text: I've had Jeni's ice cream before, but first time at the Heights location. Excellent safety protocols; 1 person (or group of 4) at a time ordering with a separate entrance for pick up.  Of course the quality & creative selections are top notch.

name: Benjamin Tan
text: Great ice cream flavors. Has cute ambiance outside

name: Nubia
text: Very delicious ice cream. It was a girls day & we gave this spot a try & it was delicious 👌🏼. Definitely worth giving it a try.

name: Juan Prado
text: The ice cream here is incredible. A must try!

name: Madison Juarez
text:
The smell of fresh waffle cones will immediately hit you when you walk inside! Cute lounging areas to the left and right when walking through to the register/line.
Staff didn't seem to care anymore, all had faces of "I dont want to be here."
Flavors are pretty delicious and SO MANY to choose from!!! Love the boozy flavors!

name: Prem Patel
text:
The first time I had Jenis was last year when I took a trip to North Carolina, when I heard there was one opening up in Houston I was very excited!

The owner herself came to the grand opening of the shop, had a pleasure of meeting her. She is very friendly and down to earth.

The staff here is amazing, they are very friendly and have great recommendations. The ice cream is a bit on the costly side but the quality of the ice cream is amazing. If you are a ice cream lover and want a good scoop(s) jenis is definitely one of the best spots in Houston!

name: Diem
text: The ice cream is delicious.  There are some very unique flavors.  The line is always long so plan ahead.  Parking is a challenge as well.

name: M L
text: Came in on Saturday afternoon and there was 30 minute wait. Tried 5 different flavors and they were all spot on. The waffle scones had a great flavor too. I also liked how they don’t use plastic spoons for samples. Overall the hype is justified.

name: Shazia Khan
text:
One of the best ice cream spots in Houston!
I loved how the flavors were so creative and different from other ice cream places.
I tried A LOT of flavors and none of them disappointed!
I ended up picking the Brown Butter Almond Brittle and Coffee with Cream and Sugar in a Waffle Cone.
The Brown Butter Almond Brittle was SO GOOD, I’ve never tasted anything like it!
The Coffee with Cream and Sugar has a really nice espresso taste without being too sweet.
They also offer Cinnamon Waffle Cones which I will definitely have to try!

name: Diana Smith
text:
During Covid it has been a goal to try a new ice cream spot once a week. Jeni’s is the best. The goat cheese cherry is out of this world and the brambleberry crisp is outstanding. If you’re looking for the best ice cream in the city - Jeni’s should be top of the list!

Update! 4/8/21 - the Dolly inspired Strawberry Pretzel Pie is dee licious!!

name: Heath LaCoss
text: Great, unique flavors, nice atmosphere, and doing great with social distancing protocols!

name: Steve
text: Fantastic ice cream! The Salted Peanut Butter with chocolate flecks is my favorite, the Gooey Butter Cake is a close second. We'll definitely be back.

name: Michael St. Pierre
text: Today after having dinner at Neo Baguette we stopped for ice cream for the first time at Jenis. We had sample spoons of the various ice creams that we wanted to try. Excellent old style ice cream parlor feel. We all had one and two scoops in either the bowl or the waffle cone bowl. The flavors were excellent and after reading about their ice creams on their napkins, they really do make their creams to melt slowly and with a fragrance of the ice cream coming through. Well worth the stop as there were many coming in after their dinners!

name: Rohan Solomon
text: Front desk service was strange, we were waiting to pay and she was staring at her phone. Ice cream was SO salty and $8 for one cone is an outrageous price

name: Christen Phillips
text: The way they handled covid delivery of the ice cream was perfect. The flavors were really hard to choose from. Ended up with 2 scoops and way too much ice cream but I can't wait to come back and try more!

name: Morgan Ruth
text: So good!! I had a scoop of brambleberry crisp and a scope of brownbutter almond brittle in a fresh waffle cone. They have developed an effective, safe ordering process. There were a few tables outside in the shade, but it was very busy and no one was sanitizing them between uses.

name: Annie Rupani
text: I've been a major fan of Jeni's from the first time I tasted her ice cream at the Fancy Food Show seven years ago. Even thought they're not handwriting all their labels anymore, the quality of ice cream has only gotten better, and I'm so excited to have a location in Houston. Not only do they have wonderfully creative flavors, they hold true to their artisanal roots with high-quality ingredients as well as gluten free and dairy free options!

name: Life Of Ancel
text: This Place Is The Best Ice Cream In Houston.

name: diem chi nguyen
text: Flavors are good but it's pretty sweet. Also i don't know if we got a bad batch or it's just how it is but the waffle cone was SALTY...like really salty, not just a hint of saltiness. I LOVE waffle cone and always finish it. But this time I couldn't.  Hopefully it was just a bad batch!!!

name: john huang
text: Yeah this place gas great ice cream.

name: Liz
text: I love that she uses grass-fed milk. I don’t think all the flavors are out of this world, but the ones that are good, are incredible. My personal favorites are salted peanut butter, gooey butter cake and skillet cinnamon roll.

name: Ari Ari
text: I LOVE it here! I Literally don’t buy ice cream from a grocery store anymore, I go here because it’s so delicious! And staff is amazing and kind! The best unique ice cream shop in the perfect spot!

name: Cash Cashty
text: The purchaser carrier and group of workers have been very first-class as is customized for this place. Coming from Ohio, evaluating the Jeni's there , the one right here in Houston leaves some thing to be desired. Lacks in richness and taste.

name: Colby Clifford

I asked her the most popular flavors and I picked 3. Salted Peanut Butter (think Reese's flavor) Dark Chocolate Truffle and Cold Brew. All were tasty! Personally I don't think there is any flavor there that is undesirable lol everything looks yummy. There are plenty of tables and spots to sit and enjoy your icecream. Lots of cool wall photos that'll make real cool pictures. Be warned it is a bit pricey one scoop will cost you a little over 5 dollars. But the ice cream is delicious!! They do have dairy free options as well. Worth checking out. No parking lot so I had to park a few blocks away and walk. Totally worth it!

text: We went during COVID, and were shocked with the service received. There were 5 in our family, no other customers in the store, and as my wife placed her order, she decided she wanted a different flavor. The cashier told her it was too late, she couldn’t change because the order was already sent through- we had NOT even paid yet. She ask the cashier again in disbelief, “I can’t change it?”- mind you, the cashier stands only 4-ft from the serving line! She could literally have just told the server to not put the vanilla, but go with the other flavor. Not wanting to cause a scene, we moved on and took the less preferred flavor. At the end, one of the ice creams was served in a bowl when we ordered in a cone. When we explained this, they seriously just handed us a cone. UTTER DISBELIEF! As we tried to spoon the ice cream into the cone ourselves, they then tell us “you can’t eat the ice cream here”. We explained we were trying to spoon the ice cream into the cone since they didn’t do it for us. THERE IS NO ICE CREAM WORTH THAT KIND OF HUMILIATION AND OFFENSIVE CUSTOMER TREATMENT. And there really isn’t anything special about their ice cream- it’s more like gelato, which is super yummy of course, but plenty PLENTY of other places you can get it.

name: Ann S.
text:
Let me start with I am super disappointed that my second photo did not load included the waffle bowl in perfect sunlight.  Spotty internet connection. I will have to try to recreate.

First visit included Bramble berry, Cognac Gingerbread (yes, it is as tasty as it sounds), and Brown Butter Almond Toffee.

Second visit was Eggnog, and White Chocolate Peppermint in a waffle bowl.

When you walk in the intoxicating smell of sweet batter and butter being turned into a waffle cone/bowl draws you in on a cloud of salivary heaven.    If you take a moment you can sort out the smell of cream and sugar being turned into a wonderful array of delightful and taste-bud enchanting flavors.
You get to try these flavors on a real spoon; super tiny, but real so it doesn't mask the flavors with the taste of plastic.

Each flavor that was tried had the taste of real ingredients, not flavors concocted in a lab to simulate what someone thought was the taste of that product.  There are real berries in the berry ice cream, real almond in the almond ice cream, etc.

The Ice Cream has an incredible full cream mouthfeel to it meaning that it is smooth, robust, and rich.  Out of all the small batch, "local," all natural, and housemade ice cream I have tried in the greater Houston area this one is the most satisfying and truthful with its claims.

The one slight downfall was the bowl, I enjoyed the Waffle in a small piece seen in the picture, when it came to the full bowl, it had WAAAAAAY too much butter in it.  If you knew me you know there is never too much butter, until now.  It was also a touch over cooked, had the taste of almost burnt, maybe that was scalded butter.  Someone needs to be assigned to keeping the cafe area tidy.

The servers are friendly and helpful. You just need to overcome the euphoria of waffles and creamed milk and sugar to hear their suggestions.

So I will shop, pay at self check out, show my paid receipt and leave. But this time I was asked to move to other cashier because I had more then 15 items in my cart or move my stuff to two carts and good luck pushing them out my self.

name: Marissa Briones
text: Good variety of items that I almost always find what I need. They offer good prices, and occasionally put items on clearance so you get unbelievably great deals. They have very recently updated this location to include walk-in coolers for produce and other things. Very cool (pun intended)! As of this review (July 2019), more than half of the registers are now self-checkout registers with smart & fast-responding scanners! There are still several registers with cashiers, so no worries. And during those times when lines are really long, I just use the Scan & Go app, which is super convenient and easy to use. They also have a new system for receipt-checking at the door, so it’s faster getting out. When I had to return something, I found that the Customer Service people have been easy to deal with; I never had any issues at all. Most of all, being a business member, I love the Sam's Club's cash rewards system.

text: Best time to shop is in the evening when everyone is at high one having dinner. I like shopping at Sam's warehouse for meats like beef and pork. If you use the Sam's app while you're shopping you can keep track of your budget. All you do is scan the bar code using the phone's camera and a running total is created as if you're checking out at the register.  When you have completed your shopping you can easily check out by using the app. No need to get in a line and wait. Once you check out using g the Sam's app take your phone and shopping cart along with your merchandise to the exit door and the attendant will check against your purchase with a scanner and off you go. Way to go Sam's!

I am extremely disappointed with the entirety of this purchase because I spent the full $149 + tax for this product, and things were missing. text:
I agree with Laura Chi. See previous review.

1. They have a good facility with a wide variety of food products from Asian markets, however, there is a downside. See #2.

2. The people here are AWFUL! Unless you speak an Asian language, be prepared to be looked at like an inferior being. Almost to the point of being discriminated against because you're not Asian. It could well be a language barrier issue, however, it's safe to say that some English is to be known. I mean how do you even read traffic signs or applications, etc.? For example, in the food court area, when I asked for broccoli, I had to literally point to it because she did not understand me. They just don't like you, particularly if you're coming in for a large order. It could also be that Asian people treat each other in a rude way and I don't understand their culture. Regardless, being rude isn't appropriate for the people who pay your salary.

3. Again on the people they hire... I came and spent $15 (which isn't a lot) that I could've spent somewhere else where they at least say "Thank You" back (because I always thank someone who serves me in any capacity).

4. Would I come back? Yes. Except next time if I'm met with the same hostility, I will respond with hostility. Also, I'm submitting a BBB complaint against this establishment.

resp.text:
Hi Christopher, thank you for your review. Feedback is always important to us and can help us improve.

As you are aware, many of our employees speak a language that is not primarily English. Being an Asian American supermarket, it can be difficult sometimes to communicate but I ensure you our staff is not trying to be rude. Language barriers are always difficult and we have encouraged our staff to continue to learn and grow as much as they can. Learning a language can be difficult and when our staff is new or training or just a little on the older side, they may not know the terms you are referring to just yet, so I hope you can help us help you! We hope that our selection of products is to your liking and we will continue to work harder to improve.

We are not a chain store and we are learning as we go so we hope you'll continue to support us!

--Welfresh market

name: Shier Lee
text:
(Translated by Google) After staying in the United States for 40 years, I finally found authentic Taiwanese beef noodles in the dining area of ​​this supermarket!
The color is smooth and shiny, the beef is Q bomb, the noodles are strong, the soup is full of flavor, and then a small plate of braised pork ears and drunk chicken feet are added.After eating, the mouth is fragrant and the aftertaste is lingering.
Uncle Lee is highly recommended by Master Lee, it is worth eating again! ! !
Don't forget to add his spicy oil, it's a must!

(Original)
留美四十年,終於在這家超市內的餐飲區吃到正宗台式牛肉麵！
色澤潤亮,牛肉Q彈,麵條勁道,湯頭味足,再來上一小碟滷味豬耳加醉雞爪,吃完口齒留香,餘味繞舌.
Uncle Lee李師傅強力推薦,值得一吃再吃！！！
別忘了加上他家的辣油,一絕！

name: Caleb Alexander
text: The policy where everyone has to be there for a reservation is a joke. They refused to seat us until everyone was here even with 1 person running late. Management should review this. It’s a ridiculous policy especially when you have people meeting up for a business dinner.

resp.text: Hello Caleb, I understand your frustration with our Hibachi seating policy. However, it is a necessary policy as we have a limited number of chefs and we need everyone seated in order to begin your  experience to accommodate everyone at a community dinning table. If your guest arrives late, and the chef has already begun cooking, he will not be able to restart the process of cooking and will not be coming back to the table as we have other tables waiting to be cooked. This is also an important rule when there are separate parties seated at one hibachi table. By requiring everyone to be present to be in order to be seated, prevents other previously seated guests from waiting on someone else's party member if they are not present. I apologize for your wait and hope that in the future this clears up any frustration you might have when dinning with us. Perhaps our dinning area would be more conducive to your needs for business meeting, as we do not require everyone present in order to be seated.

name: La Shaundrea Harris
text:
Called in an order for pickup here. Stated very clearly what I wanted. When I got to the restaurant to pick up my order, one of the items was incorrect. I let the hostess know this and she, very rudely, stated that she took the order herself and she ordered what I told her. I very patiently let her know, once again that she got it wrong and asked her to correct the order. She refused to correct the order and had the audacity to tell me that I was still going to be charged for the wrong item...her mistake...and that I could then pay for the new item! I ended up having to speak with the manager, Laura, just to get everything straightened out.
Although Laura did go ahead and correct my order without charge, when I spoke with her about the rudeness of her hostess, she defended the horrible customer service telling me how they "train" their people to take orders and repeat them. Well, they need to train them a little better...and Laura might want to take some of that training herself!

name: Mark Garlitos
text: Welcome to Joke i O grill.... over priced, mid-tier dining that passes for Japanese cuisine.  As much as Ii vilify such a wantonly mediocre establishment, it would be remiss to overlook this place as a reflection of this community's expectations of what is acceptable dining.  If ignorance is bliss why is everybody so unhappy with this place?  It would have been a miracle if this place was even remotely adequate.  The only humor I find here is the irony of Asian proprietors and management ordering around entitled, under-educated white girls who play act at working.  I could really lay into this place but it would be a bigger oblique stab at a town that's ill apt to listen.  If we really wanted a better Japanese place, we would attract a better type of American family into this one horse town.  Maybe then we could all taste the difference.

text:
The staff at this location makes it five star. Having stayed for 27 days on business it has been entirely issue free. Fresh coffee in the lobby at 5:00a.m.
A good hot and cold breakfast buffet including gluten free items available by asking the attendant. Clean, large rooms with full size refrigerator, electric stove top, dishwasher and microwave. (No oven) All utensils, dishware and cookware to make a meal. Small dishsoap included along with dishcloth and dishtowels.Large desktop work area with outlets for plugging in our much needed devices. Full mirrored closet doors. Iron and ironing board inside the closet. Like being in an apartment except with your own housekeeper, maintenance and concierge. A nice location with ample well lit parking. Not just for extended stays but, weekend getaways, and guests that become extended family while here. A great stay!

resp.text: Thank you so much for your recent stay and 5 star review of your experience at the Residence Inn Houston Sugar Land! We really appreciate guest feedback and you mentioned all the aspects that we focus on for a great stay. It's all due to a great staff, that provide such well-maintained guest rooms and common areas, along with excellent guest service. We strive to have every guest leave as satisfied as you did. text: I ordered lunch from here because of the rave reviews...I will not be going back. The rice wasn't fresh and the sauce was supposed to be spicy on the chicken and spicy garlic sauce, but it was just a bunch of sauce and veggies. The egg drop soup was good, but not enough to make me go back. I'll stick to the restaurants I know for my Chinese food fix.

name: Hill Branda
text: A great place for  good quality, reasonably priced take-out. I ordered sesame chicken and wonton soup. The portions were very large, and the food was very tasty. The people who run the place are polite and friendly.  Would definitely recommend.

name: Nancy Ghisalbert
text: My husband and I heard this was a great place to eat. I ordered take out and when I walked into the Restaurant it smelled amazing. I was greeted right away and everyone was friendly and polite. My order was ready when I got there and I couldn’t be happier with my meal. Ordered fried dumplings, spring rolls, generals chicken, beef with broccoli, and house fried rice. Everything was delicious. Will be going back.

name: Kelsey Martin
text: The food was quite good and was above average for the area and it's nearby competition. The orange chicken was tasty and the crab puffs are too die for. You could make a meal out of just those. Though the downside of this place was that it's just too hot inside it doesn't feel like the air conditioning is even running. Otherwise I'd give this place 5 stars as soon as they fix this issue. The staff is extremely helpful and so their best to make sure you have a pleasant experience. Would eat here again.

name: Douglas Lopez
text: Excelent service good food Wow good taste I eaten Chicken with eggplant that dish really nice and Hot and suor soup both recomended .

name: Candy J
text: Ordered general tso chicken and cheese puffs. The cheese puffs were pretty good. The general tso chicken was probably the worst I've ever had. The chicken was hard, small and mostly breading. When I finally had a piece that was chicken it was dark brown meat. Won't likely return.

name: Nik Murphy
text: This place is incredible. It's become a regular haunt for my girlfriend and I. The menu is exciting, varied, and well put together. The food quality and the service are top notch. More places should aspire to this degree of excellency. Love it.

name: Neil Tecson
text: Very good tasting food. The person we spoke to said they were trying to make it more authentic instead of the "usual" Chinese restaurants. We had sliced pork and it was delicious. we also had the General Tso and shrimp lo mein dishes. It seems those were even better than most places. The bamboo shoots that were added in the food was a nice touch. Actual restaurant on the small side. Maybe room for about 40 guests, which makes it cozy. Great staff as well. Absolutely recommended.

Surprisingly good.  Friendly staff with a clean  environment to boot.

Dishes like the sichuan crispy chicken is exactly what you would find off of Bellaire. Kids had general tso chicken and that did not disappoint either.

Great chinese restaurant place out in Missouri city to save us the trip into town.

text: WOOOOOW!!! This place is crazy tasty! If you love spicy food and beef you have to try their Spicy and Crispy Beef. Seafood lovers...their SaltPepper Shrimp is on point! And for you veggie lovers, make sure you get the sautéed garlic baby bok choy! Everything was perfect! The manager, Nathan, is very kind and attentive. Jenny, is the owner and she’s the sweetest thing ever. She’ll come by and make sure everything is okay, refill your drink, and just have a good ol conversation with you :) these folks are great, customer service is excellent, and food...well...IT’S AMAZING! 👍🏽 Stop reading and go eat at Bamboo Spice!

name: Shawn Petricko
text:
The people are very nice and the place is clean. It was my first time there so I got the American Staples (general tsos for the wife, sns chicken for the kiddo and beef lo mein for me along with wonton soup and egg rolls). The soup was good, nice broth but the wonton filling was a bit heavy on the pickled ginger (at least I think that's what I was tasting). The egg rolls were great, perfect in every way. The sns chicken was great. Good batter, nice crunch that held up to being transported. The sauce was standard.  My wife really liked the general tsos. It was very rich and flavorful. The lo mein was good. Very mild in flavor. It could use a bit more meat for the price though.
All in all I will be back. They do have some more traditional Chinese food in the menu so I will go that route next time.

name: Adam Hernandez
text:
This place is unassuming. It’s not as big as the other two Hilton’s in town. But what this place lacks in size it makes up for in stellar customer service.  First the owners are awesome and want to make deals with you if you’re in town on business or extending your stay. The front desk ladies, especially Victoria and Regina are always so friendly remembering me and ensuring I am good to go. The sales manager/ day time office Cassidy went over and beyond from day one. Ensuring my snack and water as a diamond member I always had. She approached my with long term discounts and made it easy to want to stay with these people as long as I’m here.

I can keep going but I’ll just say that currently won’t stay anywhere else, even the nicer bigger ones didn’t treat me so well.

name: Jeremy Schuster
text: Great Hampton inn and I stay at many of them it's my go to hotel chain. Staff were very friendly and helpful and the room was very nice and clean. Close to Starbucks and food.

name: Maj Bordovsky
text: Nice and clean. I waited to check in, when I did get checked in the lady seemed snippy when I said I hadn't been waiting long and was looking around (I meant at the decorations) and she quickly said "And... what did you see?" I just replied it looks nice. When my husband and I checked out the different lady at check in was talking to a friend as we waited for their conversation to finish we were greeted and checked out. The customer service is what caused it not to be a 5 star experience.

name: Amy Speers Thamm
text: Very lovely ladies at the front desk very warm and inviting. I deliver here sometimes multiple times a day for doordash. They will call to the room if need be and if that's what my instructions are from a guest they have staying that may have ordered food delivered to them without giving me any problems at all. It's nice to be able to go in somewhere and to be greeted instantly in a friendly manner.

name: Thomas Tucker
text:
I’m sure you could have found a better hotel in Victoria, but if you have $108.17 then this might not be a bad plan. I will say this wasn’t my favorite hotel chain but I’ve been trying to give them a go. Pros: the beds are soft and pillows are big and great selection. Comforters are big and fluffy. Couch was comfy and almost ally the lights worked. But that’s about were the buck stops.
This hotel needs a maintenance man bad. Lots of little things that were just never really taken care of. My first room last night the ac didn’t work and the fridge was froze up so I couldn’t keep my drinks cold. The second room wasn’t much better but I can live with those things if ac works. Lots of stain in both rooms, faucets not repaired lots of rust and corrosion build up. Hair in the drains, broken things here and there.

Since Covid happened the pool is green and no breakfast, only  a baggy of an apple and granola bar and a water bottle for the price of $89 a night it’s not bad but save a little more and stay across the street if you want well kept rooms.

I know I’m being hard, but I don’t want you to go in with high expectations and be let down. I would like to be honest and truthful to my experience on 2 rooms in one night. Maranatha

text: I am only giving 4 stars because of the box lunch program. I am tired of it and I want my hot breakfast back.  The room was clean and conveniently located for my needs. Staff was friendly.

Lobby is spacious. Good place to mingle or get a good read because windows are big and there is lots of illumination.

text: We stayed here for a wedding on a Saturday night and loved the place.  The beds were soft and the staff were very helpful.  One of our boys got caught in the elevator and went up by himself.  He was crying and screaming but a maid on the second floor and a service guy found him and were they to comfort him.  We were very thankful.  The morning breakfast is very good.  Try the waffle maker!  The only bad thing about it is, it's a little tricky to get in and out of the parking lot because the driveway is very close to an intersection.

text: Stayed here for one night on recent business trip, and I was completely satisfied with facilities and accommodations here, as well as the courteous and welcoming staff.  Clean and comfortable rooms (great pillows, btw!); quiet; nice small workout room with free weights and several cardio machines; plenty of restaurants within a mile north or south (and mall just to north); fresh-baked cookies at front desk upon arrival; really good free breakfast offerings (including several hot egg/meat choices); and reasonable rate.

It is also near Chipotle, Red Lobster, Olive Garden, Starbucks and a good sized gas station that offers home made baked goods. Check in and check out were simple, and the staff were very friendly. Free hot breakfast available each morning and coffee/hot tea or hot chocolate available 24/7. I would stay here again.

So we were stuck trying to find a different place to stay at the last minute, due to the owner's negligence. I don't recommend dealing with this place at ALL. Avoid at all costs. name: David Murphy
text:
The Sheraton hotel in Georgetown is an excellent place to stay. The hotel is among the cleanest I’ve stayed in, with a very polite and courteous staff. The layout of the property is beautiful along with the views from the upper floors. There is excellent restaurants within a minute of walking so there’s no need to drive when you go to dinner. BB’s country cooking is the closest for meals.
The only drawback for this place is the parking garage having a low clearance inside it, if you drive a lifted vehicle or have a trailer behind your vehicle you might consider alternative parking areas.

I said again it was upstairs and she said she didn't care I had to have a mask. I was the only person in the lobby. Check the cameras. BAD BAD Experience and will NEVER RETURN. Next pillows were weird and super flat and floppy. Finally my last issue is our shower had no shower curtain. I do have to say that I did accidentally book an ada room and did not know until walking in to the room. I have been put in ada rooms at other hotels when they were booked up. The difference between this hotel and other hotels is that the ada shower at the sheraton had no shower curtain. Water got everywhere and it was a mess. The positive things about the hotel is that the staff is super friendly and helpful (front desk and waitstaff at restaurant). The food was very delicous at the restaurant.  It is a beautiful and clean hotel.

text: The hotel itself had many amenities as well as a nice gym with modern equipment. The rooms themselves have above average decor but that is also where they lack because within the rooms, there wasn't a microwave or mini fridge. I was pretty upset about that. If you wanted one, it had to be requested. I do like that the water within is obviously ran thru a water softener. As one other review stated, I've stayed in hotels that cost a lot less that offer more. I'm also upset about there not being a complimentary breakfast. The desk staff suggested a restaurant within which prices were California like. I will not be returning to this hotel knowing I can get more for my funds elsewhere.

resp.text: Thank you Sidney, we apologize for not having fridges and microwaves in the rooms.

text: Nice hotel.  I love the pillows!!!  I didn't even have to bring my own this time but did just in case.  I wish the pool was indoors but it says it is heated.  I'll have to check it out tomorrow.   I like the workout exercise room.  The restaurant is ok but don't get the onion soup it was cold with hard cheese the flavor was very peculiar. The crab cakes were great though.  The burger was really good also but very over priced.  The wait staff was very nice and accommodating!

name: Scott Vantine
text:
So, the hotel is very nice, comfortable, staff is great. But we’ve stayed here twice in our lives, and both times at precisely 3:30 am on Sunday morning the fire alarm went off repeatedly, and we had to evacuate. No apology or compensation was offered by the hotel....at all. In fact while I was standing in the courtyard at 4:00 am, my bill was delivered promptly by email (coincidence?) Spoke with another guest that said he was 3 for 3. Obviously this is an ongoing problem that hotel is failing to address. Not only is this obviously inconvenient, but very unsafe. Repeated false alarms can create a sense of complacency, not to mention the physical stress it puts on elderly guests having to negotiate the fire escapes. It’s very irritating that the hotel booked us into an unsafe environment and charged us, knowing this is an ongoing and unresolved problem. FYI, room service was prompt and tasty, but child size portions for $$$ and phone/pass key never works.
**** UPDATED REVIEW***
I was contacted by the hotel staff and my concerns were addressed. They also indicated they will address the absence of staff assistance in the stairwells. Thank you Emily for your prompt and courteous response and kind assistance!!

I would say the only con was there were a lot of weddings going on, so it was a party atmosphere for some on the Saturday night. Not the wedding I went to because they are all super religious and not very big partiers in their room, unless they were playing Pokemon go or something.
But the people next door where whooping it up for sure.  I called downstairs on them at 1 and then again at 2 in the morning.  After the second time they for sure were quiet, but by then, do you really get any sleep.  I brought it up to the front check out on the way out and got a very lackadaisical "oohhh Im sorry" and a head tilt.  Not like I was expecting anything, but the response really just showed not a big care about it.  That was my only Con.  Will stay here again 100!

name: David vO
text:
I went there for an event, parking was terrible you had to wait in line to get to the building to park (before finding out that's you needed to park at least a block away). It would have helped if someone was at the main road redirecting people, or better yet provided a map in advance for the suggested parking area.
For a full day the men's restroom had no soap for washing hands(I notified the people there about needing the soap), the women's by the end of the day ran out of toilet tissue, and they're hand-washing faucet only worked as a trickle.
We were told not to bring any food in which normally is not a problem. Yet there is no other open restaurant in the immediate area (without getting in the car and driving in search of one as it is greater than 103 outside, walking is not recommended), this normally would not be a problem since there were two restaurants inside of the hotel. The problem that occurred was after waiting over 15 minutes in a line to get food we were told go somewhere else because they did not think there's enough food to serve us. So leaving their to go downstairs to the other restaurant we waited again to get put on a list, and then after seating us at 1:30 we were not able to get food and a drinks (water and tea) until after 2 pm. When we mentioned to the staff that it seemed they were unprepared for all 800 of us at the conference (I can understand being overwhelmed) but the reply was "no just all the tables were full" (yet when I checked in the room we had 13 tables and six of those tables were still empty and people were still standing at the door). When we ordered our food we made sure to ask for certain ingredients (cilantro) as one of our party has allergies and were reassured there was none. Yet by the time the food arrived we were so hungry and ate so fast we did not realize that the green flakes on top of their tacos is cilantro requiring that individual to self medicate and scratch throughout the rest of the conference. And that was day one.
On day 2 I realized there was no soap still in the men's restroom and notified the staff at the entrance, at lunch time I checked again and there was soap. I then went out to eat having learned my lesson.
I'm terribly disheartened with this place I have given it 2 stars (one was for the outstanding shuttle service by Joe Rogers with -SuperShuttle Execucar) and the other was because the hotel appeared very nice, safe and clean looking. As I travel a lot with work I would not recommend this Sheraton Austin Georgetown hotel. It will be a very long time before I consider trying it again.

resp.text:
Thank you David for all your feedback, it helps us identify areas we can improve on as we are always looking for ways to make things better.
We hope you give us another chance in the near future.

text:
The Muppa-Weaver wedding was the very first one at this hotel this August. My family worked closely with Jennifer Hart from day one, of giving us a tour before the hotel was even finished, to the very end. For the most part, we were generally pleased with the service we received. The team at the Sheraton worked hard to make sure our guests were happy and taken care of. The front desk especially took care of mine and my husband's needs the day of the wedding. The team was professional and courteous to all.

The only complaints I have about this venue is the delay in communications, often taking days to respond to an email or request. Our food tasting kept getting pushed out weeks, making us all nervous as we got closer to the wedding date. The hotel requires you use their catering, unless it is Indian food, which they do not offer.

There are some other little things I was not happy about, but at the end of the day, the things that mattered were handled professionally. Thank you, Sheraton!

The event planning team did a great job making our wedding vision come to life. It is a beautiful place, and we got a great deal with the price. The venue is brand-new, but has a well-experienced team to help any bride and groom looking for their perfect wedding.

text:
Perfect location for visitors, not to mention the Rivery park is practically their backyard.
Beautiful design & scenery.
Valet parking & other fabulous amenities to enjoy.
Trails that enable walking distance to San Gabriel park, Georgetown recreation center, rodeo arena, blue hole, and other great places!

If you're a lover of  fishing, disc golf, exploring trails, a distance runner, or plan to do some biking, THIS is the perfect place for you!

This Sheraton CANNOT be in a better locale.
This was definitely the perfect place to build.

Walking distance to City Light's Theater (aka: Shulman theater), Wal-Mart, Home Depot, Buffalo Wild Wings, IHop, a Mexican restaurant (Haven't tried yet), and George's on the Town Restaurant  (heard good thing's from reputable people but personally haven't been).

I've lived in Georgetown off & on since 1987...
MUCH has changed over the year's... GOOD thing's for the most part; but naturally, not ALL good.

So take my word for what that's worth it when I write a review.  I've been to alot of places...

I LOVED GT's "Home Town" vibe & although I welcome the valued growth, I also wish it wasn't SOOOO MUCH growth in such a short amount of time!

It's literally over the last 5 year's that the number of new resident's has increased so immensely that it's INTENSELY notable in EVERY ASPECT. It's getting CRAZY around here & is MORE CROWDED by the day!

COME!
VISIT!
ENJOY!!!
SPEND YOUR DOLLARS HERE!!!
BUT PLEASE DON'T STAY!
Kidding... sorta.

text:
Morning manager was rude when informed the coffee was empty, wouldn't move from behind the counter, instead had employees who were already performing other tasks come out to make coffee. Which, btw, took 15 minutes for the employees to even come out to begin with.  8am at a truck stop and no coffee...? Not a single one of the FIVE brews....? Come on now.
Not a single item on the roller grill, but it was covered in grease and crumbs. yummy 😑
Every single surface was sticky and covered in flies. I've seen less flies at the slaughterhouse down the road, Not even close to joking.

When there are no customers at the counter, an employee already behind the counter AND self checkouts, you'd think the manager could come out and make her store look presentable. Apparently not at this location.
10/10 won't be returning. I'd rather hit up the Loves up the street.

name: Molly Kirk
text: There's a hot deli, a subway, and a pizza hut here as well as hot showers a small dining area with plenty of tables. There were barstool height tables and chairs near the windows and there's a small recessed table area with fast charging capable usb ports as well as outlets to charge your devices with if needed. We ate from the deli area and there were plenty of choices to choose from both as main dish& sides. The meatloaf was a bit sweet and there was no salt in either the corn or green beans but that's easily rectified. It was reasonably priced for the portion sizes. Having said that- i feel the pizza hut prices were horribly expensive. 1. Slice of pizza was almost $4.00 before tax. A whole pizza was $15.00 before tax. Plenty of gas pumps for both commercial trucks& personal vehicles.

This is one of the sorriest truck stops, and Pilot, I've ever stopped at. I heard one customer complaining that there wasn't any coffee (a truck stop with no coffee???). Another customer stormed out after waiting for some time for Pizza Hut pizza (none ever came while I was there, as that's what I wanted too). The bathroom and coffee areas were a complete mess. There was only one person working at Subway, which there was quite a line of people waiting, but the one person working was doing her best.

A few years ago we happened to be passing through and stopped at this Pilot on their grand opening. At that time, it was the nicest Pilot we've ever stopped at! But, it had dramatically declined in quality and service in the last couple years. Hopefully they can get it back together.

name: Martin Castaneda
text:
While driving from Houston to Oregon my truck decided to break down in Dalhart, TX. I guess my truck wasn't ready to leave Texas just yet. Decided to drive it to the nearest O'Reilly's and work on it myself.

I spent 9 hours at this O'Reilly's. Every single one of the workers was extremely helpful getting the parts I needed and returning parts/tools I didn't use. I didn't receive a single complaint about working on my truck in their parking lot. On the contrary, they recommended a few local mechanics one of which fixed my truck. Part for the problem seemed to be the U-joints and the central support bearing.

As you can see, I removed the driveshaft. Ended up calling a mechanic to replace the U-joints and support bearing, though. Thanks to the O'Reilly staff I was able to get every part I needed, find a good mechanic, and get back on the road. Highly recommend this O'Reilly for all your car/truck parts.
